Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina is a barrier poke tank with great ranged damage. Rotating around the objective and using the environment to control distance from the enemy frontline are critical to finding success with her kit.

In ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank matchups, she excels at medium-range poke battles. Most of the other ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks beat her at close-range, but she has crowd control abilities to help her dictate the pace of the battle.

Teammates with similar ranged capabilities are great pairings, because they’ll get a lot of benefit from her massive barrier. Overall, as long as she can control spacing, she’s at an advantage, but heavy dive and brawl comps are difficult for her to deal with if she’s unable to outrun them.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Always play near cover. Peek out for the beam burst, and quickly hide between shots.
* Use your range to target DPS and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports to get a quick elim or force them to retreat.
* Position around the perimeter of objectives so you can contest without getting surrounded.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * AoE and explosive damage can be used to destroy multiple barrier panels at once.
* Dive counters her playstyle. Overwhelm her by quickly getting behind her barrier.
* If a teammate gets imprisoned by her ult. Help them destroy the barrier from the outside.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Sightline Control
* High damage
* Fight-winning Ult
* Countered by shield busters
* Vulnerable to Brawl
* Weak vs dive

Guide.title: Space and sightline control
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-array.png)Barrier Array arc shape and segmented panels of health make it one of the best abilities in Overwatch for controlling sightlines. Allies are able to take wider angles behind the barrier and reposition as panels are broken. The enemy team generally won't be able to take out all panels. At chokes and in long narrow hallways map areas, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina's barrier gives her team a huge advantage in the poke battle.

Guide.title: High damage from medium range
content: The burst damage and range of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/photon-magnum.png)Photon Magnum make her an extremely lethal threat at mid-range. The beam is the longest in the game, enabling her to play outside the optimal range of close-range enemies. Enemies positioned behind their Tank are often caught off guard by her deceptive range when she lands a crit with the explosion.

Guide.title: Fight-winning Ultimate
content: Many heroes lack the damage required to break through ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/panopticon.png)Panopticon before the barrier explodes. Unless their teammates break them out, catching a couple Supports with her Ult can secure the fight win all on its own.

Guide.title: Countered by shield buster
content: Team comps with heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junkrat.png)Junkrat who excel at burning through barrier health leath ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina with very little counterplay. They can play outside her range, and take away her only form of safety.

Guide.title: Vulnerable to brawl Tanks
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina beats brawl Tanks by keeping her distance and controlling the spacing. When she's unable to do so, her only close-range tool is![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sonic-repulsors.png)Sonic Repulsors knockback. One brawl Tanks like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya get up close and personal, she quickly falls.

Guide.title: Weak against dive
content: With no mobility tools, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina is unable to keep pace with high mobility dive heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer. They can easily keep away from her, and she struggles to peel for her backline when they bypass her. Also, she offers little help to her own high mobility allies.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Photon Magnum
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/photon-magnum.png)Photon Magnum

* Longest beam in OW. Although it has a limited range of 25m, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/photon-magnum.png)Photon Magnum has a greater range than any other beam in the game.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina has the range advantage in all ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank matchups other than ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra in Omnic Form
* Burst shot at the end is hitscan. No need to lead the shot.

* The burst and range make ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina especially effective at jiggle peeking while her barrier is on cooldown.

* * Briefly position behind cover between shots and during beam startup. Only peek out to shoot just before the high-impact shot fires. Doing so will minimize the time she can take damage, while still maintaining high dps output.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Barrier Array
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-array.png)Barrier Array
* Deploy the semi-circle barrier in front of choke points and in hallways with side doors. This maximizes the sightlines your team is protected from and can attack through.
* After choosing a placement for the barrier, each panel has its own HP, and must be destroyed individually or will expire at max duration.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-array.png)Barrier Array is weak against AoE damage that can destroy multiple panels at once. Examples include ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junkrat.png)Junkrat mines and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Sonic Repulsors
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sonic-repulsors.png)Sonic Repulsors

* Wall slams stun and inflict bonus damage. Be aware of the surrounding environment and try to position the enemy between ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina and a wall or structure, such as a payload.

* Against melee heroes, use this as a “get off me” button. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina doesn’t want to be point-blank. She wants to use her Crystal and beam range.
* When possible, look for environmental KO opportunities, such as on Eichenwald’s bridge.

Guide.title: [E]: Crystal Charge
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/crystal-charge.png)Crystal Charge
* Extremely good for restoring shields with her passive ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/reconstruction.png)Reconstruction.

* * When your HP is low, target deployables like an enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina's barrier to rapidly deal ability damage and burst heal yourself.
* Nearly infinite range (100 meters). Use it as soon as you see enemies while they are outside of your beam’s range.
* Upon impact with hero or terrain, the Crystal deals damage over time.
* Can be manually detonated in the air. Time detonation to explode right on top of enemies.

* Pierces through barriers so you can shoot ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma while they are protected from your beam.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Panopticon
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/panopticon.png)Panopticon
* How the explosive damage works
* * Barrier HP: 450
* Explosion damage scales from 100 – 300 based on barrier HP on expiration
* The hero inside can damage it, and their teammates outside the barrier can destroy it as well.
* Best used on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports and other heroes with low barrier damage capabilities.

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana, for example, both deal very low damage to barriers and will likely be instakilled by the explosion unless outside teammates help destroy its health.

* On the other hand, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog will quickly burn through it, and can use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-a-breather.png)Take a Breather to further reduce damage taken.
* Keep attacking!

* * Imprisoned enemies can’t attack you, but they still take damage from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina and her teammates. If you get the low, the explosion will often be enough to secure the elim.

Guide.title: Passive: Reconstruction
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/reconstruction.png)Reconstruction

* Only ability damage direct to enemy heroes counts towards ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/reconstruction.png)Reconstruction shield restoration.
* When your shields are low, keep an eye on how much health you have as you deal ability damage. When you are able to deal more damage, you’ll be able to stay in the fight longer.

Guide.title: Efficient Design
content: * Best for defensive play.
* When using Efficient Design, always wait to take a bit of damage before deploying her barrier.

Guide.title: Extended Power
content: * Better for offense.
* Extending your primary fire by 5m is very powerful; do not underestimate the strength of this minor perk.

* After activating, experiment with the increased range. Keep rotating during fights, and abuse your superior range when battling ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks.
* Ignore the enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank and use your Beam to Target squishy targets who think they are safe.

Guide.title: Disruptive Detonation
content: * Aim to detonate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/crystal-charge.png)Crystal Charge between two enemies to maximize the perk’s CC effect.
* Slow down the enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank's approach, and hinder enemies trying to escape.
* Recommended Major Perk

Guide.title: Power Move
content: * Good to give ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina counterplay against melee heroes.

* Once the enemy is in melee range, first deploy barrier behind them, then use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sonic-repulsors.png)Sonic Repulsors to wall slam them into your barrier.
* Power Move only causes barrier to act as a wall for Sonic wall slams. Enemies can still freely walk and move through it as usual.

Guide.title: Maps
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina performs best on maps with strong choke points and long hallways, such as **Havana**, **Junkertown**, and **Midtown**. These maps favor poke compositions, which Domina pairs well with and counters effectively thanks to her high barrier uptime and ranged attacks.

She struggles most with two types of maps. The first are those with very tight spaces, such as **New Junk City** and **Antarctic Peninsula**. While she can work with the right comps—provided you rotate and maintain optimal distance—it can be a significant struggle.

Maps with an abundance of high ground, such as **Watchpoint: Gibraltar** and **Numbani**, give her the most trouble. As stated under "Weaknesses" above, Domina struggles against high-mobility and dive heroes who thrive on these vertical layouts.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina pairs well with heroes who need a large shield to stand behind while spamming ranged damage. Heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste share similar positioning strategies. Their poke pressure helps her control spacing and chip away at the enemy team's resources before they can fully approach. Since she lacks mobility, AoE and projectile healing provide the most consistent sustain.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: The best way to counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina is to use heroes who can trade cooldowns to burn through her barrier. Aside from minor shield generation from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/reconstruction.png)Reconstruction, Domina doesn't have survivability tools outside of her barrier. Heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion can use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assaultt to quickly shred the shield, exposing Domina and her allies to their team's onslaught of damage.

Alternatively, you can bypass her barrier altogether using Rush or Dive comps. These strategies use bursts of mobility to close the gap and overwhelm the backline. Success depends on minimizing damage during the approach; for example, if a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt reaches melee range with only 400 barrier health and no armor remaining, he won't be able to swing aggressively enough to win the fight.

Guide.title: Overview
content: The Russian strongwoman Aleksandra Zaryanova perfectly blends solo and team play. Known as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya for short, she can use her strength to carry an entire team on her back. Equipped with both self and ally bubbles, players can choose between a team-oriented playstyle and a selfish “all by myself” approach.

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's high damage potential allows her to make up for a team with underperforming DPS. On the other hand, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can use every bubble on vulnerable allies, thwarting enemy attacks and enabling her teammates to make big plays. As a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya has middle-of-the-pack damage mitigation and, depending on her energy generation, has either the highest or lowest DPS of any ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank.

Guide.title: Playing As
content: * Build and maintain high energy by using Barriers on yourself only when actively attacking the enemy at closer ranges.
* Use your bubbles reactively to protect teammates rather than preemptively, prioritizing moments when allies are clearly under fire to maximize charge gain and impact.

* Cast ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge in coordination with your team’s follow-up ultimates or burst damage. Catching just one or two enemies is enough to win the fight.

Guide.title: Playing Against
content: * Force her to use bubbles early or inefficiently by threatening burst damage or dives, then momentarily disengaging.

* Play around her energy level. A high-energy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya is far more lethal, so respect her threat in fights and avoid extended duels when she has maximum charge.
* Avoid clumping together when she has Grav. Position where it's difficult for her to target you, or save defensive abilities to save yourself and teammates.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Solo carry potential
* Mid-range hero
* Survivability
* Needs high energy
* No mobility
* Bad Bubbles loses the fight

Guide.title: Solo Carry Potential
content: Use bubbles selfishly to generate high charge and keep yourself alive until you reach 175 damage per second at 100% energy. A fully charged ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can melt every 250 HP hero in under 1.5 seconds! With that kind of damage potential, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can always find a way to win. Furthermore, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can save allies a good distance from her with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier without having to give up her own position or aggression.

Guide.title: Mid-range Damage
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya excels in mid-range engagements (10 - 20m). When facing off against a close range heroes (![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper, etc), she can play at her maximum range just outside of their optimal ranges. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya doesn’t have to push up too far to put herself in range of pressuring enemies positioned behind their ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank. Secondary fire is also great for finishing off retreating enemies and its projectile speed is reliable at mid-range.

Guide.title: Survivability
content: The energy mechanics of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya bubbles force the enemy team to make quick decisions to try and destroy the barrier, thereby giving ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya more energy, or wait out the full 2 seconds, giving her free rein to advance or retreat. These interactions can make it very difficult to eliminate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya. Additionally, the combination of shield health and the self-heal passive allow ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya to hide behind cover briefly and quickly restore her health without the aid of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports.

Guide.title: Heavily Reliant On Maintaining High Energy
content: A low charge ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya doesn’t threaten anyone and applies minimal pressure. When an enemy team avoids damaging bubbles and you get stuck at low energy with no cooldowns, you can’t really offer anything to your team until both bubbles come back up. A ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank being shot at by a low-energy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can safely walk right past her and destroy her allies.

Guide.title: No Mobility and Weak Against Long Range Heroes
content: Enemies on the outskirts of a point, or on high ground areas are extremely difficult for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya to deal with. She can offer ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier to allies attacking these enemies but that’s about it. While a secondary fire jump can give a bit of extra vertical movement, it’s too short to give her access to most high ground areas.

Guide.title: A Couple Bad Bubbles Loses the Fight
content: Optimal bubble use is complex and the choice of what, when, where and who to bubble constantly changes throughout a match. Using a bubble on an ally you thought was in danger but wasn’t, leaves other allies completely vulnerable. Using bubble on one enemy ability leaves ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya open to a different enemy ability. Getting caught wasting two bubbles in a row usually means that teamfight is lost and your team needs to reset.

Guide.title: **Primary Fire: Particle Cannon**
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/particle-cannon.png)Particle Cannon

* Use the beam primarily against DPS and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports when they are within range, and only commit to the enemy tank if no higher-value target is available.
* Play near the outer edge of your beam range to minimize incoming damage while maintaining pressure.

* The beam cannot be ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/deflect.png)Deflected, absorbed by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp, making it reliable into those heroes.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: (Energy Grenades)
content: * Use secondary fire to pressure grouped enemies and build ultimate charge when targets are outside beam range.
* Weave secondary fire into your ammo cycle to maximize overall damage output, especially when finishing a clip.
* Secondary fire into melee provides ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's highest burst combo at close range.
* You can still fire a secondary projectile even if you have minimal ammo remaining.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Particle Barrier (Self Bubble)
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/particle-barrier.png)Particle Barrier
* Use self-bubble reactively when you are actively taking damage or committing to space, rather than preemptively.
* Look to bubble moments of clear aggression—when you are the focus of enemy abilities or stepping forward to pressure.
* Avoid using self-bubble too early in neutral, as it leaves you vulnerable if the enemy re-engages while it is on cooldown.

Guide.title: [E]: Projected Barrier (Ally Bubble)
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier
* Bubble teammates who are either under heavy pressure or committing to aggressive plays.

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier to enable dives, flanks, or frontline pushes that would otherwise be punished.
* Prioritize saving allies who are being collapsed on, as a well-timed bubble can completely swing a fight.

Guide.title: Bubble Management Philosophy
content: * Favor reactive bubbles over predictive ones, as responding to confirmed damage is more consistent than guessing enemy timing.
* Decide between early charge generation and disciplined cooldown cycling based on tempo—early bubbles build energy but slow the fight, while holding bubbles allows for stronger mid-fight reactions.
* Be mindful that both bubbles share a cooldown, so inefficient use of one limits your overall defensive flexibility.

Guide.title: [Q] Graviton Surge
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge
* You do not need a massive multi-target ultimate to win a fight; securing a single high-value elimination is often enough.

* Track enemy counter-ultimates and mitigation tools such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/ice-wall.png)Ice Wall, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier before committing.
* Use secondary fire to gauge projectile arc and range before throwing long-distance Gravitons.
* Graviton can attach to any surface, and suspending enemies slightly above the ground can make follow-up damage easier for your team.

Guide.title: Energy (Passive Mechanic)
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy.png)Energy
* Damage absorbed by your barriers increases the damage of both primary and secondary fire.
* Energy decays if you are not mitigating damage, so maintain fight tempo to preserve high charge.
* High energy dramatically increases your threat level, so positioning and bubble timing should revolve around maintaining meaningful charge without overextending.

Guide.title: Spotter
content: * Extremely powerful for enabling your allies. Healing and granting a speed boost can turn your teammates into carries.

Guide.title: Jump-Ups
content: * Best on maps with lots of high ground. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya normally struggles on these maps, but the extra jump height gives her more mobility options.

Guide.title: Energy Lance
content: * Best against brawly comps that play grouped up. Target the enemies behind and rotate to keep the front-most enemy in the beams path.

Guide.title: Extra Oomph
content: * Stops decay, and builds more overall energy than just taking damage. Great when the enemy team is smart and trying not to charge you up.

Guide.title: Antarctic Peninsula
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya tends to do well on Control Maps since most do not favor long range fighting. On Antarctic Peninsula, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's lack of mobility does not hinder her ability to get value. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can almost always force fights to occur within her optimal range on each of the three objective points. The high ground areas on this map are also not outside of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's effective range making her a great pick.

Guide.title: Rialto
content: * Although Rialto has a few areas with long line of sights, there is also a ton of cover for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya to play around. When advancing on defense, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can push with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/particle-barrier.png)Particle Barrier as she moves between cover to the next. Likewise on defense, when pressured or low on bubbles, most areas have nearby cover to hide behind before coming out to contest for space.

Guide.title: Lijiang Tower
content: * Similar to Antarctic Peninsula, the map architecture pairs well with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's kit. The focus of fights are forced on to the point where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya is strongest. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge is one of the best ults for clearing a control point considering multiple enemies tend to be grouped in one area while contesting.

Guide.title: Hollywood
content: * Too many long sight lines and too much high ground covers every point of Hollywood for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya to be consistently useful. Does the enemy have an ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe sitting back owning your team? Well ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya literally just has to watch it happen and try to outplay the enemies frontline.

Guide.title: New Queen Street
content: * For ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya to be effective, she can’t really ever be on the robot. New Queen Street is one of the most open maps in OW2. At virtually every part of the map, the entire enemy team can position themselves outside of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's range. If she plays way up on the enemy, she leaves her backline exposed on the objective. The fights end up happening on two separate fronts and require your team to win two fights simultaneously.

Guide.title: Suravasa
content: * The Flashpoint map Suravasa has too much ground to cover for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya. The points are so spread out that the enemy team will almost always get an advantageous position before ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya arrives. The objectives are also so exposed that ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya has to rely on her self bubbles to stay alive and struggles to use cover when pressured.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can work well in both brawl comps and dive comps, but struggles with and against poke comps.

Brawl comps built around ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya have primarily close range heroes who move together, try to survive poke damage, and move to force only close range engagements.
**Example of a strong Zarya brawl comp**

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira

Dive Comps with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya will have multiple DPS or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Support allies going for aggressive plays on the enemy backline. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya has one of two roles in dive comps. Primarily to bubble her aggressive allies, shielding them from crowd control abilities and giving them the extra 225 HP. The other way she enables her diving allies is by maintaining her own survivability. Using cover and self bubbles allows the rest of your team's resources to be dedicated to the dive engagements instead of having to keep ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya alive.
**Example of a strong Zarya dive comp**

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana

Guide.title: Individual synergies with other heroes
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji

* Aside from a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nano-boost.png)Nano Boost, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier is the best ability a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji player can be given. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji wants to be deep behind enemy lines and wreak havoc. He is weak to crowd control and landing any of the many CC abilities on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji usually means his death. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier grants temporary invulnerability to CC, making ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji very hard for the enemy to deal with. A Bubble on a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonblade.png)Dragonblade almost guarantees at least one elimination.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hanzo.png)Hanzo

* The classic “Grav Dragon” remains one of the best ultimate combos to this day. The only real counter to Grav Dragon is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence, but that counter can be countered. If ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya lands two or more people in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge, the combo all but declares victory.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana's healing enables mega aggressive play for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya. Anti-Nade also helps to get elims the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks that ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya struggles to beat without the anti-healing effect. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nano-boost.png)Nano Boost on a high energy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya just demolishes the enemy team. Most heroes can’t run away fast enough even if they see the glowing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya coming at them. Moreover, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can save her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana from enemy flankers (who ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana is weak to), with a well-timed ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: The primary way to counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya on any role is to avoid giving her charge and figure out her bubble usage patterns. If she always bubbles early, wait it out then go aggressive. Does the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya panic bubble her allies as soon as you look at them? Attack ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya herself now that doesn't have any left for herself. Sometimes going for a brief retreat and reposition can allow ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy.png)Energy decay to kick in, which then allows your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank to take less damage in the recontest.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra

* No matter how high ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/charge.png)Charge ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya is, she’s not killing Ram while he’s blocking if his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports are healing him. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya also struggles to get charge from Ram because he can easily shield or block during bubbles. Between ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form's speed boost and Vortex’s slowing effect, Ram can easily chase Down ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya when she attempts to recover behind cover between bubbles.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/widowmaker.png)Widowmaker

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya simply doesn't have any counterplay to a good ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/widowmaker.png)Widowmaker. Obviously, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can’t kill Widow from long distance, but ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya also can’t reliably help her team stay alive against Widow either.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei countering ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya depends on who can outplay the other. If an ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/ice-wall.png)Ice Wall cuts off ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya from her team, it's pretty much a guaranteed elim, or will trade your one cool down for both bubbles, and a ton of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports' abilities. The danger for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei is that if she messes up her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/ice-wall.png)Ice Wall, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's close-range damage far exceeds ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei's close-range primary fire.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste

Guide.title: Overview
content: With the ability to control gravity, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma crushes every enemy in his path. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's power to control the tempo and positioning of team fights is nearly unmatched in the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank category. Being able to simultaneously mitigate enemy projectiles while dealing tons of his own damage has made ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma consistent across different types of metas. Unless he is nerfed into the ground, there are never scenarios where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma feels useless.

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's AoE poke damage rapidly boosts his ultimate charge and keeps the enemy teams consistently low on HP which gives his team an influx of opportunities for playmaking. The way he can contest space is not by standing directly in the enemy's way, but through dishing out high levels of damage whilst taking very low damage himself.

The ideal range for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma to play in is made obvious by his primary fire, so he is always looking for ways to rotate and maintain his perfect distance. When facing a team with huge amounts of poke damage, no other tank can deal with a ranged onslaught better than this astrophysicist.

Guide.title: Playing As
content: * Position at mid-range poke distances to maximize ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres damage while keeping yourself outside of the enemy's optimal range.

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/experimental-barrier.png)Experimental Barrier to the enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports damage and healing from reaching their ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank or your team.

* Track escape abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade before activating ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/gravitic-flux.png)Gravitic Flux or else the enemy will easily avoid its AoE.

Guide.title: Playing Against
content: * Force ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma off his optimal mid-range poke angles by pressuring him with dive or flank threats, exploiting his lack of mobility.

* Beam heroes are strong against ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma because they can burn through his shield and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp doesn't absorb beams.

* Stun him out of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/gravitic-flux.png)Gravitic Flux to immediately cancel his ult before he has a chance to activate.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * High AoE damage
* Movable shield
* Survivability
* No mobility spells
* Can't get solo elims
* Slow projectiles

Guide.title: High AoE damage output
content: At the end of games, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma will often lead the scoreboard with total damage dealt. Especially against teams that play grouped near their tank, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's direct impact damage on one enemy plus splash damage on multiple enemies quickly racks up. Additionally, the ricochet effect of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres makes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma extremely powerful at controlling tight spaces like hallways and choke points.

Guide.title: Movable shield
content: There are many shield abilities in OW2 but ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma alone has the ability to constantly redeploy his shield and set it anywhere he pleases. No other shield can be left floating in mid-air, perfectly blocking an enemy hero's LoS. Saving shield health and using it to react to specific ability usages, splitting off a target from the rest of their team or simply soaking up the full 700 HP of damage can all be great uses of his shield.

Guide.title: Survivability
content: Even when ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's team has lost heroes during a team fight, it is never over if he is still alive. Excellent use of cover between shots of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres, Barrier and Grasp combine to allow ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma to take very little damage and require little to no resources from his supports to stay alive. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion also works as a great anti-dive CC tool to shut down enemy movement abilities or give ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma and his allies time to escape.

Guide.title: No mobility abilities
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's greatest and most exploitable weakness comes in his complete lack of mobility tools. Other than during his ultimate, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma has no way to speed himself up or move vertically and is technically the only ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank without any way to do so. Positioning is extremely important for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma because he is essentially stuck wherever he is currently standing. The poor mobility also makes him weak against high mobility and dive comps.

Guide.title: Difficulty solo confirming elims
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's highest burst combo (![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion → ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres → melee) only deals 230 dmg leaving the standard 250 HP hero the chance to live, escape and keep fighting. Even though his ult combo (Flux → ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres → slam) can eliminate a single target, there are multiple abilities that counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/gravitic-flux.png)Gravitic Flux and enable enemies to survive the combo. While he has high overall high damage output, the damage tends to be too slow or inconsistent to consistently confirm elims without team assistance.

Guide.title: Slow primary fire projectile speed and fire rate
content: The speed of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres is slow and requires a good deal of leading your shots in order to land direct hits. The small gap between each one of the two orbs in his double shots is also just large enough to make it difficult to land a direct hit with both orbs. Top all that off with the slow rate of fire and consistently hitting small hurtbox heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko becomes very challenging for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma players.

Guide.title: [Primary Fire]: Hyperspheres
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma is a front-line Tank that indirectly contests space. (As opposed to a hero like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt who stands directly in the spot he is contesting).
* * While shots are easier to land at point-blank range, Sigma typically wants to play near his max range. His slow rate of fire makes jiggle peeking a wall or corner really powerful.

* Expose yourself only during the moments Sigma is actually firing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres then quickly retreat behind cover.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres bounce, so look for opportunities to attack enemies around corners and inside rooms.
* Aim towards the enemies feet for more consistent direct hits. The hurt boxes are larger, and if you miss slightly, sometimes you'll catch them with the bounce.

Guide.title: Positioning
content: * Even when using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/experimental-barrier.png)Experimental Barrier to position more aggressively, it is best to stay near some type of cover, even if just partial cover like the Payload. The cover still allows Sigma to cycle through use of cover, Barrier and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp to protect himself from incoming damage and stay alive as long as possible.

* Rotating around an objective is a crucial skill for Sigma players to learn. To do this, focus on maintaining a distance to the enemies that keeps them within your primary fire range, but outside of close and melee range. As the enemies move towards you, circumnavigate the objective area, or pieces of cover in order to keep the distance and keep pressuring them with your AoE damage.

Guide.title: [Secondary Fire]: Experimental Barrier
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/experimental-barrier.png)Experimental Barrier
* Try to never let the shield break
* * Leaving the shield with even 1 HP will save you the 5 extra seconds of cooldown before beginning to regenerate shield health.

* Only need 1 HP of shield available to block big abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/self-destruct.png)Self-Destruct, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook etc.
* Use to block high value projectile abilites rather than burning health on random poke damage.

* * Depending on the enemy comp and situation, the Experimental Barrier can be useful for general damage mitigation but its best use is to decide what heroes have big impact abilities and try to save some shield health to react to them.

* In addition to those listed above, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-blade.png)Jagged Blade, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade are other good examples.
* Play near cover so you can recall shield, and corner peek while shield health regenerates.
* Recall shield before using Kinetic Grasp to maximize shield health management.
* Block snipers LoS such as Widowmaker, Ashe, and Ana who play back from their team and do very little damage to barriers.
* * Great for blocking high-ground positions
* When doing this, place the shield behind as many of the enemy heroes as possible so it doesn't break.

Guide.title: [Shift]: Kinetic Grasp
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp

* Since Sigma is completely vulnerable to beam damage for the full 2 seconds or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp, you’ll ideally want to be positioned where the beam heroes can’t attack you when you use Kinetic Grasp.

* The hitbox is actually a large rectangle in front of Sigma and absorbs all projectiles that come in contact with it. The AoE is rather generous and can be treated like a mini ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix.

* Absorbing damage from turrets like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/deploy-turret.png)Deploy Turret and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. guarantees overhealth generation.

* Grasp is countered by non-absorbable stuns, so be careful not to position too aggressively when the enemy has CC abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun available.

Guide.title: [E]: Accretion
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion

* Landing a direct hit to knock down and stun an enemy is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma’s sole counter-option against enemy aggression.

* * Against a flanking DPS, hitting an ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion usually leads to an elimination assuming other allies are following up.
* When facing most mobility Tanks, you can stop their dives or escapes with Accretion.

* * Knock down ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston during his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack, and you'll often be able to get the kill.

* Accretion is a great tool to stop channeled abilities (![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-block.png)Power Block ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/block-nemesis-form.png)Block (Nemesis Form), etc.)

* Large hitbox but slow-moving means the ability is best used when enemies are making a predictable movement. (i.e., walking to cover, jumping, falling, movement abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/guardian-angel.png)Guardian Angel or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/violent-leap.png)Violent Leap etc.)

Guide.title: [Q]: (Ultimate) Gravitic Flux
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/gravitic-flux.png)Gravitic Flux
* There is a 1 second activation delay time once a location is selected before enemies are locked in the ult.

* * * Track enemy escape abilities such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/swift-step.png)Swift Step, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-slide.png)Power Slide, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify. If you didn't just see these types of abilities used, assume the enemy will be able to evade your ult.

* Two direct ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres (one volley) during his ult with eliminate 300 HP heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei.
* Use cover

* * Hard knockdowns and stuns will cancel your ult. You can strafe in the air behind cover, activate, hide, then peek to shoot ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres.

* Place ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/experimental-barrier.png)Experimental Barrier in front of where you will fly to protect yourself.

* If the enemy for sure has a stun like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart, it's better to just activate and hide until the slam. Let your team shoot them in the air.

Guide.title: Kinetic Cycle
content: * Decent when struggling to maintain distance for dive and brawl ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks. Otherwise, take the other.

Guide.title: Hyper Regeneration
content: * Barrier health is very important, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma deals a lot of damage from his primary fire. Your team gains a significant amount of increased shielding, and in turn, everyone has an easier time staying alive.

Guide.title: Hyper Strike
content: * Interesting ability that is pretty good at countering any enemy with a primarily close-ranged kit. Send them floating and out of their optimal range.

Guide.title: Levitation
content: * Very good as it gives ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma the one thing he is missing, mobility.
* Best use is to traverse between high ground areas where your poke pressure can dominate.

Guide.title: Circuit Royal
content: * Watch any pro game and you’ll see ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma is a must pick on Circuit Royal. For us normal folk, he is still the strongest ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank pick for this long range map. Circuit Royal is basically 3 long hallways that ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's abilities are all perfectly suited for. Barrier cuts off sight lines from enemies, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp only needs to absorb damage from one direction since flanking on this map is very uncommon. Narrow areas give ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma an easier time landing his primary fire and he can use all the walls to help aim for direct hits as well.

Guide.title: Junkertown
content: * Most of the time you’ll be playing with and facing off against poke heavy team comps on Junkertown. Each of the three points are very open which can make it difficult to constantly land ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres, but ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's defensive options in these areas with long LoS is unmatched.

Guide.title: Midtown
content: * On Defense ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma can focus on setting up strong position to hold and spam the choke points. On offense, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma can slowly work his way forward as he uses his defensive abilities and takes space for his team to move with him. Most of the defensive positions available to the enemy team keep targets within ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's range since most fights occur at a mid-range. There aren’t really any areas in the entire map where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's lack of mobility hinders his ability to contribute to the fight.

Guide.title: Watchpoint Gibraltar
content: * Every point on Gibraltar is loaded with strong high ground areas that ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma cannot easily access and has a difficult time contesting enemies who are.

Guide.title: Ilios
content: * On Well, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma is very vulnerable to being CC’d into the Well and he doesn’t have a reliable means of counterplay. Ruins and Lighthouse both force fights to be at closer quarters than ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma prefers and he has difficulty controlling the spacing.

Guide.title: Nepal
content: * Prepare to spend the entire match trying not to get run over by enemy aggression. Nepal has a few areas ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma can play well in, but he needs to play nearly perfectly the entire game whereas a brawl or mobility tank only needs to make a few correct choices to win the maps against him. Even in Sanctum, where more long range engagements occur, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma tends to crumble as soon as the enemy breaks through his first line of defense.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma is best suited for poke team comps. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma is really good at taking up enemy focus and resources which allows long range allies behind him to attack more freely. Shutting down enemy poke heroes is also an area ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma excels in, so the odds are in his teammates' favor. The whole team can work together to chip away at enemy health and resources before the enemy ever has a chance to fully commit to their attack.
**Ideal comp built around Sigma:**

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hanzo.png)Hanzo, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari

Guide.title: Individual synergies with other heroes
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy's optimal range is very similar to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's, and the two heroes become a duo front line following up on each other's high damage output. High Noon can be difficult to get kills with and often ends up being a zoning ultimate. Catch a few enemies in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/gravitic-flux.png)Gravitic Flux, however, and High Noon means certain death!
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo has a uniquely potent synergy between ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/gravitic-flux.png)Gravitic Flux and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/focusing-beam.png)Focusing Beam. Flux at minimum puts its target at 50% HP which is exactly where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/focusing-beam.png)Focusing Beam does maximum damage and allows ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo to constantly confirm kills off of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's Ultimate.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo's poke damage and off-angling pairs really well with how and where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma wants to play. She can also confrim kills off of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion knockdowns with Beam.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste's poke damage is one of the best utilities a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Support can add to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's kit. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/amplification-matrix.png)Amplification Matrix's damage boost applies to both ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyperspheres.png)Hyperspheres which makes the two attacks a “one shot” combo against every non-Tank hero in the game. Additionally, the slow movement of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma makes him an easy target for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste to heal.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Any time you are playing against a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma you want to figure out where he is trying to position, then track which of his abilities best counter yours. If you are playing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston, you don’t need to pay any attention to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/experimental-barrier.png)Experimental Barrier or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp, but ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion can easily mean your death if he hits you out of a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack.

Regardless of who you are playing, you’ll benefit from constantly repositioning to outplay his Barrier usage. Then focus on closing the distance to him and trying to get him stuck somewhere he is unable to retreat.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's a beam hero, which means every time ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma uses ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp, she can nonstop blast him for two full seconds! When pressing forward into ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretions can easily be reacted to with a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/particle-barrier.png)Particle Barrier, preventing its CC effect and giving a burst of energy charge to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/symmetra.png)Symmetra

* First off, her primary fire charges up insanely fast anytime ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/experimental-barrier.png)Experimental Barrier is in front of her.
