Guide.title: Overview
content: The original face of Overwatch, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer has been one of the most game-defining heroes ever introduced. Zipping around fights, bursting down Supports, and getting multi-kills with a nice ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulse-bomb.png)Pulse Bomb stick have made her a crowd favorite. Her kit and design are so good, the only time she’s ever fallen out of a top meta position is when her damage gets nerfed into the ground.

She can keep up with every dive hero and in coordinated attacks, she deletes backlines. Even when she’s not getting solo kills, just her presence poses a huge threat and interrupts the enemy team’s game plan. Most of her time is spent behind enemy lines, surviving on her own and looking for targets she can isolate.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Dive the backline. The number one job of every Tracer is to either kill or distract the enemy backline. Even if the Supports live, they can’t heal the rest of their team if they're trying to fight you.
* Avoid Tanks. Most Tanks have armor, which negates a lot of your damage anyway. Tracer can annoy Tanks, but she’s wasting her time if she is focusing on them.

* Don’t go in without ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/recall.png)Recall or two ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/blink.png)Blinks. Tracer can’t survive fights without the ability to dodge and rewind time. Waiting a few extra seconds for your cooldowns is far better than going in and getting sent back to spawn.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Keep your distance. Tracer has terrible ranged damage so try to position where it's difficult for her to reach you, or use mobility tools to dodge her.

* Track ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/recall.png)Recall. You can get used to the timing of Recall to predict where she will rewind to. If you see Recall used, that is your chance to chase and eliminate Tracer.

* If you see Tracer multi-Blink straight at you, expect a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulse-bomb.png)Pulse Bomb. Use a barrier, stun, or escape tool to avoid getting stuck.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Self-reliant
* Mobile AF
* Pain to play against
* Short range
* Hard to play
* Low health

Guide.title: Self-reliant
content: Tracer can heal herself and use her mobility to grab health packs when needed. At very close ranges, she can one-clip enemy backlines without having to coordinate a dive attack. Unlike most heroes, she can pretty much ignore what her team is doing and execute her own game plan.

Guide.title: Evasive and mobile
content: Her small body and fast movement make her difficult to hit. She can reliably dodge enemy cooldowns and Ults with Blinks and Recall. She’s also one of the best overtime stallers in the DPS category because she gets back to point quickly, then touches, evades, and touches again to keep resetting the OT timer.

Guide.title: Nuisance
content: The hardest part about dealing with a skilled Tracer is that she is always being a nuisance. You can never fully ignore her, but it often feels impossible to kill her. She can single-handedly keep both enemy Supports preoccupied, while her team kills everyone else.

Guide.title: Short range only
content: The main downside of Tracer's kit is the limited effective range of Pulse Pistols. Unless you can get close to your target, your damage will barely tickle the enemy. Wide bullet spread and harsh damage falloff prevent Tracer from dealing meaningful damage at medium to long ranges.

Guide.title: Mechanically demanding
content: One reason Tracer has always been a staple in pro and top 500 meta, even when she’s been weak in regular ranked play, is that she has a high skill floor and ceiling. Tracking and Blink mechanics make or break good Tracer mains. Even if you execute a perfect strategy, it won’t matter if you can’t land your shots, get lost while Blinking, or whiff Pulse Bomb.

Guide.title: Low health
content: Winning the award for lowest health of any hero, Tracer relies on movement to stay alive. She gets insta-killed by a lot of attacks and combos that every other hero would survive. You have to play extra carefully when using Tracer, as small amounts of spam damage quickly deplete her small health pool.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Pulse Pistols
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulse-pistols.png)Pulse Pistols
* Stay close
* * Tracer’s ideal range is about 7m or closer. From this distance, the majority of bullets stay within an enemy's hurtbox, and the damage falloff doesn’t kick in.
* The closer you are, the more consistently you’ll land all bullets. You’ll also be able to go for headshots at very close distance and benefit from the double damage.
* Poke
* * A bit of poke damage is better than nothing. However, your time will usually be better spent setting up flanks.

* Any damage resets the universal self-healing passive. So, against Supports shooting just to get in some damage and stop their self-healing can buy you extra time to keep their health low while you close the distance between you.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Blink
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/blink.png)Blink
* Dodge
* * Anytime you are attacking or dueling, Blinks are your primary means of staying alive. Change up your Blink movement with left and right Blinks, crossup Blinks, and Blinking behind corners.
* Traverse the map
* * You should always use Blinks to get around faster, until you are getting near the enemy team. Don’t want to get caught with no Blinks and then have to immediately use Recall just to stay alive.
* Engage and disengage
* * Blinks help you get into your ideal range faster and safer, so you can start attacking. Be careful never to use all three to get into position.
* Always save at least one Blink to dodge.
* If you don’t have Recall or want to save Recall, Blinks are a great way to back out of a fight, reassess the situation then go back in.

Guide.title: [E]: Recall
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/recall.png)Recall
* Use as late as possible
* * Focus on using Blinks to survive and only Recalling when absolutely necessary.
* Waiting until you’ve taken more damage also helps to get more enemy resources out before you get to reset the fight.
* Just don’t activate too late, as you can be killed or stunned during its brief startup animation.
* Never die with Recall
* * Most importantly, better safe than sorry. If you die with Recall, 100%, you know you wasted a death and the long trip back from spawn.
* Play safe
* * Keep your distance when Recall is on cooldown. Don’t overcommit when you have no escape.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Pulse Bomb
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulse-bomb.png)Pulse Bomb
* Sneak attack
* * Sticking a target is difficult. To improve your odds, always try to sneak up on people so they won’t be trying to dodge you.
* Wait behind walls, or come from behind and make sure they aren’t looking at you.
* Track counter abilities
* * Heroes who have abilities like: Moira Fade, Zarya bubble, Cassidy Roll, Kiriko Cleanse, etc., can use them to survive a Pulse Bomb stick.
* Always wait until you see these abilities used before attempting to use Pulse Bomb.

Guide.title: Chronal Dash
content: * Increased movement, and can be good for chasing enemies with high mobillity.
* The main problem is that you would have to adjust muscle memory of blink distance mid-round.
* Not worth taking over Kinetic Reload.

Guide.title: Kinetic Reload
content: * Recommended Minor Perk
* Incredibly strong Perk to help secure elims. You literally restore 50% of your ammo with each Melee.
* Blink > Melee when you need just a few more bullets for the kill, as quick melee is faster than reloading.

Guide.title: Blink Packs
content: * Considering ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer uses frequently grabs health packs, this will help you get back into the fight a bit faster, multiple times per game.
* Great when dueling and are able to grab a health pack. Tracer puts herself in a lot of 1v1 scenarios. Health packs restoring a Blink give her increased survivability.
* * Also, she can now steal health packs from the enemy **even when she’s at full health**. Don’t let them grab it!

Guide.title: Quantum Entanglement
content: * Helpful for confirming elims
* * Sometimes, enemies survive with a bit of health. Overhealth and extra ammo come in handy to help stay in the fight after Recalling to get that final blow.
* Should probably still disengage
* * Even with the overhealth, if you have no Blinks available, you should still get out of the fight and wait for your cooldowns to refresh.
* In General, don't go aggro after using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/recall.png)Recall.

Guide.title: Maps
content: Tracer’s mobility allows her to find value on virtually every map. The best maps for Tracer, however, are flat maps with plenty of side rooms for flanking. When Tracer can abuse corners and side routes with health packs, her job of being a backline assassin becomes considerably easier. Because she lacks vertical mobility, she can have trouble on maps with lots of high ground that the enemy can use to avoid her. On wide open maps with long sight lines, Tracer wastes a lot of time pathing to avoid enemies with superior range.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer can do everything she's meant to do all on her own. She doesn't need a specific team comp to function. That said, however, dive comps are where she can shine the brightest.

A coordinated dive with another DPS or Tank makes her flanks extremely lethal. Also, having another hero in the enemy backlines with her takes attention off of her and makes her actions safer. Dive Tanks like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va, and dive DPS like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/vendetta.png)Vendetta, are good choices as they and Tracer can keep up with each other's mobility.

Passive Support healing like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-harmony.png)Orb of Harmony and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/restorative-stream.png)Restorative Stream are really strong for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer since she can zip around while healing. Her HP is very small, so the light healing brings higher value on her than the huge HP of a Tank.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer can win games by being Pro-status and going in and deleting everyone one by one. Most of the time for the "mortal" gamers, she wins by securing occasional assassinations and being a constant nuisance. You'll need to be able to stop her from harassing your Supports if you want to win.

The best way to do so is with Stuns like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mizuki.png)Mizuki’s ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/binding-chain.png)Binding Chain, or protection like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/torbjorn.png)Torbjörn’s ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/deploy-turret.png)Deploy Turret.
Keep your distance. Tracer has terrible ranged damage, so try to position where it's difficult for her to reach you or use mobility tools to dodge her.

Track Recall, and if you haven't seen her use it, save your offensive cooldowns until after. You can get used to the timing of Recall to predict where she will rewind to. If you see Recall used, that is your chance to chase and eliminate Tracer.

If you see Tracer multi-![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/blink.png)Blink straight at you, expect a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulse-bomb.png)Pulse Bomb. Use a barrier, stun, or escape tool to avoid getting stuck.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters names
content: mizuki
torbjorn

Guide.title: Overview
content: Vendetta, champion of the Colosseo, is Overwatch’s only true melee DPS hero. A ruthless gladiator driven by rage and unrelenting ambition to reclaim her family’s lost empire. Wielding the massive Palatine Fang greatsword, she combines lightning-fast movement with lethal crowd control and burst damage.

In team comps, Vendetta’s purpose is to dive and destabilize backlines, force out cooldowns, and create chaos that her teammates can follow up on. Unlike ranged DPS, she must be in the thick of battle to find value. This high-risk, high-reward playstyle demands precise timing, smart target selection, and the ability to read the battlefield to know when it is safe to commit. Doing so correctly brings huge returns, as Vendetta can single-handedly destroy a team’s backline, which will trigger the Tank falling next and winning the fight.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Stage from off-angles and high ground to approach the enemy from angles they can’t see you coming.
* Prioritize high-value isolated targets, such as a Wuyang positioned behind the rest of his team.
* Use not only her block but also her mobility survive by evading enemy attacks.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Maintain distance. Save your escape tool for when you see her use her sword toss dash. She can’t chase you if you reposition after.
* The moment she arrives, focus her. She won’t be able to escape for a few seconds, and that is your team’s best opportunity to punish her.
* Use crowd control to neutralize her. She can only try to dodge it as her shield does not absorb CC.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Good in the enemy's face
* Mobile AF
* Snowballer
* Low range
* Squishy AF
* Weak vs CC

Guide.title: Major advantage at close-range
content: Vendetta’s combos and mobility make her deadly in CQC duels. When she sticks to a target, her burst and sustained sword damage can overwhelm most heroes before they escape

Guide.title: Mobility and disruption
content: Abilities like Whirlwind Dash and Soaring Slice let her enter, reposition, or disengage quickly. This mobility makes her unpredictable and hard to pin down in brawls.

Guide.title: Snowballing
content: Her Onslaught passive increases movement and attack speed as she hits enemies. If the skirmish lasts for more than a few seconds, she becomes even more powerful, and her damage can overwhelm her target.

Guide.title: Extremely limited range
content: Vendetta struggles at long distances; ranged poke and hitscan harassment can peel targets before she gets within striking distance.

Guide.title: Glass cannon
content: Vendetta is as squishy as she is deadly. Misusing cooldowns or diving too many heroes at once will generally lead to her own death.

Guide.title: Vulnerable to crowd control
content: Her block does not stop CC, Sleep Dart, or stuns. Knockbacks can instantly shut down her engage if she already used her dashes and then gets booped while blocking.

Guide.title: [Primary Fire]: Palatine Fang
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/palatine-fang.png)Palatine Fang
* After the nerfs to her ability damage, the regular sword swings and overhead are your main source of damage.
* Once you are in range, just spam primary fire and don’t worry about your other abilities except for movement or blocking.
* When you see your target, you can prime the overhead byperforming two swings behind cover, then popping out to attack them with the 3rd swing that is the big overhead slash.
* * It’s short, but you have a small window of time to pause after the 2nd slash and still perform the overhead.
* Longer range than you think. If you hold forward and jump during the overhead start-up, you’ll hit targets that were more than 10m away from you.

Guide.title: [Secondary Fire]: Warding Stance
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/warding-stance.png)Warding Stance
* Not invincible, only damage reduction, so make sure you have a decent amount of health left when using it, so don’t just die anyway (ex, ~100HP).
* Blocks 100% melee damage like Reinhardt's Hammer. Blocking melee also drains the resource.
* Once block is depleted, it’s time to get out of the fight.

Guide.title: Protected Edge (Primary Fire during Warind Stance)
content: * Mostly for poke damage to farm ult charge.
* Not much of a lethal threat. But smart to use before getting into close range, and anytime you want to get in extra damage against a target outside of your sword toss range.
* Good for securing elims as the final blow on a low HP enemy that barely survived your initial attack.
* Firing the projectile also consumes block resource.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Whirlwind Dash
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whirlwind-dash.png)Whirlwind Dash

* Because you’ll always be using the sword throw dash to engage, save Whirlwind Dash to disengage, or dodge while waiting for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soaring-slice.png)Soaring Slice to refresh.
* The damage is ok, but only worth using when multiple enemies are grouped up, or when needing a quick final blow.

Guide.title: [E]: Soaring Slice
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soaring-slice.png)Soaring Slice
* Use Sword Toss to gain verticality, take high ground, and set up your next engage.
* Ideally, you don’t want the enemy to see you coming. Always path to catch your target by surprise.
* You can use Soaring Slice early to get into position, then wait for the cooldown to refresh before actually diving in.
* Overhead always follows the sword catch.

Guide.title: Combo
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soaring-slice.png)Soaring Slice into the air above an enemy. While you are falling shoot a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-edge.png)Projected Edge, land an overhead slice, and follow with:
* Melee will elim 225 HP heroes
* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-edge.png)Projected Edge will elim 250 HP

Guide.title: [Q]: Ultimate: Sundering Blade
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sundering-blade.png)Sundering Blade
* Charging to stage 3 takes about 2.5 seconds. That is a very long time to be standing still. Make sure to use terrain or an ally barrier to survive channeling.
* Use Soaring Slice to dash into the air, then activate Ul, charge to Stage 3, and crash down from above at a choke point so the enemy doesn’t know exactly where you are coming from.
* On the ground channel around a corner or behind a barrier so you can survive long enough to charge stage 3 damage.

Guide.title: Passive: Onslaught
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/onslaught.png)Onslaught
* The buffs do not decay gradually like many other abilities. When it expires, it drops to zero instantly.

* If you stopped being able to primary slice during a fight, be ready for your attacks to be slower, or for you to suddenly not be able to chase the enemy down. If you lose the passive, don’t over-commit; it’s ok to disengage and try again.
* When you have healing resources, you can get a lot of benefit from the passive.

Guide.title: Raging Storm
content: * Vendetta’s best sustain tool. Without this perk, you have to play way more passively and disengage far sooner.
* Recommended Minor Perk

Guide.title: Extra Edge
content: * The best tip for Extra Edge is to not use it.
* In theory, you can get an extra projectile in before recharging, but this is very low impact.

Guide.title: Relentless
content: * Taking Relentless increases the Onslaught passive buffs from 25% attack speed up to 40%, and from 20% movement speed up to 32%.
* Incredibly strong when combined with Sihponning Strike, since you’ll be able to stay swinging for longer.
* Coordinate with your team because a pocketed Vendetta with full Relentless buff will feel unstoppable to the enemy team.
* Recommended Major perk

Guide.title: Siphoning Strike
content: * Decent extra AoE damage, and a bit of extra movement.
* Use if you struggle to be accurate with her primary fire and need the big swings to add consistent damage.

Guide.title: Maps
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/vendetta.png)Vendetta is an versitile hero who can adapt her playstyle to most maps. The ones she'll struggle the most on are the traditional sniper maps like Circuit Royal and Havana. When playing these maps, take the extra time needed to path around the edges of the map and outside of the LoS of ranged enemies.

Her best maps have high ground she can set up on, drop down and engage without needing to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soaring-slice.png)Soaring Slice. Most maps have some areas where she can do this but Numbani and Watchpoint: Gibraltar are prime examples.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Heroes who have a ranged protective utility such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier are the best for empowering ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/vendetta.png)Vendetta to overrun a lobby. Dive in, receive the bubble, swing, kill, get out. This powerful gameplan is very difficult for the enemy team to deal with.

Additionally, she prefers consistent ranged healing from abilities such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-rifle.png)Biotic Rifle and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-harmony.png)Orb of Harmony. When she has sustain from the team, she can take Extra Edge as her Minor Perk for increased projectile use.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: When left unchecked, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/vendetta.png)Vendetta can single-handedly win the match for her team. The best way to counter her is to play heroes with stuns such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/flashbang.png)Flashbang, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy-javelin.png)Energy Javelin. She doesn't have any direct counterplay to projectile stuns, so it's the easiest way to punish her for soaring in.
When you don't have these available, you want to play near allies who can help you fight her. Never leave yourself in a situation where she can put you into a 1v1.
Lastly, open areas away from cover are difficult for her to reach if you have the range to do so.

Guide.title: Overview
content: Looking for a hero to one-trick who can do it all? ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn has a versatile blend of close and long-range lethality, great mobility, area control, and a powerful ultimate. Her positioning isn’t set in stone either, as she can quickly adapt to the enemy team’s comp, playstyle, and positioning. Most of the time, she’ll benefit most when maintaining a medium range from the enemy. Focus on building energy for a charged shot, then finding your perfect target..

Guide.title: Playing As
content: * Charge up ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/railgun.png)Railgun energy on Tanks, then target DPS and Supports with the charged shot.

* Save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-slide.png)Power Slide to escape. Always engaging with Slide leaves you vulnerable to counterattacks.
* Sojourn has long-range and close-range capabilities, so play against your enemies' weaknesses. If they are brawlers, keep your distance. If they are snipers, get in close.

Guide.title: Playing Against
content: * Watch for charged Railgun shots. When she hasn’t fired one for a few seconds, position out of her LoS.

* When you hear ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overclock.png)Overclock, find cover and hide. On occasions where that isn’t possible, immediately focus her.
* After she uses Power Slide, quickly dive her. She won’t be able to escape and likely has low Railgun charge.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Great at securing kills
* Hybrid sniper
* Game winning Ultimate
* Headshot damage Ultimate
* Cooldowns
* Feast or famine

Guide.title: Securing final blows
content: Rail’s charged shot is arguably the best ability in OW2 for confirming elims. Anytime an enemy gets low on health, Sojourn can instantly finish them off if she saved Railgun. She can patiently spam primary fire while waiting for the perfect secondary fire shot and target.

Guide.title: Hybrid Sniper
content: Unlike the other hitscan snipers, Sojourn has great mobility and decent poke spam. She doesn’t quite have the range of the rest of the snipers, but in most scenarios, her lethal range is more than sufficient.

Guide.title: Game-winning Ultimate
content: Whether you’re watching the OWCS or playing in ranked, there’s no doubt you’ve seen a Sojourn wipe the entire team with one use of her ult. Overclock is always a huge threat to the enemy team, especially when combined with another ult like Nano Boost or Graviton Surge.

Guide.title: Need to headshot during ult
content: One of the aspects of Sojourns kit making her so strong right now is the 150% charge from her Minor Perk. Headshots during her ult one-shot all 250 HP heroes. If you aren’t hitting those consistently, her ult will feel underwhelming.

Guide.title: Cooldown dependant
content: When Power Slide is on cooldown and she doesn’t have a charged Railgun, Sojourn becomes very weak. Misusing either of these abilities leads to wasting time at best, and often leads to an early death.

Guide.title: Feast or famine
content: Sojourn players are either a hard carry or a heavy burden on their team. Either you are getting consistent kills with charged Railgun shots, or you should be playing a dependable hero like Cassidy or Soldier: 76. Oftentimes, you’ll see a Sojourn player have one huge play where they single-handedly win the fight, only to be feeding the rest of the game.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Railgun
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/railgun.png)Railgun
* How to build charge
* * Critical hits = 10 energy
* body shots = 5 energy
* Damage to deployables = 1 energy
* Target prioritization
* * When the enemy team positions with the Tank way up front, and the rest of their team sitting back, stay as hidden as possible and build charge off of the Tank.
* If a barrier is protecting all your targets, shoot the barrier until a target opens up.
* Against brawl comps, shoot whoever is closest or most threatening to you.
* Bullet spread
* * Shooting more than 12 bullets in a row kicks in severe bullet spread.
* When shooting targets farther than 20m away, take a full second pause between bursts to keep your bullet spread tight.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Railgun (Charged shot)
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/railgun.png)Railgun **(Charged shot)**
* Most important ability
* Target DPS and Supports
* * An instant 180 damage on a 250 or 225 HP hero puts them into immediate threat of death. That same damage on a 700 HP Tank hurts, but doesn’t halt their attack.
* A fully charged body shot on a squishy has more impact than a critical hit on a Tank.
* Look for low HP enemies
* * Because of the range and damage of charged Railgun shots, Sojourn excels at eliminating enemies at critical health.
* Enemies at low health are number one on your priority list. Even if the shot is difficult, go for it.
* Hold onto charge
* * Wait for a good shot. If there isn’t a clear shot on a DPS or Support, and the Tank is at full health, just hold your charged shot.
* There is a long 9-second window before charge decay sets in. This resets every time you build charge from landing a single shot.
* Against snipers, this principle is twice as important. No need to get hasty with peeking corners when you already have full charge.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Power Slide
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-slide.png)Power Slide
* Engage
* * Quickly jump on your target or into position for a charged shot and Disruptor. You can often catch enemies off guard when sliding around a corner.
* Be patient

* * Eight seconds is a good amount of time to not be able to reposition in Overwatch. If you use Slide to move just because you don’t want to spend an extra 2 seconds walking, you won’t have Slide when you actually need it.
* Escape
* * Watch the enemy team and predict what they want to do. Understand that whenever they have rush or dive heroes, they’re going to suddenly approach and attack you.
* Be sure to save Power Slide to jump away and dodge their attack.
* High ground
* * Before every fight and during most, you’re going to want to super jump onto the high ground. Use the raised floor as cover to hide behind and change up your positioning and timing.
* Many enemies struggle to attack you on high ground, so it’s almost always safer.
* Super Jump
* * Jump, Power Slide, and immediately jump again to cancel Slide’s forward momentum and gain extra vertical height.

Guide.title: [E]: Disruptor Shot
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/disruptor-shot.png)Disruptor Shot
* Choke points

* * The easiest way to generate a lot of ult charge is to stick Disruptor Shot onto the floor or door of a choke point as the enemy is walking through it. They’ll typically be more grouped up and likely to take damage.
* Use to separate
* * Stick Disruptor between two enemies when you want to isolate one from the other.
* Example: The enemy Tank is walking forward, stick Disruptor in front of their allies following behind them to prevent them from moving up with the Tank.
* Notably easier when above your target, shooting downwards.
* Cut off escapes

* * Anytime you hit a charged Rail shot and get an enemy low, assume they will try to get behind cover unless they have a self-healing ability. Shoot Disruptor to the place they are trying to retreat to, and you’ll either force them to stay out in the open or finish them off with Disruptor's damage.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Overclock
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overclock.png)Overclock
* Don’t overcommit
* * The worst thing you can do with your ult is to Powerslide out in front of your whole team and die instantly. Stay where you have some form of protection, whether that is natural cover or a Tank.
* Wait for team aggression

* * Using Overclock when your team is still passively poking the enemy will hinder its potential. Wait until your team is already committing to the fight and exchanging cooldowns before activating your ult.
* Doing so gives you the best odds of success as the enemy will have fewer resources to counter you, and more of their attention will be taken up by your teammates.
* Ask for a pocket

* * Get in VC and ask for a Support to pocket you during your ult, or at least ping “My ultimate is ready.” The constant healing from a Support enables you to position yourself more forward, take more damage, and keep shooting your charged shots.

Guide.title: Deceleration Field
content: * Best Minor Perk
* One-shot 250 HP heroes
* * A 150% charged shot deals 255 damage on a critical hit. Since the majority of the roster falls within this threshold, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to delete heads.
* Primary fire between shots
* * Don’t forget to spam primary fire to generate charge faster and get off as many secondary fire shots as possible during your ult’s duration.

Guide.title: Overcharged
content: * Best Minor Perk
* One-shot 250 HP heroes
* * A 150% charged shot deals 255 damage on a critical hit. Since the majority of the roster falls within this threshold, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to delete heads.
* Primary fire between shots
* * Don’t forget to spam primary fire to generate charge faster and get off as many secondary fire shots as possible during your ult’s duration.

Guide.title: Dual Thrusters
content: * Best Major Perk
* * Yes, you sacrifice a bit of vertical height, but getting a 2nd charge of Power Slide is incredibly powerful.
* New movement options

* * Normally, we urge great caution when engaging with Power Slide. With Dual Thrusters, however, you are free to go in deep with your first Slide, since you retain the option of disengaing with the second slide.
* Good for anti-dive
* * Being able to double slide raises Sojourn’s survivability by making her more difficult to catch and kill.
* The window of vulnerability where she has no slide is effectively cut in half, and harder for the enemy to track.
**Adhesive Siphon**
* Weaker Major Perk
* Damage is cut in half
* * Adhesive Disruptor only deals about 150 damage maximum. Even if you stick a target, you’ll also need to land a lot of extra damage if you want to elim.
* Rail and ult charge
* * The ability to stick Disruptor to an enemy boosts its consistency in dealing damage. Plus if the stuck target is close to other enemies, you get the AoE damage as well.
* Consequently, you’ll be generating both Rail and ult charge faster.
* A stuck target generates 36 energy for Railgun.
* Wait for an easy target
* * 15-second cooldowns need to be used carefully. Wait until you see an easy shot before haphazardly blasting away.

Guide.title: Maps
content: Sojourn’s versatility allows her to be played effectively on every map. That said, she performs best on maps with high ground, her Slide jump reaches. Also, medium range sight lines are best for her since her damage fall off begins at 40m. The maps that hinder her capabilities the most are those that don’t give her enough room to slide around and maintain that ideal mid-range fight distance. Additionally, if the map’s high ground is too tall, her Slide becomes much less useful, and she’s at a disadvantage compared to the heroes whose mobility allows them to take those vertical positions.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn DPS heroes in _Overwatch_. No matter what team composition she is paired with, she can find a way to provide value. There isn't really a team archetype that Sojourn simply will not work with.

Guide.title: Tanks and Positioning
content: Her best team comps are built around enabling her to play aggressively and carry through fully charged Railgun shots and Overclock. Tanks with barriers to play behind, such as![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina or![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, make it safer for her to hold the frontline. While she can work with dive tanks like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist, she benefits most from the stable positioning that anchor tanks provide.

Guide.title: DPS Pairings
content: DPS who can draw attention away from her angles by flanking (like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji) are excellent pairings. Alternatively, defensive heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/torbjorn.png)Torbjörn are great for protecting her against dive threats and making her even more difficult to eliminate.

Guide.title: Support Synergy
content: For Supports, the optimal choice is often![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy to pocket her with damage boost. However, keep in mind that this requires investing 40% of your five-player team into making Sojourn lethal. As a result, she must pop off immediately, or her team is at a major disadvantage.

Other strong choices include any Support who can offer assistance through ranged healing or offensive buffs, such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nano-boost.png)Nano Boost during an Overclock ultimate.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Watch for charged Railgun shots. When she hasn’t fired one for a few seconds, position out of her LoS.
When you hear Overclock, find cover and hide. On occasions where that isn’t possible, immediately focus her.
After she uses Power Slide, quickly dive her. She won’t be able to escape and likely has low Railgun charge.

Guide.title: Overview
content: The ninjutsu master of the Shimada clan, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko, fights swiftly for peace and against injustice. She’s a well-rounded, versatile Support who provides both defensive and offensive support.

When teamfights get scrambly, and it's every player for themselves, Kiri survives and thrives in the chaos. Her mobility enables her to quickly reposition to escape danger or help an ally secure elims. Generally, she’ll position herself as the mid-line to ensure she’s always within Swift Step and lock-on healing range.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Play within ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/swift-step.png)Swift Step and Healing Ofuda lock-on range at all times so you can quickly save allies or escape danger without overcommitting.

* Rotate between healing and Kunai pressure to build ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush quickly while still threatening enemy backliners with headshots.

* Save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu for high-impact debuffs or lethal moments rather than using it purely for healing value.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Force out ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/swift-step.png)Swift Step or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu early, then re-engage while those cooldowns are unavailable.
* Pressure her from multiple angles to deny safe teleport targets and limit her escape options.

* Treat ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush like the best offensive ult the enemy team has. Save defensive utility to survive, retreat when possible, or use your own ultimates to prevent her from overwhelming your team.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Auto-tracking healing
* Good survivability
* Strong Ultimate
* Slow projectiles
* Weak vs tanks
* Difficult to use primary fire

Guide.title: Auto-tracking healing
content: No matter your skill level, everyone misses shots. Kiri never has to worry about that with her forgiving lock-on hitbox. Once locked on, the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda will even chase allies around corners. Comes especially in handy with small and mobile teammates.

Guide.title: High survivability
content: Supports are often the first players targeted by the enemy team. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko is one of the most difficult Supports to eliminate because she has so many survival tools. Kunai counts as well since it poses a decent threat to attackers.

Guide.title: Fight-winning Support Ultimate
content: Most Support ults need to be comboed with a Tank or DPS ult to win a fight. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush empowers the whole team and is often enough of an advantage all on its own to win the teamfight.

Guide.title: Slow healing projectile and limited lock-on range
content: The farther away an ally gets from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko, the more noticeable her slow healing becomes. At max lock-on range, the healing can arrive too late to save them. Additionally, compared to a lot of other Supports, Healing Ofuda’s Lock on range is very limited so Kiri falls behind in ranged capabilities.

Guide.title: Weak into barrier Tanks
content: Barriers block both ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kunai.png)Kunai and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda. If a Barrier is between Kiri and her allies, Kunai deals far too little damage to destroy it. She needs to take the extra time to constantly reposition and play around barriers.

Guide.title: Difficult to use primary fire
content: The slow travel speed, rate of fire, and low damage of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kunai.png)Kunai hinder Kiri’s offensive prowess. Landing headshots brings big value but is very inconsistent, even for the best aimers.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Healing Ofuda
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda
* Focus on mobile allies
* * When your team has highly mobile heroes like Genji, Tracer or Doomfist, be sure to prioritize healing them since your other Support may struggle to consistently heal them.
* Auto-tracking range

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/swift-step.png)Swift Step and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda lock-on effects have the same 35m range. Therefore, if you see the Swift Step indicator around an ally, you know they are in range for the auto-tracking ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda.
* Always active projectile

* * Even if an ally isn’t being locked on, they will still absorb and be healed by the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofudaif they come into contact with it. This applies when teammates walk in front of one another or when they are outside of the lock-on range.
* Doesn’t penetrate barriers
* * Don’t forget that deployable barriers like Winston bubble or Sigma shield will block your allies from receiving your healing.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Kunai
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kunai.png)Kunai
* Kunai between healing

* * Kiri has time to fire one Kunai between every ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda without sacrificing healing output. This increases her overall damage output and ult charge generation.
* Go for headshots
* * Even though you may miss more Kunai, the burst damage from landing a single critical hit is greater than hitting two body shots in a row.
* Infinite range
* * Kiri is good at pressuring the enemy backline because she has no falloff damage. Try shooting a few shots at the enemy Ana, Ashe, Zen, and other heroes who sit far behind their team.

Guide.title: [Shift]: Swift Step
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/swift-step.png)Swift Step
* Keep track of ally positions

* * If you don’t know where an in-range ally is positioned, you won’t be able to quickly use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/swift-step.png)Swift Step when being attacked. Be sure to know where and if any teammates are in range.
* Teleport to safety
* * 99% of the time, you’ll want to TP to where enemies are not able to attack you so that you’re more likely to survive until your next Swift Step

Guide.title: [E]: Protection Suzu
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu
* Save when the enemy team has debuffs or negative effects

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana Anti-Nade, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen wounds & anti, and Ashe or Mauga burning, are all examples of abilities worth using Suzu on.

* If Junker Queen sees you use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu just for healing, she knows she can get an easy team wipe with her ultimate Carnage.
* Swift Step Suzu combo

* * When a teammate is outside of your LoS or behind a wall, AND you have ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu available, you can TP to them and save them with Suzu and healing.

* Doesn’t cleanse certain abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/charge.png)Charge or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter, but the brief invincibility will prevent them if timed perfectly.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Kitsune Rush
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush
* Memorize Kitsune Counters

* * Aside from healing Support ults like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence, be cautious of AoE ults like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tectonic-shock.png)Tectonic Shock, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/molten-core.png)Molten Core, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/self-destruct.png)Self-Destruct, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/downpour.png)Downpour, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonstrike.png)Dragonstrike, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter. Ults like these will either hit your whole team, or force everyone to leave ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush's AoE
* Kitsune alone or combo?

* * If your team has ults like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tactical-visor.png)Tactical Visor or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonblade.png)Dragonblade, save your ult to combo with your allies. Doing so greatly increases the power of both ults.
* If your team doesn’t have a specific combo, then use Kitsune on its own as it can easily be a one-ult fight win if the enemy doesn’t have counter ults available.

Guide.title: (Passive): Wall Climb
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/wall-climb.png)Wall Climb
* Get LoS without committing
* * Instead of using Swift Step to assist a teammate behind a wall, Kiri can climb and shoot or throw Suzu over the wall, then immediately fall back behind cover.
* Additional survival tool

* * When combined and rotated with Suzu and Swift Step, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/wall-climb.png)Wall Climb makes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko extremely evasive. Most enemies aren’t going to be able to chase you if you climb up and over a wall.

Guide.title: Urgent Care
content: _“Healing Ofuda projectile speed is increased by 50% when seeking critical health allies.”_
* Take if you’ve already noticed your team demanding a lot of healing.
* * Receiving healing sooner when at critical health can mean the difference between life or death for your ally. The farther they are from you, the greater benefit the Perk gives.

Guide.title: Fortune Teller
content: _“Kunai hits launch 2 Healing Ofuda to an ally in front of you.”_
* Free healing when attacking
* * If you are able to be aggressive and attack frequently, Fortune Teller is the better Perk to take.

* With the Fortune teller perk, it's worth shooting two Kunai between every ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda. For a slight delay in primary fire, she has the chance to deal damage and increase healing potential from the extra 2 Ofudas per hit.

Guide.title: Ready Step
content: _“Swift Step grants Kiriko 40% increased attack and reload speed for 3 seconds."_
* When selecting Ready Step, your dives become more lethal. Wait to TP to your ally until they need assistance with an elimination.

* Be smart. Just because you get buffed offense, doesn't mean you should always TP aggressively. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/swift-step.png)Swift Step is you best escape tool, so if you TP into multiple enemies, you likely won't escape.

Guide.title: Foxtrot
content: _“Protection Suzu grants 30% movement speed to allies for 4 seconds.”_
* 30% movement speed is really strong, especially on heroes who need to stay close to deal optimal damage.

* * For example, when playing with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt the movement speed allows him to chase down squishies that would otherwise be just barely outside his range.

* Better disengage. Faster movement speed enables you and your allies to escape more effectively when using![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu defensively.

Guide.title: Maps
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko's mobility and versatility make her a solid choice on every map. But because she can climb and teleport through walls, maps with lots of structures or rooms give her more outplay potential. Long sight lines are good for her Kunai, but bad for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda if her allies get too far away from her. Be mindful of the map area you are in and adjust accordingly. Just make sure to always be within lock-on and Swift Step range to your team.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko has great self-survivability, range, and movement. These qualities mean she pairs best with rush and dive comps, but her versatile kit will allow her to find value in every team comp.

Tanks that want to position and move aggressively are good choices. Especially those without barriers or an absorption to block status effects like anti-![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade. For example, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga benefits greatly from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko because he has no way to block such abilities, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush paired with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cage-fight.png)Cage Fight is a deadly combo.

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko pairs best with mid and frontline DPS. Thanks to her ranged healing and damage, she wants to always face forward and constantly spam, and never have to turn around. Snipers are her worst pairings since she needs to turn away from the main action to peel for snipers.

She can be played as the primary source of sustain, or focus more on utility. Historically, her best pairing has been ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio because they both are able to play hyper-aggressively, survive without relying on the other, and synergize with the same team comps.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Force out ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/swift-step.png)Swift Step or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu early, then re-engage while those cooldowns are unavailable.
Pressure her from multiple angles to deny safe teleport targets and limit her escape options.

Treat ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush like the best offensive ult the enemy team has. Save defensive utility to survive, retreat when possible, or use your own ultimates to prevent her from overwhelming your team.

Guide.title: Lucio Overview
content: Using his sound waves and beats to inspire his allies, Lucio skates across maps while bringing his team along for the ride. Positioning and mobility are extremely important in Overwatch 2 and Lucio helps his whole team with both.
Although he doesn’t bring a lot of sustain, increasing the movement speed of his team gives them the advantage in deciding when and where to take fights.

He spends most of his time close to his Tank, but Lucio can also be a deadly backline assassin thanks to his wall riding. Master Amp it up timing and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soundwave.png)Soundwave usage, and you’ll be well on your way to carrying your team with this underground DJ!

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Speed in your Tank. If your Tank is a brawl style Tank, speed boost enables them to close the gap on the enemy and run them over.

* Keep your allies in your aura. The indicator in the center of your screen tells you how many allies are being affected by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/crossfade.png)Crossfade. Make sure to keep that number high.
* Protect your backline. Lucio’s speed and knockback allow him to be a great protector of his backline from enemy flanks and dives. Speed over and help with a counterattack.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Knockback or stun him. Anything that stops or slows his momentum makes Lucio easier to eliminate.

* When you see Lucio use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier try to disengage from the fight and wait out the overhealth instead of trying to fight through it.
* If you keep getting run over by Lucio’s team, pick heroes with good mobility. Their speed won’t matter if you can escape their attack.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Opportunist
* AoE abilities
* Doesn't need a lot of resources
* Hard to play
* Needs good team coordination
* Close ranged

Guide.title: Opportunist
content: With unmatched speed, Lucio can quickly react and move. Good Lucio players often wait for opportune moments, such as seeing the enemy use their defensive cooldowns, then speed boost themselves and their team in for the kill.

Guide.title: Large AoE abilities
content: Unlike many other Supports who can only assist one ally at a time, Lucio’s abilities can affect his entire team at once. Healing, speed boost, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier all have generous AoE and get huge value when his team is all playing grouped up.

Guide.title: Low demand for team resources
content: Riding vertically on walls, moving quickly and constantly changing up his positioning makes Lucio difficult for the enemy to target. Because of this, he doesn’t demand healing, damage mitigation, or protection resources from his team. The rest of his team can worry about themselves and use their abilities more offensively when Lucio is their Support.

Guide.title: High skill ceiling
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/wall-ride.png)Wall Ride forward, backwards, in place, through windows, rollouts, and jump spots give Lucio nearly unlimited hero-specific tech. To maximize your Lucio play, you must dedicate many hours to fine-tuning your movement mechanics. He’s easy to pick up, but difficult to master.

Guide.title: Needs team coordination
content: You’re probably not a Reddit Lucio who can go off on their own and solo kill the entire enemy team one by one. So instead, you’re going to need your team to work as a unit to succeed. It doesn’t matter how good your timing is if no one moves in to attack during Amp it Up speed boost.

Guide.title: Close range LoS
content: Lucio can’t assist his team unless he’s within the 12m radius of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/crossfade.png)Crossfade and there are no barriers or structures in his way. To maximize the value of his song aura, he needs to be positioned near his allies. Since the Tank typically needs speed boost the most, this means Lucio ends up front and in the open, where the enemy team can target him.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Sonic Amplifier
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sonic-amplifier.png)Sonic Amplifier
* Destroy deployables
* * Lucio's range and speed make him better than most at getting into position to destroy deployables like Sym and Torb turrets, Immortality Field, and Healing Pylon.
* Keep moving while poking
* * Never stand still or stay grounded for long. Even when you are focusing on spamming the enemy team, be careful not to make yourself an easy target.
* Hitscans have the upper hand and more consistent damage in ranged fights.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Soundwave
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soundwave.png)Soundwave
* Get off me

* * Most of the time, you’ll want to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soundwave.png)Soundwave's knockback to keep the enemy away from you and your allies. Especially against close-range and melee heroes, boop them away.
* Spam

* * A Five-second cooldown is very short. You can generally use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soundwave.png)Soundwave off cooldown. Unless you need to save for a specific reason, like an environmental kill, or booping away an enemy ult like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/death-blossom.png)Death Blossom.
* Environmental kills

* * The best feeling is knocking people off the map with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soundwave.png)Soundwave. On maps with edges near the objective, a hole in the middle like Ilios Well, always be on the lookout for enemies standing too close to the edge.
* Combos
* * Against walls or while diving with speed boost, Lucio has good burst damage combos. If you are moving too slow, or the enemy doesn’t have a wall behind them, the melee cancel will miss.

* The knockback of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/soundwave.png)Soundwave also makes tracking easier as it briefly locks the enemy's movement.
* Primary fire → Soundwave → melee

Guide.title: [SPACE]: Wall Ride
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/wall-ride.png)Wall Ride
* Wall ride as much as possible
* * Lucio moves much faster while wall riding, and the verticality sets him above the standard horizontal plane where most enemies are aiming.
* Rollouts
* * Very map-specific, but it's a good idea to pay attention to paths where you can jump from wall to wall on your way from spawn to the objective in case you die.
* Bunny hop
* * If you jump right as you touch the ground, Lucio keeps some momentum for a few jumps.
* Useful for maintaining speed while transferring from one wall to another.
* Stall objectives

* * Any objective with walls, windows, or a center column are good for Lucio ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/wall-ride.png)Wall Ride around when waiting for his team to respawn.
* Ride in circles, in and out of windows, behind and in front of structures, and be as evasive as possible.
* Settings
* * PC players. Binding the scroll wheel to jump makes wall jumps and bunny hopping easier.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Crossfade
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/crossfade.png)Crossfade
* Watch your ally indicator
* * The number in the center of your screen under your crosshairs shows how many allies are being affected by your healing or speed.
* You don’t need to look around, you can focus on attacking while also making sure to keep in position near enough to keep your allies in your sound aura.
* Speed or healing?
* * Use healing aura any time your team needs health, or when you want to build Ult charge faster.
* Use speed boost whenever your team is trying to get close to the enemy or reposition quickly.
* When most of your team is near full health, feel free to stay on speed boost.

Guide.title: [E]: Amp it Up
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/amp-it-up.png)Amp It Up
* Heal Amp

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/amp-it-up.png)Amp It Up healing is over 4x’s faster than standard healing. If your team gets to critical health, quickly use Amp it Up healing.
* Speed Amp

* * In brawl and rush comps, you’ll want to primarily save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/amp-it-up.png)Amp It Up for speed boost. The most important thing with Tanks like Junker Queen, Ram, and Rein is not giving them a bit of healing to live longer. They just need to get close to the enemy and win the fight quickly.
* Run away
* * When the enemy uses an offensive ultimate, speed Amp your team away from the enemy so they can get behind cover and survive. Then speed them back into the fight once the danger has passed.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Sound Barrier
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier
* Use reactively

* * Sometimes Lucios will try to start fights with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier to allow their team to push in without fear of dying. Typically, this brings much less value to your team and also leaves you defenseless when the enemy attacks with their ultimates.

* Better to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier in reaction to enemy ultimates. The overhealth is enough to survive most attacks.
* Cast time

* * Be mindful of your height when using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier. The higher Lucio is, the longer it takes for the ult to activate.

* Enemies can cancel your ult if they stun you before hitting the ground. Watch for enemies with stun abilities, or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier behind cover.

Guide.title: Soundwave Rider
content: * Stack Amp it Up uses
* * Use Amp it up before ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier to maximize your benefit of Beat Drop.
* Amp it up lasts 6 seconds, and Amp it Up’s cooldown is 12 seconds. At most, you’ll only have to wait 6 seconds before another Amp it Up is available.

Guide.title: Beat Drop
content: * Stack Amp it Up uses
* * Use Amp it up before ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier to maximize your benefit of Beat Drop.
* Amp it up lasts 6 seconds, and Amp it Up’s cooldown is 12 seconds. At most, you’ll only have to wait 6 seconds before another Amp it Up is available.

Guide.title: Noise Violation
content: * Good in teams that are more spread out. If your team is running a lot of poke heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja, you’ll be more likely to get them all in your AoE with Noise Violation.
* Lucio’s playstyle and positioning caters to allies who need speed boost the most already, so the extra Amp range isn’t really necessary.

Guide.title: Accelerando
content: * Better for aggressive Lucio players
* * When you solo or team speed into the enemy team, 50% attack speed can be the difference between getting an elim or your target surviving long enough to kill you.
* If you try for a lot of aggressive plays, or dive the enemy DPS and Supports, you should be running Accelerando.

Guide.title: Maps
content: The best maps to pick Lucio on are those with lots of flat ground or a lot of space to cover. The team with Lucio will always be able to move and reposition faster than the team without, so maps with a lot of area to walk give more opportunity to benefit from the speed boost.
Also, maps with ledges near the objective create to possibility of instant kills by booping them off the map.

The maps where he struggles the most are those with long, narrow sight lines where the enemy has more time to attack him during his approach. Lucio himself does well on maps with strong high ground areas, but the teammates who benefit the most from speed boost tend to be weaker on those maps.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Team comps built around Lucio are equipped to take full advantage of his speed boost. Close range and melee heroes generally receive the most benefit from speed boost because they depend on getting close to the enemy to be effective.
Poke heavy comps can work with Lucio as well, but his speed will be used more often for defensive spacing and rotations instead of offensive approaches.

Lucio typically needs another Support with high healing output and burst healing capabilities to make up for his lack of sustain. In these teams, Lucio also functions as a backline protector by using his quick movement and knockback to keep his allies safe from enemy flankers.
**Example of a team comp built around Lucio:**

* Tank: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya (6v6)

* DPS: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei
* Supports: Lucio, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira

Guide.title: Individual synergies with other heroes
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt

* When ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt starts swinging on an enemy, they’re done if they can't immediately escape. Rein’s biggest weakness is his short melee range, and Charge being his only movement ability.

* Lucio’s speed enables Rein to quickly get into melee range and overtake the enemy. With Amp it Up he can even shield walk faster than the enemy can walk away. Coordinate Amp it Up when Rein has the health to keep swinging, and you'll have some easy classic wins.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy is a mid-range hitscan with a great anti-dive kit. Lucio's poke and speed combined with Cassidy's damage output make them a lethal duo who oppress the enemy with ranged damage while simultaneously having high survivability.

* Lucio helps peel for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy when he's getting overwhelmed by the enemy team, and Cassidy does the same for Lucio.
* Additionally, a speed-boosted Deadeye is very hard to deal with because of how fast Cassidy moves around. They completely control sight lines and force the enemy to retreat.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira and Lucio’s AoE healing make them the perfect brawl Support duo. Teams that play grouped up will constantly be healed, and can move around as an unstoppable deathball.
* Moira's healing is high enough that Lucio can also go on occasional flanks when the opportunity presents itself.
* Neither Support needs to waste their resources peeling for the other because they both have high self-survivability. This allows them to focus on enabling the rest of their allies.

Guide.title: How to Counter Lucio
content: Knockback or stun him. Anything that stops or slows his momentum makes Lucio easier to eliminate.

When you see Lucio use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier try to disengage from the fight and wait out the overhealth instead of trying to fight through it.
If you keep getting run over by Lucio’s team, pick heroes with good mobility. Their speed won’t matter if you can escape their attack.

Guide.title: Overview
content: Harnessing the power of the Sun to deal damage to her enemies and heal her allies makes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari one of the most deadly offensive Supports in Overwatch. Her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/solar-rifle.png)Solar Rifle seamlessly swaps between damage and healing mode, allowing for quick adjustments from one moment to the next. Among the Support cast, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari has one of the most mechanically demanding kits because the true power of her kit lies in landing critical hits. Players whose forte is clicking heads often pick up ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari and quickly start carrying games.

Her place in the meta tends to always be niche and heavily depends on map and team composition. Her poke presence is really strong, but she lacks consistent healing output compared to other supports. Make sure to place Pylon where it can’t be shot by the enemy but can still heal your team, and you’ll be set for success.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Focus on keeping up your damage output. If you aren’t applying a lot of offensive pressure, playing a different Support would be better.

* Place ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon behind walls where it is hidden from the enemy team. Only move it when your whole team is repositioning.
* Use your ult to target enemies that your allies are already attacking. That way, they can quickly trigger the Sunstruck explosion.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari has great ranged damage, but struggles with close-range duels. Try to avoid her LoS until you can catch her in a close-range fight.

* Teams with Illari are at a disadvantage in longer fights that require a lot of sustain. Play patient and only commit to the attack after she’s lost her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon and used up her Solar Energy.
* When you hear her ult voice line, prepare your countermeasures. Shoot her out of the sky, block the projectile, stun her before she fires, or escape out of her LoS.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Good poke
* Passive healing
* Knockback
* Poor close-range
* Limited healing
* Easy to counter Ultimate

Guide.title: High poke damage
content: The long range and high damage of her primary fire make ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari feel more like a DPS hero who just so happens to be able to heal her allies as well. Oftentimes in OW2, burst damage ends up being the most valuable ability any hero can possess. Landing critical hits with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari forces the enemy to either start playing out of her LoS where they struggle to get value, or ego duel to the death.

Guide.title: Passive healing ability
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon is a really strong healing ability. The deployable can be positioned near your team and auto-heals everyone within its range. The automated healing frees up ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari to focus on clicking heads or use her healing beam to give a quick burst of health to a low-health ally.

Guide.title: Knockback movement ability
content: Heroes with the ability to simultaneously CC their enemy and reposition themselves possess an advantage against close-range enemies.
