Outburst can be used for quick vertical or horizontal movement for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari, or can be used to boop away the enemy out of position. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari wants to maintain distance from her enemies to take advantage of her ranged power, so Outburst is a great tool to keep that distance.

Guide.title: Poor close-range performance
content: When paired with teammates who want to play in close range to the enemy team, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari can struggle to keep up. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon benefits from teams holding positions for extended periods and staying within its range. Her slow rate of fire can also make dueling at close range very challenging and typically puts her at a disadvantage.

Guide.title: Limited healing
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon only has 125 total HP, making it easy to break if spotted. When an enemy does break the Pylon, its cooldown doubles to 14 seconds. That is a long time for her team to rely solely on Solar Rifle's healing. Even when up, she can only heal a single target and has a very limited healing resource from Solar Rifle.

Guide.title: Ultimate easily countered
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/captive-sun.png)Captive Sun can either feel like a massive fight-winning ult, or completely useless. First, Illari’s voice line alerts everyone she’s ulting, then she flies up into the air at a slightly fast speed that’s not too hard to track. Finally, she only has a 5-second window to fire the projectile. During this time, her enemies can prepare their countermeasures, which can vary from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu, to a simple phase ability to self-cleanse.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Solar Rifle
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/solar-rifle.png)Solar Rifle
* Prioritize offense

* * The purpose of playing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari over other Supports is to take advantage of her range and poke damage. Look to spend as much time as possible attacking the enemy team with your primary fire.
* Jiggle Peek
* * It takes just over a full second to prep a max-charged shot. Between firing, get behind cover, and peek out in the open just before firing to line up your shot, and get back behind cover.

* Jiggle peeking is crucial for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari to minimize damage taken while maximizing the time she can spend attacking.
* Charge and Ammo management

* * Unlike other charge abilities, such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston's or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's right-clicks, Illari’s charge does not affect her ammo usage.
* To maximize damage output, full charge every shot.
* Break points
* * Within 30m range, 2 headshots + 1 body shot is needed to eliminate 250HP and 275HP heroes.

Guide.title: Secondary fire: Solar Rifle (Healing Beam)
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/solar-rifle.png)Solar Rifle
* Resource management
* * Try to never fully deplete the Solar Energy resource because it adds a 3.36-second additional cooldown before you can use the ability again.
* Heal enough to stop your ally from dying, then pause and let the resources refill for another burst of healing.
* Burst healing

* * Of all the Supports, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari has the highest healing per second outside of ults. She is limited by the downtime of her healing beam and Pylon, and by having no AoE healing

* Generally, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari wants her other Support to keep the Tank up, because her burst healing gets more value on DPS and Supports.

Guide.title: [E]: Healing Pylon: Deploy a pylon that heals allies
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon
* Enable Flanks

* * As long as she’s paired with another Support that can keep the rest of the team alive (e.g., Baptiste), ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari can go on a flank angle by herself and use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon to keep herself up while creating multiple angles of attack for the enemy to try and defend against.
* Pylon targeting
* * Pylon beam automatically targets the ally with the lowest health in its range.
* Hide the Pylon

* * Normally, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon’s 7-second non-combat cooldown begins as soon as it is deployed. However, if it is taking damage or gets destroyed, the cooldown doubles to 14 seconds.
* Therefore, placing the Pylon out of enemy LoS and where they will have difficulty targeting it is of the utmost importance.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Outburst
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/outburst.png)Outburst
* Escape tool

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari's ideal fighting range is around 20-30m. The closer most enemies get to her, the greater their advantage becomes. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/outburst.png)Outburst helps Illari to get enemies off of her, so she can kill or escape.
* Against flankers and dive enemies, always save Outburst for defensive escapes and avoid trying to use it offensively. Otherwise, you’ll get caught and be an easy kill.
* How to control Outburst movement
* * Holding SHIFT gives ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari more vertical height.
* Tapping SHIFT gives ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari faster horizontal movement.
* Bunny hop: Without jumping, tap SHIFT, then hold jump before hitting the ground to carry your momentum forward.

* Highest Vertical movement: From neutral (no directional input), jump (hold), activate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/outburst.png)Outburst, and continue holding jump.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Captive Sun
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/captive-sun.png)Captive Sun
* When to NOT use Captive Sun
* * Try to avoid using it to begin a fight, as the enemy team will typically have the resources to survive the ult.
* Don’t use when you haven’t seen counter abilities recently used.

* * Ex: An enemy like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va has boosters and DM available, or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko has ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu to cleanse.
* When to use Captive Sun
* * Your allies have pushed deep into the enemy team and are on their backline. They will have a higher chance of triggering Sunstruck when they are already in an attacking position.
* Once both teams have begun dumping resources, Support cooldowns, and defensive ults.
* Triggering Sunstruck
* * Two body shots or one headshot will trigger Sunstruck.
* A combined 90 damage from anyone on your team will trigger the effect.
* How to survive your own ult
* * Utilize environmental cover during the flight stage to avoid being picked out of the sky by hitscan enemies.
* Plan your exit path. Always look for where you can land after firing the projectile that puts you in a strong yet safe position to trigger the Sunstruck explosion during the slow effect.

Guide.title: Rapid Construction
content: * Increase Pylon Uptime

* * As previously stated, the biggest weakness of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari and her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon is how much downtime there is between uses. The CD reduction has a more notable effect when replacing the Pylon without taking damage, but it's always helpful.
* Better at saving allies

* * The faster construction time allows ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari to deploy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon near an ally in danger and begin granting healing significantly faster. Against dive comps, Rapid Construction is the better Minor Perk.

Guide.title: Summer Solstice
content: * Makes outplaying your ult more difficult
* * The extra flight time and speed make it harder for the enemy to avoid your ult and makes your fire timing more unpredictable.
* Against comps with a lot of Captive Sun Counters, you should take Summer Solstice.

Guide.title: Solar Flare
content: * Great for adding burst and AoE healing to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari's kit, which is one of her main weaknesses for sustain.
* It can be activated as long as the energy resource is not completely depleted.
* Recommended Perk, unless the enemy team is hard-focusing you on dives.

Guide.title: Sunburn
content: * Anti-dive

* * The main strength of Outburst is the distance it creates between ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari and her attackers. The extra damage over time will help her win 1v1 duels.

* Most effective when you are being sustained by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon because the burning damage is only ~23 damage /second, so you'll need to stay alive long enough to benefit.

Guide.title: Circuit Royal
content: * * Every point and area of Circuit Royal have the perfect sight lines for Illari’s rifle. Most areas of the map also feature areas where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari can stick a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon behind some cover where the enemy has difficulty destroying it. On first point defense, the high ground bridge area is really strong for Illari to set up with other poke heroes.

Guide.title: Blizzard World
content: * * The first two points of Blizzard World provide multiple angles for Illari to set up around cover on both offense and defense. Her damage potential on these areas are really hard for enemy teams to deal with. Moreover, every high ground area on this map can be accessed by Outburst allowing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari to reposition to her heart's content.

Guide.title: Midtown
content: * * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari can always find value on Midtown. The map layout causes fights to almost always occur within her optimal range. On defense, she has multiple options for where to set up her position. When attacking, team fights usually halt at the same few locations giving her the opportunity to keep redeploying ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon within range of herself and her allies.

Guide.title: Watchpoint Gibraltar
content: * * On Watchpoint Gibraltar, the high ground areas are really strong positions and are too high for Outburst to reach. Dive comps often dominate this map and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari doesn’t pair well with them, and struggles to stay alive against a good dive comp.

Guide.title: Lijiang Tower
content: * * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari can position herself and her pylon on the outskirts of the control points, but it's difficult for her not to get overtaken on any of these positions. Lijiang Tower also favors close range and brawl team comps which Illari finds difficult to keep her team alive against.

Guide.title: Busan
content: Downtown

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari fairs ok in the open section of the map opposite of the control point. When the fighting inevitably shifts to the objective area, Illari struggles to find an effective position for both herself and for her pylon. There simply isn’t a good place to put Healing Pylon where it can heal her team and not be destroyed.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari performs best within poke team comps that are based around doing as much ranged damage as possible, and burning down the enemy team before they even have a chance to close the distance. For the other Support hero, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari benefits from having someone who can focus primarily on healing the team so she can further focus on dealing max damage. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari struggles to find value in teams with a lot of fast high mobility like dive comps. Ideally, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari can place ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon, and focus on shooting the enemies together with a DPS ally possessing strong ranged damage.
**Ideal comp built around Illari:**

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junkrat.png)Junkrat, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste

Guide.title: Individual synergies with other heroes
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma

Sigma remains the best tank for most long range and poke maps. He lacks any movement ability so it's easy for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari to keep with him and keep![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon within range. Experimental Barrier provides great cover against the enemy's poke damage for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari as well.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe

Ashe and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari want to be doing the same thing at the same time. They also both have similar effective ranges. Creating an off-angle from the rest of your team with just Illari and Ashe can carry games and make it impossible for the enemy team to avoid the barrage of incoming damage from multiple angles. If Ashe is having to duel any other long range heroes, Illari outputs super high single target healing which will make it very difficult for your Ashe to lose the fight.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste

High total healing output plus AoE healing to complement her single target healing make ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste + ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari an ideal duo. Their entire kits work well together. Illari deletes enemies with headshots through Amplification Matrix, and Baptiste can easily deal the 90 damage required to activate the Sunstruck explosion following Illari’s ult. Furthermore, Immortality Field helps make up for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari's lack of defensive abilities.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: When facing a skilled ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari player, try to find ways to use cover to stay out of her LOS. If you can get your team to play aggressively, hold W and advance on her team, that is where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari struggles to respond. Even if ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon isn’t destroyed it can only be redeployed every 6 seconds. If your team can force her team to move outside of its range, that creates a big advantage for you.

Do your best to track her secondary fire healing beam usage. If you see ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari holding down healing on her ally, you know you have a brief window of time where she won’t be able to provide any healing and that is your chance to quickly win the teamfight.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari is weak to dive in general. D.Va’s Booster cool down is half of Captive Sun making it virtually impossible to outrun D.Va. Defense Matrix alone is the hardest counter to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari since it mitigates any damage Illari can deal. D.Va also has rather easy time countering Illari’s Ult since she can fly and Defense Matrix Captive Sun pretty much anywhere she shoots it. Even if ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari lands Captive Sun, Matrix can prevent any damage that would trigger Sunstruck.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji

A good Genji can ruin Illari’s day. His mobility allows him to position and consistently destroy Healing Pylon. If ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari is positioned with some distance from her team as she often will be, Genji dives her and is at a huge advantage in the 1v1 duel because of his high mobility, Deflect, and Illari’s slow rate of fire makes it even harder to hit Genji jumping all around her. The charge timer also makes Illari’s shots more predictable and thereby easier to Deflect. Top all that off with the fact that he can Deflect Captive Sun back to your team and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari has her work cut out for her.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko

Although not as consistent, Kunai can challenge ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari's ranged damage because of its high headshot damage and lack of fall off damage. If ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari doesn’t purposely wait for Protection Suzu to be used, Captive Sun becomes completely useless since it cleanses everyone in the AoE of the debuff.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters names
content: dva
genji
kiriko

Guide.title: Overview
content: She’s a retired pro gamer and has been a staple of pro Overwatch play. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va is the mech flying Tank who specializes in constantly moving around the fight to find the strongest position. Going against a skilled ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va player feels like she’s everywhere at once, and there is nowhere you can go that she isn’t going to show up and stop you.

She can’t Tank in the traditional sense. If you try to stand firm and lock down choke points with her, you’ll soon have her mech destroyed. In many Tank matchups, her goal is to avoid the enemy Tank entirely and leave them walking around with nothing to do.

Matchup and map knowledge are particularly important for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va players as Matrix can completely take enemy abilities out of the game, but only if she’s positioning properly. Always be on the lookout for which of your teammates needs help, and abuse the short cooldowns of Boosters and Matrix to help them become playmakers.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Be reactive. Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va's mobility to respond to where and who the enemy team is attacking.

* Peel and enable. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix should be used to keep your backline alive and to protect your DPS during their attack.
* Protect yourself first. Don’t forget you need to keep yourself alive and in mech if you want to be useful to your team.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Create crossfire. Attacking ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va from multiple directions stops her from Matrixing all your team's damage.
* Stay together. Focus on keeping each other alive and forcing her to retreat. Every time she leaves close range, her value goes way down.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va has no protection against beam and melee attacks. If you’re struggling, consider swapping to counter.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Low cooldowns
* Defense
* Burst damage
* Terrible ranged damage
* Directional damage mitigation
* Zoning Ultimate

Guide.title: Low cooldown mobility
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/boosters.png)Boosters have the lowest cooldown of any Tank movement ability in OW. On top of that, they allow her to fly in any direction. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va can quickly engage and then disengage, fly to defend her team, or fly to help her team secure an elim.

Guide.title: Defense Matrix
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix, being resource-based and not health points, means she can absorb infinite damage during its duration. She’s also the only Tank who can completely absorb ultimates like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/blizzard.png)Blizzard. The power and versatility of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix make ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va the best team enabler among tanks.

Guide.title: Burst damage
content: Up close, she has great burst damage when firing her shotguns and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/micro-missiles.png)Micro Missiles together. When your team can’t seem to stop the enemy Supports, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va can go in as the backline assassin and kill one before the rest of the enemy has time to react.

Guide.title: Terrible ranged damage
content: Anytime ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va isn’t right in the face of the enemy, her damage can pretty much be entirely ignored. The slow travel speed of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/micro-missiles.png)Micro Missiles also causes them to be an unreliable source of ranged damage.

Guide.title: Directional damage mitigation
content: While some Tanks can block damage from multiple directions or large areas in front of them, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va’s ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix is a cone-shaped straight in front of her. If you aren’t precise with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix's aiming, you’ll waste the resource and not even absorb the damage you intended to. This also makes her struggle in the open because of crossfire.

Guide.title: Zoning Ult
content: In the lowest ranks, you may be able to get away with launching ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va bomb into the sky and getting random team wipes. Once you begin to climb, however, you’ll quickly find that players are good at hiding from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/self-destruct.png)Self-Destruct as it flies through the air.

The best use at higher ranks is often as a zoning tool. Only being able to force the enemies to walk away for a few seconds is much less impactful than stunning the entire team with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter or Grav.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Fusion Cannons
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fusion-cannons.png)Fusion Cannons
* Use the closest cover
* * Due to the limited range, you want to always look to position as close to the enemy as possible.
* Move from corner to corner and try to hold the cover closest to the enemy. The farther you can safely push up, the more opportunities you’ll have to find a good dive target.
* Infinite ammo
* * The wide bullet spread and infinite ammo of your primary fire end up being good for constant small instances of damage.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va is the best at chasing after a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/translocator.png)Translocator ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sombra.png)Sombra because your shotguns will reveal ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sombra.png)Sombra invisible location.
* Additionally, every bit of damage restarts the self-heal passive. Take advantage of this when enemies are low and don’t have a Support able to heal them.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Defense Matrix
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix
* Learn matchups

* * Depending on the enemy team’s hero selections, your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix focus will change. If they have a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira, you should be eating every ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-orb.png)Biotic Orb. If a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junkrat.png)Junkrat, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix his Concussive Grenades, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana's nade, and the list goes on.
* All high-value abilities that can be absorbed by DM should be the primary target for you.
* Peel

* * Booster and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix are the best combo abilities for peeling among all the Tanks. When you see ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog hook a teammate, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/boosters.png)Boosters and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix the follow-up damage so they can survive, for example.
* Enable

* * Is your DPS going for a high-risk, high-reward play? Apply ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix to them to significantly reduce risk and increase their chances of success.

* Coordinate with your DPS and protect them during their Ult use. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrage.png)Barrage, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/deadeye.png)Deadeye, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/death-blossom.png)Death Blossom are good examples of ults that greatly benefit from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix protection.

Guide.title: [Shift]: Boosters
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/boosters.png)Boosters
* Be decisive

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va can’t afford to be passive or stand around trying to decide what to do. Her short range means she can’t stand in main and poke, and the short duration of DM prevents her from being a shield bot.
* Dive and engage

* * If you’re going to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/boosters.png)Boosters to hard engage, be sure to have plenty of Matrix so you can survive the counterattack.
* Always try to engage on the perimeter of fights, and never in the centre. You’ll have an easier time isolating enemies while also taking less damage.
* Disengage

* * If you go in or are pushed up on the objective, and suddenly the entire enemy team is looking at you, Booster away to safety. In about three seconds, you’ll be healed up and ready to Booster back up to try again.

Guide.title: [E]: Micro Missiles
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/micro-missiles.png)Micro Missiles
* Don’t poke with Missiles

* * It’s easy to fall into the trap of standing far away and using missiles to shoot at an enemy barrier. This is a huge waste of Missiles and gives the enemy a window to move up, knowing you can’t burst them down.
* Best burst damage

* * Booster, wait until you are close, then ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/micro-missiles.png)Micro Missiles, and shotguns, to burst an enemy to death. Extremely effective against enemies on off angles and flanks.

* Against aerial enemies like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo, be sure to wait out their primary movement ability, then Booster to chase after so they can’t escape.
* Matrix and Missile

* * Protecting yourself and attacking simultaneously comes in handy when you need to shut down enemy DPS. Getting right on the enemy with Matrix cuts off all projectile damage and projectile healing. Plus, your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/micro-missiles.png)Micro Missiles are damaging them. If even a single ally coordinates and attacks with you, the enemy should die.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Self-Destruct
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/self-destruct.png)Self-Destruct
* Booster Bomb
* * 99% of the time, you’ll want to send your exploding mech forward and not just eject in place.
* However much Boosters' resource is left, is how far the mech will fly.
* A good rule of thumb is to use 50% of Boosters before Ulting to ensure the mech falls back down before exploding. That way, you don’t overshoot the enemy team by accident.
* Second life

* * Sometimes the use of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/self-destruct.png)Self-Destruct is for the quick re-mech. If you’re getting demeched with Ult available, don’t hesitate to use your Ult.

Guide.title: [Q]: Call Mech
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/call-mech.png)Call Mech
* Be safe
* * The most important consideration of when and where to remech is whether you are likely to survive. Get behind cover before calling down mech.

* Also, remember ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/call-mech.png)Call Mech gets cancelled by hack, knockback, and stuns. Be aware of the positioning of enemies with these abilities.
* Oneshots 250 HP heroes if extremely close.
* * Generally not worth it, but for memes and niche scenarios, it comes in clutch.

Guide.title: Passive: Eject
content: _Eject out of your mech when it’s destroyed._
**Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/eject.png)Eject!
* If the fight is already lost, be sure to die quickly and not stagger. The worst thing you can do in pilot form is make your respawned team wait for your late respawn.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Light Gun
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/light-gun.png)Light Gun

* Get away from the enemy when you are pilot ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va and target the easiest to hit enemy to get ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/call-mech.png)Call Mech quickly.
* Don’t give up; her tiny body makes it difficult for enemies to hit you. Sometimes you can win a 1v1 and get mech back.

Guide.title: Bunny Power
content: * Safer Minor Perk

* * The extra health makes it way easier to survive long enough to remech. Enemies look to instantly kill pilot ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va when she ejects from her mech. Bunny Power helps her to tank those attacks.

Guide.title: Extended Boosters
content: * Good for diving
* * When diving the enemy backline, you can Boosters through their Tank and any other enemies in the path to proc Extended Boosters.
* Chasing a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy, for example, is much easier when you have more flight time.
* Numbers
* * Each boop deals 25 damage.
* Base Boosters have a 2-second duration. Hitting two enemies extends the duration by 50%.

Guide.title: Shield System
content: * Increased self-sustain
* * Shield health moves to the front of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va’s health pool and is damaged first.
* Matrix converting damage absorbed to recover lost shield health increases your survivability mid-fight.

Guide.title: Precision Fusion
content: * Best when you want to focus on offensive power and kill potential.
* Save for finishing blows instead of using it at the start of attacks.

Guide.title: Maps
content: The most distinct advantage ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va has over the rest of the Tanks is her ability to fly for 2 seconds, every 3 and a half seconds. She gets the most value from maps with extensive high-ground areas. Her damage is only effective at very short ranges, so maps with flat and open areas are bad for her. However, that doesn’t mean she wants to sit and brawl on the objective. Capture and Control points that are cramped don’t give her enough room to move around, and she’ll likely lose the face-to-face Tank battle.

Guide.title: Watchpoint
content: Gibraltar

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: The team comps that can best utilize ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va’s mobility and damage mitigation strengths are dive and poke comps. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va excels at enabling her allies by repositioning quickly and often. For her to deal meaningful damage, she needs to be point-blank right in the enemy's face. Because of this, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va is often ran with dive heroes who suddenly collapse on a single target.

As a defender and enabler, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va allows her ranged and hitscan allies to take aggressive positions while she protects them with her presence and Matrix.

Against poke comps, she is equally effective since DM is resource-based and can absorb infinite damage. Add on her ability to control high ground, and the poke comp with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va is always at an advantage.
**Example of a team comp built around D.Va:**

* * **Tank**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt

* **DPS**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper

* **Supports**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana

Guide.title: Individual synergies with other heroes
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt (6v6)

* When paired with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va covers all of his weaknesses. She can deal with enemies on high ground and DM him when he drops his shield to swing. They can even dive together whenever Rein can pin past the enemy Tanks.
* Both are also excellent protectors for their ranged teammates who can stand behind their shield and Matrix while laying down suppressive fire.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper helps to take attention away from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va whenever he's on the flank. Her Boosters also allow ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va to quickly dive anyone ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper is surprise attacking. The easiest time to kill ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper is while he's stuck spinning in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/death-blossom.png)Death Blossom. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix covering Blossom is shockingly lethal and hard to stop.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta

* The team with this glass-cannon Support always has the upper hand on offense. Well, as long as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta is alive, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va can peel for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta whenever he's getting focused and help him stay in the fight. His long-range damage and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord are also the best Support tools to help ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va secure elims on the enemy backline.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va best ability is her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix. Using attacks that do not get absorbed by Matrix is the easiest method of directly countering her. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/photon-magnum.png)Photon Magnum, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/photon-projector.png)Photon Projector, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/particle-cannon.png)Particle Cannon are beams so they go through Matrix. All melee attacks such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonblade.png)Dragonblade also work.
If your hero only has projectiles, you can position her at angles where you can shoot her from the sides or back, where Matrix cannot absorb.

Also, any abilities that can stun her out of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/boosters.png)Boosters will stop her movement, and is the best way to get the de-mech. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/binding-chain.png)Binding Chain,![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion are strong CC tools that you should save to use until she tries to fly away.

Guide.title: Overview
content: "To all agents of Overwatch, this is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston!” ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston greeted us every time we booted up OG Overwatch, and has been one of the best dive Tanks ever since. For longtime players, many have not adapted to the multitude of balance changes that have affected ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston, his playstyle, and his supposed counters. Ever since the last armor changes, for example, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston can survive against heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va, and Monke mains shouldn’t be swapping off just because the enemy has these heroes present.

A simple-to-understand yet difficult-to-master kit gives ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston a low skill floor but a very high ceiling. The very generous AoE of primary fire means you don’t need good aim to do well on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston. Similar to this genius ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston mains must first develop their brains and game sense in order to perform consistently well. He can suddenly appear anywhere on the map, so the enemy needs to always be on alert and ready to get jumped on. When you want to play aggressively, try out ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston and start bypassing the entire enemy team to target that squishy backliner.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Avoid Tank battles. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston will lose a 1v1 duel against every other Tank. Stay away from them.

* Don’t sit at the choke point. Short range and minimal damage mitigation make ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston bad at contesting choke points. Use Leap to bypass chokes and get to flank angles or high ground.

* Look for isolated dive targets. Anytime you see an enemy a bit separated from their team, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack onto them and try to get a quick elim.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Track his cooldowns. When ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston uses either bubble or leap, his enemies have a generous window to target him where he can’t shield or jump away. Focus him when he can’t escape.

* Keep your distance. Most heroes have CC to stop or knockback ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston, or a movement ability to run away. Try to never let him get close to you, as he’s only a threat up close.

* Stay in an ally Support’s LoS. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston's damage is rather low, and most Supports can keep you alive with their healing even while he’s attacking you. Eventually, you’ll do more damage than him, and he’ll have to disengage.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Fast jump
* Good at isolating targets
* Barrier piercing cleave
* Low damage
* Low cooldown cycle
* Lots of bad matchups

Guide.title: Extremely fast jump
content: Jump Pack sends ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston flying across the map and is one of the fastest movement abilities in OW. He uses the superior speed to catch enemies and force them into situations where they have to outplay him or die. Whether he’s taking high ground or jumping straight at the backline, the damage and speed of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack are the core of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston's kit.

Guide.title: Isolating enemies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston excels at scouting and at jumping onto enemies who are separated from their team. On top of this, he also has ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-projector.png)Barrier Projector to completely cut enemies off from their team. Their team can’t shoot or heal through the barrier, which allows him and his team to quickly eliminate the isolated foe.

Guide.title: Barrier-piercing cleave
content: Other than melee attacks, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tesla-cannon.png)Tesla Cannon primary is the only attack that pierces barriers. Additionally, the beam’s wide angle cleaves all enemies within its AoE. This enables ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston to damage multiple enemies simultaneously and build ult charge faster.

Guide.title: Low damage per second
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston sometimes struggles to get elims simply because his damage per second is too low to reliably kill a target while they are receiving any healing. The low damage is one of the main factors in why he’s so bad at dueling Tanks. They just kill him way faster than he can kill them.

Guide.title: Long cooldown cycle
content: Compared to the other dive Tanks, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston can reposition less frequently. He only has one movement ability, and its cooldown is longer than ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/boosters.png)Boosters, for example. The 12-second cooldown of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-projector.png)Barrier Projector is even more exploitable. The health usually lasts only a couple of seconds, leaving a long gap between Barrier uses.

Guide.title: Heavily affected by matchups
content: What ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston can do and should be trying to do in a given match is very dependent on the enemy team’s composition. When they have an immobile backline, he can easily jump them, but if the backline has Stuns and CC, he can get booped out of his leap or stunned to death. The same principle applies to all roles. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston, more than other Tanks, is forced to adapt his playstyle and strategy to the hero selection of the enemy comp.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Tesla Cannon
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tesla-cannon.png)Tesla Cannon
* Barriers and mitigation abilities

* * Most of the time, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston doesn’t want to battle the heroes who have barriers, so you should only look to take advantage of this feature early in fights, or to finish off a critical health enemy who’s shielding to stay alive.

* Example: Enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma has low HP but has barrier and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp available to keep him alive. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tesla-cannon.png)Tesla Cannon ignores both and can kill the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma when the rest of your team can’t.
* Big cleave
* * Always try to keep multiple people in your beam. You can strafe and adjust your aim to make cleaving additional targets easier.
* Melee weave
* * Whenever you are in melee range, you should alternate between melee and primary fire. Over time, you’ll deal more single-target damage since you’ll be reducing reload time.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Tesla Cannon (Charged)
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tesla-cannon.png)Tesla Cannon **(Charged)**
* Poke damage
* * Before every fight breaks out, you can use secondary fire to start building some ult charge and applying light poke pressure to the enemy.
* When the enemy team has high poke damage and peeking to deal 60 damage costs hundreds of your HP, you’re better off not peeking or poking.
* Jump combos

* * Begin charging secondary fire, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack, fire while in air to get some damage in before landing. This tech increases your burst damage and helps to secure elims.
* Range without committing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack

* * Often, enemies will have very low health and run away from you. You could ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack to chase them down, but if they are low enough to be killed by a charged beam, go for the shot and save the jump.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Jump Pack
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack
* Contest the high ground

* * The greatest strength of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack is the capability to contest the high ground. Never let enemy DPS and Supports stand on high ground for free when you are ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston. Jump up, use your health and barrier to survive their damage, and injure them enough that they have to fall back.
* Prioritize survival

* * Never ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack into the enemy team without ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-projector.png)Barrier Projector. The cooldown of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack is twice as fast as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-projector.png)Barrier Projector, so be careful not to leap into the enemy and instantly die because you don’t have bubble to keep you alive.
* Jump distance

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack can be directionally influenced. Hold forward to go farther, or backwards to jump short distances.
* Jump target prioritization

* * The most important thing to learn with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston is how to discern who you should be jumping on. Here’s a condensed checklist of examples to help you figure out where to jump in any given match.

* * Threat to your team: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn is ulting and slides into your team looking for picks. Immediately Jump her. Even if you can’t kill her, your presence will likely keep the rest of your team alive.

* Isolated: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta is off angling by himself, trying to catch your backline with a full-charged volley. Jump him while he’s alone for an easy kill.

* Already used counter-cooldowns: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra just exited ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form. His standard form doesn’t pose much threat to you, and you can damage him through his barrier. This is the only time you would want to Jump a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra.

* Immobile: You see ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun. Jump to wherever she lands because you know she can’t boop you back or escape.

* Can’t break your barrier: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei is pushed up on your team. You can Jump her as long as some of the rest of the enemy team is preoccupied. She can’t break your barrier, and you can bubble dance to win the duel.

Guide.title: [E]: Barrier Projector
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-projector.png)Barrier Projector
* Block crowd control

* * The most important use of your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-projector.png)Barrier Projector is to block stuns and knockbacks. You could perfectly time a dive on an enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana all by herself, but if you don’t block her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart, she’ll escape and you’ll likely get anti-naded and die instead.
* Once you start blocking enemy CC, expect them to change up timing. Then it becomes a mental battle of who can read the other better.
* Bubble dance
* * If you plan to spend any time actually fighting, you’ll need to master the bubble dance:
* * Stand at the edge of the bubble and walk inside when the enemy is outside. When they try to walk in, walk out to keep blocking their attacks.

* Depending on the matchup, you can learn the timing of their attacks to be more effective. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog has a slow-firing shotgun, for example, and you can time your dance to counter his rate of fire and never get shot by a full blast.
* Cut off LoS
* * Sometimes the best use of Bubble is to cut off an enemy from their team's resources. This could be to stop a low health Rein from being healed, or placing bubble to cut off Sound Barrier’s AoE.
* Peel

* * While ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston isn’t always the best Tank for peeling, he’s certainly capable. When you see an ally in danger of dying, jump to them and drop bubble to keep them alive.
* Many ults can be survived with a well-timed bubble. Drop bubble on top of your team to buy them time to counter the enemy's ult.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Primal Rage
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage
* Extra Life

* * When the fight is still winnable and you're about to die, pop ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage for the instant health. You essentially get an extra life and can save the fight just by being alive.
* Keep track of players alive and save your ult if your team is already way behind in numbers.
* Overwhelm enemy resources

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage enables ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston to commit and go all in on a fight. In many fights, this will make the difference between the enemy backline surviving with a sliver of health and being able to finish them off.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston's initial dive traded for the enemy's cooldowns, then ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage can be used without the threat of these abilities. Thus, allowing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston to secure elims with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage that he otherwise could not have.
* Don’t ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage if the enemy has counter resources.

* * Whole hog, sleep, grav, and other similar abilities easily shut down the giant body of the angry Ape. Wait until these abilities have been used before you commit ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage.
* Juggles

* * The final stage in mastering ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage is juggle mechanics. By far the most difficult and flashy aspect of his ult. Spend time in training mode getting used to how far the melee knock back and how far you need to jump to keep the combo going.
* Walls, corners, and small rooms all make juggling considerably easier. Trap enemies against the environment, hold attack, and jump off cooldown to maximise damage output.
* Look down in the air to hit enemies during Jump and carry them with you.

Guide.title: Electric Charge
content: * Excellent for chasing opponents as they try get away from your dives.
* Compared to Heavy Landing, this perk will give you more consistent value.

* Best when the enemy has speed boosting abilities or if you are not confident with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage juggling.

Guide.title: Heavy Landing
content: * Best Minor Perk
* Increased lethality during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage

* * Every time you ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage, you’ll deal more burst damage. The extra damage is surprisingly helpful in converting kills.
* The longer you’re in the air, the higher the resource meter fills up, and you’ll deal more damage upon landing.
* In general, it’s better to only go for a high Jump on the initial attack, then keep the Jumps low and quick.

Guide.title: Chain Lightning
content: * Extra ult charge

* * Chain lightning deals an extra 72 damage when hitting 2 extra enemies. Compared to the 48 damage of a single hit, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston can generate 2.5x the amount of ult charge with every secondary fire.
* Potential for final blows
* * The bounce can hit enemies behind cover as long as they have a targetable teammate in range. You may be able to get some final blows if the enemy is one-shot.

Guide.title: Revitalizing Barrier
content: * Self healing
* * Even a few seconds of healing while bubble dancing with an enemy can make the difference between winning the exchange and getting out alive.
* Extra ult charge

* * A full duration Barrier heals 240 HP to each hero inside. The healing you and your allies receive generates ult charge. When needing to farm ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage for a fight, you can use the bubble defensively and heal your allies.

Guide.title: Maps
content: The best maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston have structures, high ground, and plenty of natural cover. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston doesn’t want to have to rely on his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-projector.png)Barrier Projector as his only means of staying alive. Instead, he performs best when the map’s environment offers protection. Jumping the high ground to push enemies off is his bread and butter. High ground also allows ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston to stage dives and drop down on the enemy without having to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack. That way, he can leap away at a moment's notice.

The maps Monke struggles on are the wide-open ones with very little cover. Also maps that favor close-range fights on the objective are pretty miserable for him since he has a harder time staying away from his bad matchups.

Guide.title: Watchpoint
content: Gibraltar

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston doesn't have lethal burst damage on his own. If his target is receiving healing, he generally will not be able to get an elimination. Where Winston shines is disrupting backlines and creating openings for the rest of his team to follow up on his dives.

Heroes who can keep up with the speed of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack are the best pairings. Think mobile burst damage heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/vendetta.png)Vendetta. Together, they can stomp the enemy backline.

For Supports, Winston needs high single-target healing so he can retreat, be healed, and get right back into the fight. Pairing Supports like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko allow him to play aggressively, receive healing from a distance, and be saved by their utility cooldowns.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: The most effective way to counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston is to prevent him from leaping out of a fight. His basic gameplay loop is to jump in, drop his barrier, attack, jump out, and repeat. If you stop that leap out, he is dead (or you force a Support Ultimate like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier to save him).

Abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/vendetta.png)Vendetta overhead, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/ravenous-vortex.png)Ravenous Vortex, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/binding-chain.png)Binding Chain are all hard counters when timed properly.
Lastly, remember that if you don't have an escape ability, you must stay near an ally who can protect you—either with high-burst healing or enough damage to force Winston's retreat.

* Pro Tip: Don't automatically switch to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper. This counterpick is a remnant of the past that has cemented itself into the modern player base. While his shotguns deal high damage to Monke, that only applies at point-blank range and if Winston doesn't have a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-projector.png)Barrier Projector to protect himself. This situation rarely presents itself if the Winston player knows what they are doing. Remember that matchups don't exist in vacuums; you must remain conscious of the map, the game mode, and the rest of the enemy team.
