Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog feels more like a giant DPS than a Tank. Chain Hook makes him more of a lethal threat than the rest of the Tanks. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog wins games by being a solo playmaker. He’s also one of the only Tanks who offers no protection to his allies other than being a bullet sponge.

Players who like to take offense and defense into their own hands find ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog to be a great fit. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-a-breather.png)Take a Breather gives him a ton of self-sustain and makes Hog one of the most self-reliant Tanks in Overwatch. Play forward, pull vulnerable enemies out of position, and convert those early picks into fight wins.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Landing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook on a DPS or Support is higher value than on Tanks. Be on the hunt for squishies in range of Chain Hook.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-a-breather.png)Take a Breather to heal whenever your Supports are preoccupied or out of LoS. You can also absorb more damage during Breather.

* Hook can be used before or during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whole-hog.png)Whole Hog to keep the enemy close. Try to aim ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whole-hog.png)Whole Hog towards a wall so your target gets stuck instead of being knocked away.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * If you react quickly with healing, CC, or damage mitigation when an ally gets Hooked, you can save their life.

* When Hook misses or gets blocked, press the attack for a few seconds because ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog is not very lethal without ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook.

* If you have a damage mitigation ability, let ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whole-hog.png)Whole Hog push you back so you get out of its optimal range before activating your barrier or damage absorption.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Chain Hook
* Burst damage
* High self-sustain
* Bullet Sponge
* Low range
* Poor mobility

Guide.title: Displacement abilities
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook is easily the most dangerous Tank cooldown in all of Overwatch. Pulling someone around a corner and away from their team is almost always enough to get the kill. Additionally, Whole ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog can be used for environmental KOs or to push enemies off the objective.

Guide.title: Burst damage
content: His shotgun deals high burst damage at both very close-range and mid-range. He can also combo right-click > ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook > primary > melee for a rapid burst combo.

Guide.title: High self-sustain
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog is the only Tank who can heal himself anytime he needs health (granted, he has Breather resources). He can heal himself for 450 health every ~9 seconds. During ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-a-breather.png)Take a Breather, he also gets damage reduction. This allows ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog to survive on his own and makes him difficult to kill.

Guide.title: Bullet sponge
content: Because he is large, slow, and has no damage mitigation, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog is always taking a ton of damage. Feeding with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog is easy to do, and even if you don’t die, the enemy team often gains an ult economy advantage.

Guide.title: Limited range
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/scrap-gun.png)Scrap Gun's slow projectile speed and wide bullet spread make it terrible at longer ranges. Enemies who can position outside of his Hook range can also ignore him as a threat.

Guide.title: Poor mobility
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog is the only Tank without any movement abilities. He does have Invigorate for a brief speed boost, but that is locked behind a Major Perk. Most heroes can easily play keep away with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog, and maps with lots of high ground are extremely difficult for him.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Scrap Gun
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/scrap-gun.png)Scrap Gun
* Only for close range. Until you are very close, within a few meters, you should use Secondary Fire.

* Play with cover. The slow fire rate makes it optimal for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog to constantly peek out from cover. Even at close range, don’t forget to try to minimize how much damage you take.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Scrap Gun (Medium-range)
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/scrap-gun.png)Scrap Gun
* Optimal secondary fire range is 10-14m. At this range, the explosion will trigger, and you can one-shot squishies with a full cluster headshot.
* Poke early in fights with secondary fire to start building ultimate charge.
* Always aim for headshots. If the range is after the explosion, aim slightly lower so the upper pellets crit.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Chain Hook
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook
* Hook & turn

* * The best Hooks are done near a wall or structure so ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog can pull the enemy in, flick his aim to the side, and preposition the enemy behind the wall.
* Their team won’t be able to provide healing, and they’ll need to navigate around the wall to escape. This is generally not possible and will almost guarantee a KO.
* Combo: Secondary Fire > Hook > Primary Fire > Melee

* * Performed in rapid succession, this is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog's bread and butter. Hitting headshots with this combo deletes most DPS and Supports.
* Target DPS and Supports

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook reaches 20m. Abuse its range and pull in the DPS and Supports who think they are safe behind their Tank. Compared to high-HP Tanks, DPS and Supports can’t survive a Hook unless their team saves them with something like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/life-grip.png)Life Grip.
* Prevent Tank disengage

* * Against Dive Tanks like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va, don’t pull them in until they are using their mobility ability. If you ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook them before, they can just fly away. If you ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook them during flight, they are trapped.

Guide.title: [E]: Take a Breather
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-a-breather.png)Take a Breather

* Anytime your Supports are busy healing another teammate, use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-a-breather.png)Take a Breather before spamming “I need healing.” The whole point is to have the agency to manage your own health.
* Be careful not to feed. Just because you can heal yourself doesn’t mean you should constantly take spam damage.

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-a-breather.png)Take a Breather to reduce damage from high-damage attacks such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/meteor-strike.png)Meteor Strike.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Whole Hog
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whole-hog.png)Whole Hog

* Hook an enemy into you before using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whole-hog.png)Whole Hog. You can also start ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whole-hog.png)Whole Hog, Hook, then continue firing.
* Environmental KOs are the best. On maps with ledges, position yourself to get the opponent’s back to the edge, then blast them off.
* Walls are your best friend when ulting. Trapping an enemy Tank into a wall, corner, or room guarantees you keep blasting them with max damage.

Guide.title: Scrap Hook
content: * Save yourself from embarrassment

* * The worst feeling every ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog player has experienced is Hooking an enemy and finding you have no ammo, so you just stand there reloading with the enemy in your face.
* Scrap Hook guarantees you’ll always have the ammo necessary for your Hook combos.
* Increase shotgun uptime
* * The extra 2 ammo effectively decreases the time ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog spends reloading by 30%

Guide.title: Shrapnel Launcher
content: * The new range is about 15m for the explosion range, which actually makes you weaker in the 10-14m range than without the perk. Keep this in mind to help you make your choice.
* Great when you are confident in your aim. Opens up way more ranged damage during the poke phases of fights.
* Especially good on maps with longer sightlines, such as Colosseo.

Guide.title: Invigorate
content: * Better for flank and solo playstyle. Can flank and reposition to and from off-angles more quickly.

* Good for disengaging as well. When you need to run away from something like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra's Ult, Invigorate makes it possible.

Guide.title: Pulled Pork
content: * The extra sustain is very strong. Take Pulled Pork when the enemy team has been laying a lot of damage on you. You’ll be able to stay in fights longer and position more forward.

Guide.title: Maps
content: The best maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog are those that encourage close-range fights, like most Control and Flashpoint maps. Because Roadhog has no mobility, he doesn't like high-ground maps like Watchpoint: Gibraltar, and with limited range, he doesn't want long-sightline maps like Circuit Royal.
No matter what map, the main thing Hog needs to use is corners to pull enemies around.
Also, there's a need to mention Ilios: Well because Hog just standing on the point threatening to pull you into the hole is a major threat that forces the enemy to reposition off the objective.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog doesn't need much healing since he can heal himself more than any other hero. What he needs is allies who can fill the gaps in his kit. Heroes with long-range damage and those who can contest high ground for him make his life much easier.

For Supports, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta’s ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord makes every ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook even more lethal. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu is pretty much required for Hog to survive if the enemy has anti-heal like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rampage.png)Rampage.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: To counter Hog, all you really need to do is stop his hook from killing people. If you are a barrier Tank, watch for patterns and his animation to reactively block as many hooks as possible. If you are a DPS or Support with an escape or block, use them to avoid getting hooked.

The other important component is protecting allies who do get hooked. You can use abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy-javelin.png)Energy Javelin, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/life-grip.png)Life Grip to save your teammate from death after they get hooked.

Anti-healing is also extremely strong against Hog since his only form of survivability is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-a-breather.png)Take a Breather. When none of these apply, just exploit the fact that he can't protect his team or contest range and high ground, and farm as much damage and Ult charge as possible from him and his team.

Guide.title: Overview
content: A former principled Overwatch agent who left as the organization lost its way. He was hunted down by bounty hunter Freja, who found him heavily modified with cybernetics. His mind is at war with itself, toggling between his old self and a soulless killing machine.

Emre uses his Burst Rifle take over the ranged battle. While most other heroes sacrifice either accuracy or movement speed, Emre maintains both as he ADS strafes to be simultaneously lethal and evasive.

Taking off angles helps him to bypass barrier Tanks, find targets behind cover. When he catches someone off guard, he can get them with a direct nade and finish them off with a rifle burst. He also has great self-sustain thanks to life steal, and his health regen passive.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * ADS as much as possible. Only unscope when there is no target, or when fighting at very close range.
* Keep yourself alive and don’t rely on Support healing. Use Siphon Blaster when you need healing.
* Throw Cyber Frag and quickly try to shoot the same target. Frag + headshot is his most lethal combo.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * If you don’t have good burst damage, try to escape during his Siphon Blaster, so you minimize how much life steal he can generate.
* Emre has no crowd control counters other than trying to dodge with Siphon Blasters. He’s an easy kill if you can stun or knock him around.
* Listen for his Ult voice line, and prepare to shoot Emre out of the sky.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Good at medium to long-range
* Fast Movement
* Self-sustain
* Vulnerable during Ult
* Damage output is low
* Weaker version of other DPS

Guide.title: **Good Medium to Long-Range Dueling**
content: Being able to hip fire and ADS his assault rifle gives him a decent amount of versatility in the ranges at which he is effective. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-aim-emre.png)Take Aim (Emre) makes him very strong in medium to long-range duels.

Guide.title: **Fast Movement**
content: While he is not moving at the hyperspeed of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack, Emre has the best ADS strafe speed in the game, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/siphon-blaster.png)Siphon Blaster gives him both vertical and horizontal mobility. He never has to sit still, making him a difficult target for the enemy team.

Guide.title: **Self-Sustain**
content: Self-sustain is a rare commodity in the DPS roster. Although the lifesteal from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/siphon-blaster.png)Siphon Blaster is not an insane amount of burst healing, it can definitely keep Emre alive in 1v1s. Having movement paired with lifesteal makes Emre more self-sufficient and less reliant on team assistance.

Guide.title: **Vulnerable During Ultimate**
content: Floating around in the air during his ult makes him an easy target for enemy hitscans. Expect any enemy with anti-air capabilities to focus on taking him out before he can secure multiple kills.

Guide.title: **During Siphon Blaster, Damage Output Is Very Low**
content: Even though he needs it to survive, pulling out Siphon Blaster sacrifices a lot of damage. If his target is receiving healing, he struggles to secure the kill until he swaps back to his rifle or lands a direct hit with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cyber-frag.png)Cyber Frag.

Guide.title: **Lags Behind in His Niche**
content: Emre competes with heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/soldier-76.png)Soldier: 76, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe for the role of a mid to long-range hitscan on his team. These heroes all have well-rounded kits and high damage output. He can trade blows with Soldier, but compared to Sojourn and Ashe, it is difficult to justify picking Emre over them.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Synthetic Burst Rifle
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/synthetic-burst-rifle.png)Synthetic Burst Rifle
* Stay unscoped when you need to make large aim adjustments or are targeting an enemy at close range.
* Designed for frequent scope/unscope play. You can seamlessly swap between the two.
* Unscope when not actively aiming at a specific target so you retain full FoV, and don’t limit your visual information.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Take Aim
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-aim-emre.png)Take Aim (Emre)
* No movement penalty, super fast strafing while ADSing, unlike Ana and Ashe, who slow while aiming.
* Greatly increased effective range and tighter bullet spread. ADS whenever possible.
* Range, accuracy, and movement speed make Emre extremely good at medium to long-range poke fights.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Siphon Blaster
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/siphon-blaster.png)Siphon Blaster
* Survival tool. Primarily use Siphon Blaster for survive enemy attacks. You become move evasive with increased jump and movement speed, and all damage deal with the blaster generates life steal.
* The increased mobility is not burst mobility or a dash. It’s similar to Bap Jump or Juno glide, and not like Echo, Winston, or Anran’s SHIFT.
* Blaster is semi-automatic, so you need to rapid tap fire.
* Cools off faster if you burst fire, pause, burst fire, pause, just before overheating.

Guide.title: [E]: Cyber Frag
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cyber-frag.png)Cyber Frag

* The main reason you would play ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/emre.png)Emre over another hero like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/soldier-76.png)Soldier: 76 is for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cyber-frag.png)Cyber Frag.
* * The best use is pressuring enemies positioned near corners and walls. You can force retreat, cut off their retreat, or bounce the nade to hit behind cover after their retreat.
* Also good for initiating your attack. Throw the nade first, then start firing so that the explosion hits as your bullets hit for big burst damage.
* * Decent AoE damage, but best used for bursting down a single target.
* Can nade jump, including additional jump speed when combining nade jump with Siphon Blaster.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Override Protocol
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/override-protocol.png)Override Protocol
* Start by firing a heavy round. There is a cooldown before you can fire another, so spam light rounds until you can fire another heavy.
* Heavy rounds have greatly increased direct hit and AoE damage.
* Heavy rounds can be used for a super-fast rocket jump by shooting the ground or a wall and jumping during the self-knockback.

* Extremely vulnerable while flying during ult. Make sure you either have a Support directly healing you or position behind a barrier. Otherwise, you’ll need to use vertical cover and be a bit more passive with its use.

Guide.title: Suppressive Security
content: * Makes Emre’s Ult more lethal by making it easier to land follow-up Heavy shots.
* * Slow the enemy with light rounds, then finish them off with a heavy round.
* Enemies will be more hesitant to challenge your ult, thus making ulting a bit safer.

Guide.title: Enhanced Agility
content: * Decent for escaping and evading while Siphon Blaster cools off.
* Since the blaster is constantly overheating (without Heat Sink), you can take advantage of moments when you need to let it cool off.
* The 20% increase in movement speed, on top of the base movement buff, makes escaping feel more realistic.

Guide.title: Heat Sink
content: * Recommended Major Perk
* Fire more shots for more total time. Also results in greater life steal. If you are confident in aiming Siphon Blaster, this is a great Perk. Allows you to play more aggressively.
* Especially good for dueling, and for when Tanks are pressuring you (easier to land more shots on their large bodies).

Guide.title: Cyber Adhesion
content: * Transforms Cyber Frag into a cyber semtex.
* Sneak up on an enemy, throw the nade to stick, and immediately ADS headshot. You’ll delete DPS and Supports.

Guide.title: Maps
content: Emre performs best on maps with objective areas and sightlines that match his optimal range (e.g., Rialto, Nepal, Esperança). Ideally, he will play near Cyber Frag’s max range, where he can abuse the AoE damage paired with his rifle follow-up shots.
Smaller maps (e.g., Antarctic Peninsula, Oasis, New Junk City) feel cramped for Emre. Although he can get good value from grenades, he may struggle to utilize the rest of his kit effectively.

As long as he can maintain high ground, he performs decently on dive maps (e.g., Dorado, Watchpoint: Gibraltar), but he gets countered by dive heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va that are typically played on these maps.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Emre wants a frontline Tank who can set up and hold a position. Tanks like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma are ideal choices, as their barriers protect him, and they have the damage and CC needed to help defend against aggressors.

Since he is fairly flexible as a DPS hero and has consistent output, he can pair with just about any other DPS. The main consideration is whether the other DPS is filling the same role (e.g., ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/soldier-76.png)Soldier: 76, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn). If the enemy team is countering with dive or a barrier Tank, your team will lack counterplay.
For Supports, it is generally up to Emre to play within line of sight or healing range. Because he has some self-sustain, he can work with both high-healing and utility-based Supports.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: To counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/emre.png)Emre, your first objective should be neutralizing his grenade. You can do this either by playing outside of its range (snipers like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/widowmaker.png)Widowmaker, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta) or by using damage mitigation to block it (e.g., ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-shield.png)Barrier Shield).

Emre’s weakest matchup is against dive and rush comps that can chase him down and beat him at close range. He does not have a strong escape tool, and he has no CC, so he is an easy target to play aggressively into.
If you don’t have good burst damage, try to escape during his Siphon Blaster, so you minimize how much life steal he can generate.
Emre has no crowd control counters other than trying to dodge with Siphon Blasters. He’s an easy kill if you can stun or knock him around.
Listen for his Ult voice line, and prepare to shoot Emre out of the sky.

Guide.title: Overview
content: Earning respect throughout the wild west, the cowgirl leader of the Deadlock Gang takes out her targets from beyond the horizon. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe outranges nearly every hero in Overwatch with her trusty lever-action rifle, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/the-viper.png)The Viper. Not only does she use her superior aim to click heads, but also to shoot ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite out of the air to set the whole enemy team on fire. When your team needs to keep the enemy team at a distance, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe's kit does it better than anyone else's. Her combination of ranged, AoE, and burst damage helps to shut down the advances of the enemy.

Guide.title: Playing As
content: * Constantly change your position to maintain distance and catch the enemy by surprise.

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite to target enemies behind barriers, walls, and cover. They’ll think they're safely hidden until they're hit by the explosion.

* Send ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. onto the objective to gain progress for your team and stop the enemy's progress. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe should rarely, if ever, stand on the objective herself.

Guide.title: Playing Against
content: * Close the distance. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe struggles in close-range fights. Find ways to approach her and shut her down.

* Keep track of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite's 12-second cooldown. If she just used it, you can move up. If she hasn’t thrown it for a while, try to stand outside of her throw range.

* Hide from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. He has a huge health pool, so if your team can’t burst him down quickly, it's best to get out of his LoS and wait until he leaves.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Great control
* Consistent damage
* Good point pressure
* Mechanically difficult
* Can't one-shot people
* Bad vs close-range

Guide.title: Angle Control
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe is wildly good at holding angles. If she’s set up first, she can stay scoped in and fire as soon as the enemy comes around the corner. If they try to hide behind the corner, she can ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite and hit them with the explosion AoE.

Guide.title: Consistent damage sniper
content: Compared to other snipers like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/widowmaker.png)Widowmaker and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hanzo.png)Hanzo, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe brings more consistent damage to her team. Her kit isn’t so feast or famine thanks to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite and her higher rate of fire. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. can also be used to finish off enemies when her aim isn’t doing the job.

Guide.title: Point pressure
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. is arguably the best objective Ult in the game. He deals high damage, has a lot of HP, and is zero risk to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe and her team. These qualities make him great for contesting the objective. The AoE damage of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite also makes it dangerous for the enemy to sit on point.

Guide.title: Mechanically demanding
content: The unfortunate reality is that ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe's biggest weakness comes down to the mechanical skill of the individual player. If you are cracked and a head-clicking monster, it’s nearly impossible to do poorly on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe. On the other hand, if you are missing every other shot, it's going to be super hard to bring value to your team while playing her.

Guide.title: No one-shot
content: Because ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe can’t one-shot, she is at a disadvantage against ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/widowmaker.png)Widowmaker and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hanzo.png)Hanzo in sniper duels. Especially on long-range maps like Havana and Circuit Royal, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe has to be much safer with her positioning than the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/widowmaker.png)Widowmaker or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hanzo.png)Hanzo.

Guide.title: Struggles in close-range engagements
content: Although she can hipfire and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe is at a major disadvantage in close-range fights. If she already had to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun, she has no defense against dive heroes. Additionally, most high mobility heroes' movement abilities are on shorter cooldowns than ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun, so even if ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe boops them away, they can reengage before she has another ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: The Viper
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/the-viper.png)The Viper
* Don’t unload your whole clip

* * Always try to save at least a few bullets for ADS shots. It can be tempting to spray and pray from the hip in a panic-induced attempt to survive. Do your best to conserve ammo and find the opportunity to switch back to ADS shots.

* Consider that to kill a full health 250HP enemy, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe would have to land 8 hipfire body shots in a row before they kill her!
* Finish off low HP enemies
* * Hipfire is still hitscan, and the faster rate of fire makes it ideal for finishing off targets that barely survived your ADS shots.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: The Viper (ADS)
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/the-viper.png)The Viper (ADS)
* Spend most of your time ADS

* * ADS shots are your primary source of damage and the entire reason for playing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe. So, try to use this as much as possible.

* The 25% movement-speed penalty doesn’t make ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe much easier to track. In general, it's not worth unscoping just to try and dodge incoming fire.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Coach Gun
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun
* Get off me

* * The most valuable use of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun is to get divers off of you. Knocking a leaping ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston stops him from attacking you, and often forces him to waste Bubble and retreat.
* Time ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun to hit after the enemy has committed their movement ability.
* Take the high ground

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Guns' self-knockback is great for setting up on high-ground positions. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe is strongest when she can overlook the battlefield, throw ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite over barriers, and use the floor of high ground to LoS from low ground enemies.

Guide.title: [E]: Dynamite
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite
* Don’t force ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite

* * If you don’t have clear targets, save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite for when you do. The damage, ult charge, and overall value of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite is too precious to waste.
* Control corners

* * Especially when matched against closer-range enemies that are constantly trying to approach you, use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite to control corners. Do this by holding onto it until you see the enemy coming around cover, trying to approach you, and then explode one in their face. The damage pressures them to retreat, which keeps you safe.
* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite as often as possible

* * More important than not wasting ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite is using it. Don’t hold it all game waiting for a 5-man explosion. If you have an opportunity, take it.
* Without frequent ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite use, you’ll be building Ult painfully slowly.

Guide.title: Ultimate: B.O.B.
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B.
* Aim carefully

* * The worst thing you can do with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. is mess up his positioning. The saddest thing every ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe player has experienced is when ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. goes running past where you intended him to stop, and ends up in nowhere land, shooting no one.
* Take the time to carefully line up his running path and plan for structures and enemies in his path. Check for what he might get stuck on, and what you want him to get stopped by.
* Contest the objective

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. is an incredible objective contesting tool. He runs fast, so he gets the point quickly. He sacrifices himself so ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe and her allies don’t risk their lives on the objective.

* Make sure the wall you send ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. to actually puts him within the objective area. Sometimes he’ll stop just outside the area.
* Create crossfire

* * Always try to get ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. to attack from a different angle than yourself. If you and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. are both firing from in front of the enemy, they will easily avoid both sources of damage. On the other hand, if ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. is behind the enemy and you are in front, they can’t shield from both angles simultaneously and have to expose themselves to one to avoid the other.

Guide.title: Remote Detonator
content: * Useful for exploding ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite over walls and around corners where you can’t shoot it.
* Also, safer than standing in the open to shoot the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite.

Guide.title: Double-Barreled
content: * Best against dive comps. You can create space between yourself and the enemy with the first shot, then you have another shot to reposition even better.

Guide.title: Viper's Sting
content: * Best poke Perk
* * The extra damage is very powerful on maps with long sight lines. The bonus damage is also not affected by falloff, so the extra 25 damage keeps its effectiveness at all ranges.

* Also useful for pressure ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks as landing two shots in a row is very easy on their large bodies.
* Bonus damage reset
* * The “consecutive scoped shots” reset after every hit, 2 scoped shots, when missing a scoped shot, or after 3 seconds of no shots.
* Hip fire shots do not affect Viper’s Sting’s counter.

Guide.title: Airburst
content: * Best anti-brawl Perk
* * When the enemy team plays as a deathball, the larger AoE will help you burn more targets with each use.
* Increase ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/the-viper.png)The Viper uptime

* * Even if you don’t hit any targets with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite, every time ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe shoots it out of the air, she reloads 3 ammo. This helps her reduce reload time and increases the time she spends firing.
* Don’t pick against a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko

* * The increased AoE is essentially negated by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu. Remember Suzu heals extra when cleansing effects like Burning, so you’ll be feeding her a lot of Ult charge.

Guide.title: Best Maps
content: The best maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe have open sight lines where she can take advantage of her superior range. She also benefits from high ground she can ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun up to, then use for attack angles and protection. Maps with enclosed objective areas are difficult for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe because she’s forced to play in suboptimal close ranges. Furthermore, if the map has a lot of side routes for flankers, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe struggles to keep an eye on so many angles, so she can’t properly defend herself.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Team comps built around ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe enable her sniper playstyle by creating space for her keep the enemy in her LoS. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks with barriers can deploy them in front of her, allowing her to snipe her targets safely. Other DPS and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports assist ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe by keeping the enemy at a distance through CC or damage pressure. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. are equally important components of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe's kit. Allies who help her stay in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite range enable ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe to farm ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. significantly faster and apply more pressure to the enemy backline. When ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe is free to hold angles, she takes over sight lines and destroys the enemy team.
**Example of a team comp built around Ashe**
* **Tank**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt

* **DPS**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sombra.png)Sombra

* **Supports**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste

Guide.title: Individual Hero Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt

* Rein’s ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-field.png)Barrier Field is the perfect huge shield for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe to position behind and snipe the enemy. When facing off against other long-range heroes, the one who has a shield ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank in front of them has a major advantage in the match-up. Additionally, a Rein pushing into a team demands their full attention, which frees up ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe to position in the open where she can acquire easier targets.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sombra.png)Sombra

* The main way ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sombra.png)Sombra and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe play off of each other is by filling opposite roles simultaneously. While ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe is sitting back and sniping, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sombra.png)Sombra splits the attention on the flank. Anytime these two heroes are attacking at the same time, turning to focus on one completely exposes you to the other. Moreover, when the enemy runs dive to counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sombra.png)Sombra can stay back and hack the attackers anytime they come in.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe with a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy pocket is one of the deadliest duos in all of Overwatch 2. The damage boost changes the break points of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe's ADS shots, and a damage boosted ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite deals almost 200 damage on its own. With ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe can take more aggressive off angles and become a greater threat to the enemy team.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Other than ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/widowmaker.png)Widowmaker, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe has the long-range advantage against virtually every hero in Overwatch.

The main strategy when facing an Ashe is to close the distance and attack where you have the advantage. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe struggles in close-range fights, but you should path outside of her LoS (take side rooms, go over walls, etc) so you don't let her snipe you during your approach.

The next most important thing is to keep track of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite's 12-second cooldown. If she just used it, you can move up. If she hasn’t thrown it for a while, try to stand outside of her throw range.

If you have a barrier or mitigation ability that can block Dynamite, make it your personal mission to block every single throw. This will deny her a ton of ult charge meaning you'll have to deal with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. less often.

Most of the time you should hide from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/b-o-b.png)B.O.B. He has a huge health pool, so if your team can’t burst him down quickly, it's best to get out of his LoS and wait until he leaves (10 seconds).
Of course if you need to contest point or if your team can get out of his range, then you need to help by either shooting him, displacing him, or blocking his shots.

Guide.title: Overview
content: True to her name, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo copies and repeats the abilities of other heroes. The ability to dash, fly, and glide gives her some of the best movement of any DPS hero. She’s nimble and sneaky, but can be easily punished for positioning mistakes. Floating above the ground means she doesn’t make any footstep sounds and that makes her absolutely lethal when going on deep flanks behind the enemy team.

The nature of a copy ultimate means she simultaneously has one of the best and most difficult ults in the entire game. Echo mains can’t truly be one-tricks because they need to maintain a large hero proficiency pool to get the most value out of every ult use.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Take advantage of Echo’s silent movement and set up surprise flank attacks as often as possible.

* Wait to visually confirm an enemy’s health is below half before activating ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/focusing-beam.png)Focusing Beam, or else you’ll lose out on a lot of damage.

* Plan out your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/duplicate.png)Duplicate target ahead of time, and make sure they are in a position to be selected. As the copy, play safe until you get their ult.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Hitscans like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/soldier-76.png)Soldier: 76 have the advantage against Echo when she’s flying around.
* Pay attention and notice if you don’t see Echo. She’s likely setting up behind you for a sneak attack, so watch your flank.

* Many Echo players use Flight to get in and attack. Dodge and get cover for a few seconds, then quickly focus her while her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/flight.png)Flight is on cooldown.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Mobile
* Ultimate
* Burst
* All-or-nothing abilities
* Ult hero pool
* Super squishy

Guide.title: Mobility
content: Flight and Glide give Echo nearly endless options for movement and positioning. She can outrun most attacks to stay alive, and she’s able to rush down enemies trying to get away. One unique quality of Echo’s mobility is that she can use Flight for vertical and horizontal dashing. Most heroes are limited to one or the other.

Guide.title: Versatile Ult
content: Being able to copy anyone on the enemy team means Echo can adapt her Ult usage to be offensive, defensive, zoning, tempo, or simply as a self-survival tool. Paired with Friendly Imaging, Echo can have up to 11 Duplicate choices in 6v6 game modes. Instantly gaining max HP and all the copy's cooldowns is very strong, plus when Duplicate ends, Echo will always have a minimum of 100 HP.

Guide.title: Burst damage
content: Sticky Bomb followed by Focusing Beam is a lethal combo against all DPS and Support heroes. Echo is great at finishing off enemies who think they are safe because of Focusing Beam and her mobility. Beam against critical health Tanks is one of the best abilities in the entire game to make sure those Tanks don’t get healed back up.

Guide.title: All or nothing cooldowns
content: Echo’s primary fire is not particularly strong, and when Beam is used on a target above 50% HP, the damage is very low. Sticky Bombs are also easy to miss due to their slow travel speed. You either are going to get massive or no value from her cooldowns. When Echo isn’t getting solo kills and final blows, she’s not contributing much to her team.

Guide.title: Ult hero pool
content: One major drawback to a copy Ult is that you have to achieve at least a base level proficiency with almost the entire cast of Overwatch 2. When the enemy team isn’t running a hero with an ult you want, or a hero in your main pool, you may struggle to do anything other than feed with her ult.

Guide.title: Glass Cannon
content: Echo’s lethality comes at the cost of low health and no defensive abilities. She dies quickly when exposed and has to play evasively if she wants to stay alive. When Flight is on cooldown, Echo is a sitting duck against dive heroes. Moreover, if the enemy runs more than two hitscans, staying in the air becomes a problem as Echo can’t sustain the damage.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Tri-Shot
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tri-shot.png)Tri-Shot
* Poking
* * Before you get into deep flank positions, you should be poking with primary fire to start building Ult and apply a bit of pressure on the enemy.
* Anytime someone survives your Bomb + Beam combo, Tri-Shot comes in for the finish.
* Save cooldowns
* * Tri-Shot should be used while waiting for ideal opportunities to use Bombs and Beam. Those two are not abilities you can afford to waste, but you can spam primary fire as much as you’d like.
* Range
* * Primary fire can be effective at any range because it has no damage fall off. The bullet spread and travel speed will have you dealing less consistent damage the farther away you get.
* Close to medium range is best for Echo to maximize primary fire damage and stay in range for her other cooldowns.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Sticky Bombs
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sticky-bombs.png)Sticky Bombs
* Surprise attack
* * The best use of Sticky Bombs is as a combo starter against unsuspecting enemies.
* Maximize direct hits by getting an off-angle or deep flank where your target doesn’t see you. They won’t be trying to dodge, and you’ll have a higher chance of landing every Bomb.
* Immediately after firing Stick Bombs, begin using primary fire and Focusing Beam. Sticky Bombs travel slower than Tri-Shot, so at longer ranges, all your damage will land close together.
* Spam damage
* * Because they are on a short cooldown, anytime you’re poking with primary fire, you should also be firing Sticky Bombs.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Flight
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/flight.png)Flight
* Save for escapes

* * It’s so tempting to use Flight to dash right into the enemy and start blasting. Doing so, however, often leads to your death. Echo will end up being exposed to the enemy team and have no way to survive.
* Most of the time, you should save Flight as a disengage tool. Walk or Glide into position, eliminate your target, then Flight out to safety and repeat the process.
* Chase
* * The times when you should use Flight aggressively is when needing to chase down a low HP enemy and Beam them to death.
* The initial burst of Flight is very fast and can catch up with most enemy movement abilities. Don’t let them get away!
* Plan ahead

* * When you do use Flight to engage, make sure to plan how you will survive without Flight. Is there a wall to fall behind where the enemy doesn’t have someone who can chase you? Maybe an ally has a resource like Zarya Bubble or Suzu that can keep you alive. The point is, don’t go in just hoping for the best; make an actual plan.
* Min-maxing Flight
* * Activate Flight, then immediately cancel the ability. Echo will benefit from the instant burst of speed and carry some momentum while Gliding. Also, this puts Flight on cooldown much sooner.

* You’ll get to use Flight again quicker, and don’t lose that much distance or speed. Useful when returning from spawn, or when you are mid-fight and need the movement, but can’t afford to go 9 seconds before the next use.

Guide.title: [E]: Focusing Beam
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/focusing-beam.png)Focusing Beam
* Never use until half health

* * When using Focusing Beam, focus on confirming the enemy is already below half health before activating. Using Beam to try and get in enough damage to get them below half, then start benefiting from the damage increase, will not work in your favor.

* Expect the enemy to get healed during your attack unless they are completely isolated. Consequently, if they are above half health when you begin using Beam, they’re likely to stay above half as they get healed.
* Focus beam deals damage faster than any Support can heal as long as the target is below 50% HP.
* Beam bypasses

* * Remember, Beams ignore certain damage mitigation abilities like Defense Matrix, Kinetic Grasp, Deflect, and Javelin Spin. Heroes who have these typically use them to survive long enough to get healing while at low health.
* In these matchups, save Beam to counter such abilities and get the kill when they think they’re safe!
* Deployables
* * The below half health damage buff also activates when attacking deployables like turrets, B.O.B., and Immortality Field.

Guide.title: [SPACE]: Glide
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/glide.png)Glide
* When to float
* * Glide above walls to use the vertical cover and create unique attack angles only available to the few heroes with verticality.
* Against close-range and melee heroes, you can essentially perma-fly to keep as much distance as possible between you and the enemy.
* After using Flight to keep momentum and move faster.
* Don’t Glide when:
* * The enemy team has multiple hitscans like Widowmaker, Cassidy, and Illari.
* Your team isn’t being aggressive, so the enemy is free to focus you.
* You’ve already been Gliding in the same position or area. Repeating your Glide patterns makes you predictable and easy to kill.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Duplicate
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/duplicate.png)Duplicate
* Copy for cooldowns or Ult?
* * Echo can base her duplicate selection on either the copies base kit, or their ultimate.
* Some heroes like D.Va, for example, have powerful cooldowns but their ult isn’t very good for an Echo Copy.
* Depending on the available hero pool, consider what abilities would benefit your team the most to help you determine your copy target.
* Don’t rush it
* * Duplicate lasts up to 18 seconds (with Minor Perk) which is really long in Overwatch time. Take your time, use the new cooldowns intelligently, and don’t take unnecessary damage.
* Positioning

* * Don’t copy and end up in the middle of the enemy team. Duplicate is a shiny homing beacon for the enemy team to focus you. If you Duplicate, then jump between the enemy Tank and Supports, you’ll be instantly killed by team fire.
* Instead, position as you normally would on the perimeter. When copying a Tank, you can also just stay frontline with your Tank. If you copy a Support, position like that Support normally would.

Guide.title: Focused Rush
content: * Recommended Minor Perk

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/focusing-beam.png)Focusing Beam is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo's best ability, so buffing it is very strong for her. The increased range and speed enable you to position more safely and target enemies normally out of your range.

Guide.title: Partial Scan
content: * Install ults

* * A good use of starting with 50% ult charge is for copying heroes with install ultimates like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/primal-rage.png)Primal Rage, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/annihilation.png)Annihilation, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonblade.png)Dragonblade, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overclock.png)Overclock, etc.
* Many times, you’ll find that without Partial Scan, by the time you generate the copied ult, your time runs out and cancels the ult.
* Prioritize earning ult
* * Partial Scan should be treated as a time extension as soon as you activate copy. Take some extra time to play safe, stay alive, and farm your copy's ult.
* Dying (copy ending) before getting ult completely wastes this Minor Perk selection.

Guide.title: Full Salvo
content: * Best Major Perk
* * Echo can benefit from Full Salvo every 6 seconds as compared to only benefitting from High Beams when specifically getting elims from Beam after using Flight.
* Extra burst damage
* * The math works out to roughly 30% more damage compared to regular Sticky Bombs.
* Full Salvo is more consistent at getting all DPS below half health for Focusing Beam combos (even those with high health and armor).

Guide.title: High Beams
content: * Full aggro beam usage
* * Being able to use Flight twice in a row enables some crazy aggressive plays. You can Flight dive the backline, kill, fly to cover, wait for Beam, and assassinate another.
* Hard to rely on the reset

* * To fully benefit from the Flight reset, you’ll want to fly in deep, secure an elim with Beam, then fly away. However, if the enemy survives your beam, you are left with no cooldowns and a death sentence.
* You should be used to Flight management and not leaving yourself exposed after Focusing Beam use. Therefore, you’ll have to adjust your playstyle to benefit from the Flight reset.

Guide.title: Maps
content: Echo’s quick movement and flying abilities are best utilized on maps with plenty of high ground and natural vertical cover. Peeking over walls, or air strafing around structures high in the air allow Echo to play more aggressively and do so more safely.

On flatter maps, as long as there are lots of side paths for flanking, Echo still performs great thanks to her silent footsteps and horizontal dashing. The maps that hinder her playstyle the most are the long range sniper maps where she has to expose herself down sightlines to approach the enemy. Echo also has difficulty on maps with large open objective areas and maps with too many small areas that hinder her movement.

Guide.title: Watchpoint
content: Gibraltar

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: First off, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo is a flyer, so if you're playing a close-range hero like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, you mostly need to do whatever you can to help your teammates counter her. Don't think there is nothing you can do; protecting them, pinging Echo, and creating space all help your teammates deal with her.

For Tanks, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va is the best counter pick since she can fly and use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sticky-bombs.png)Sticky Bombs. Hitscan heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/soldier-76.png)Soldier: 76, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/emre.png)Emre, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari have the advantage against Echo when she’s flying in the open. However, she will have the advantage when sneaking up on their flank at closer ranges.

Pay attention and notice if you don’t see Echo. She’s likely setting up behind you for a sneak attack, so watch your flank. Many Echo players use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/flight.png)Flight to get in and attack. Dodge and get to cover for a few seconds, then quickly focus her while her Flight is on cooldown.

When she uses ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/duplicate.png)Duplicate on Tanks, remember that her HP is capped (usually at 350 HP), making it lower than a "real" Tank. Focus her down immediately before she can generate their ultimate.
