Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: As a versatile Support, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wuyang.png)Wuyang can work with rush, dive, and poke team comps. He just needs to adapt his playstyle to fit his team. For example, on a dive team, make sure you have ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/restorative-stream.png)Restorative Stream placed on the teammate playing most aggressively and taking up the enemy team's attention. To do this, you generally need to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rushing-torrent.png)Rushing Torrent to keep up with their movement and stay within healing range.

On the other hand, when playing on a poke-heavy team, you should primarily be saving ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rushing-torrent.png)Rushing Torrent as an escape tool to get away from enemy attacks, since you won't need it to keep up with your team's more stationary playstyle.

For Supports, try to play with a hero who has AoE healing like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mizuki.png)Mizuki or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio to make up for your single-target healing. Also, your team will get more benefit from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/guardian-wave.png)Guardian Wave's boosted healing when you hit multiple allies, and they are all being healed simultaneously by your other Support.

Just remember that if you are paired with an ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana, healing boosts from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenadeand ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/guardian-wave.png)Guardian Wave do not stack. These are two extremely high-value cooldowns, and your team can't afford to waste them by layering them together.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: The main way to beat ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wuyang.png)Wuyang is by tracking his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/guardian-wave.png)Guardian Wave and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rushing-torrent.png)Rushing Torrent cooldowns. When he has these still available, he and his allies are very difficult to eliminate.
Slowly pressure him and save your most lethal cooldowns until after you've seen him use one or both of these CDs.

When you see the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/guardian-wave.png)Guardian Wave slam, back off, wait 3 seconds, then hard re-engage to wipe his team because they won’t have burst healing. After Wave, you know he can't knock you back, and can't rapidly heal his allies.

After his dash, he doesn't have any way to escape your attack. After you see him use Rushing Torrent (often to refill healing resources), immediately rush at him to eliminate Wuyang while he’s unable to escape.
His Ult has a short 3.5s duration. Run away, use cover, and escape tools your hero has because you don't want to get knocked down by the explosion.

When you are unable to escape, hard focus the enemy in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tidal-blast.png)Tidal Blast. This is less optimal since they'll likely have plenty of health plus the huge chunk of overhealth from the ult.

Guide.title: Overview
content: Enhanced by body augmentations, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard leaps around the enemy team, trapping them with his dangerous ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall. The deployable wall is large enough to block most doorways and can be used to cut off entrances and escape paths that the enemy is trying to use. Equally effective is when he uses the wall defensively as a barrier to protect himself during an engagement.

As a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank, he’s rather versatile and doesn’t quite fit into any of the traditional ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank categories. His shotgun, wall, and block make him decent as a frontline brawler, while Leap and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vault.png)Vault give him dive capabilities as well. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard is a great ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank to pick up when you want the ability to quickly switch between defensive and aggressive playstyles through a match.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall to cut off the enemy LoS. You can protect yourself from damage or separate enemies from their allies.

* Always be moving and repositioning. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vault.png)Vault has no cooldown and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/violent-leap.png)Violent Leap's cooldown is short. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard does best on the move and should never sit in one place.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard early to maintain armor and gain information on enemy positions. Dive, then Guard again to finish off targets, and survive long enough to Leap away.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Every time you see ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard, use your crowd control abilities on him.
* Plan how you will survive his dive. You can use escape abilities, damage mitigation, stuns, or position near an ally who can assist you.

* Counterswap when necessary. Examples: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana can sleep and anti him; ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo can avoid him, then burst combo him to death after he blocks; ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog can interrupt his dives with Hook.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Mobile Movement Abilities
* Got a big wall
* High uptime
* Has to be in melee range
* Short mobility
* Struggles vs CC

Guide.title: Multiple mobility tools
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard can climb walls and ledges, Leap, and bunny hop. He can even ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vault.png)Vault on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall when needed. When positioning and managing his cooldowns properly, there should never be a time when you have no mobility options.

Guide.title: Deployable wall
content: As the only ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank and only hero other than ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei with a deployable wall, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard can execute plays that no other ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank can. Wall is equally good for blocking doorways, used as a barrier, isolating enemies, cutting off enemy escape routes, and for a bit of damage.

Guide.title: High uptime
content: With multiple strong abilities and a short cooldown cycle, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard never has to sit around waiting for his resources to refresh before he can engage. Compared to many other ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks with a main long cooldown ability that their entire game plan is centered around, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard spends far more time in the heat of battle.

Guide.title: Has to get in close
content: Slash and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/bonespur.png)Bonespur are only effective at very close range. Depending on the map and enemy team comp, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard may waste a lot of time trying to approach the enemy while getting poked down.

Guide.title: Short mobility distance
content: While he’s not a true dive ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank in the traditional sense, his playstyle is very similar. His movement range, however, is quite limited compared to the other dive ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard struggles to chase down enemies with mobility and escape tools of their own.

Guide.title: Weak to crowd control
content: Without a barrier and only one use of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard is particularly susceptible to CC. If the enemy has heroes with stuns and displacement abilities, expect to be targeted every time you use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard. The slow, predictable movement makes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard an easy target.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Bonespur
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/bonespur.png)Bonespur
* Poke during approach
* * Don’t just wait around for the perfect moment. As soon as you see the enemy, you can start applying some poke pressure.

* Against barrier ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks, the distance doesn’t matter too much and you’re decent at chipping away at their barrier health.
* Play corners
* * Your ranged damage is worse than almost every other hero. So you don’t want to get into a full-on ranged fight. Peek corners while shooting to minimize how much damage you’re taking.
* Reload before fully engaging

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/bonespur.png)Bonespur is your primary form of damage so if you’ve been poking, make sure you reload before Leaping into the enemy team.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard automatically reloads, so no need to manually reload if you’re about to block anyway.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Spike Guard
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard
* Keep your armor up

* * Don’t wait until you’re almost dead to start blocking. The best time to block is when you have plenty of armor health and not when you’re about to die. That way, when you start attacking again, you still have the armor to tank damage with.
* Final blows

* * The autofiring damage is excellent for finishing off enemies at critical health. It’s guaranteed to hit, reloads your primary fire, and buys your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports time to heal you.
* Survive burst damage

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard reduces all direct frontal damage by 65%. As long as you are not right next to it, you can even survive a D.Va Bomb.
* Always try to Leap away and immediately block when you see incoming burst damage.
* Minimize healing resources used

* * As a non-sheild ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank, it’s still your job to take as little damage as possible. Don’t be a bullet sponge who demands all your team’s healing resources. You’ll get the rest of your team quickly killed if both ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports are constantly having to heal you.
* Guard refreshes quickly so block often.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Violent Leap
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/violent-leap.png)Violent Leap
* Take space in increments

* * Leap doesn’t send you across the map like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va, or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball. So you need to approach in Leap-ranged chunks.
* Leap to the closest cover, poke, and Guard, then Leap to the next cover that gets you closer to your target until you ultimately end up in dive range.
* Engage then disengage

* * Don’t forget that ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/violent-leap.png)Violent Leap is also an escape tool. Even though you’ll primarily be using it to attack, it’s great for getting to safety as well.
* Bunnyhop
* * Leap and jump as soon as you land to perform a bunny hop. You’ll keep momentum and jump farther.
* You can also hold onto Slash until just after bunny hopping to effectively extend its distance.
* Use other abilities during airtime

* * Don’t just float through the air, attack or deploy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall. Good for extra damage and combos.

* Best combo: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/violent-leap.png)Violent Leap → ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/bonespur.png)Bonespur (primary fire) → ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/violent-leap.png)Violent Leap slash → ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/bonespur.png)Bonespur → Melee

Guide.title: [E]: Jagged Wall
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall
* Turn on “![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall uses preplacement controls” in hero settings
* * Makes precise placement of wall much easier.
* Cut off LoS

* * The main use of Wall is blocking the enemy’s LoS. You can deploy wall in front of you to block poke damage, or place it between an enemy and their ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Support to cut off their healing.
* Protect your flank

* * When you’re diving the enemy backline, the rest of their team will turn around and try to kill you. Put ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall behind you to protect yourself from the counterattack so that you’re free to focus on your offense.
* Block entrances and escapes

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall is large enough to block doorways. Great for stalling time when the enemy in trying to contest the objective, or to separate them from each other.
* When attacking an enemy trying to get away from you, shoot wall in their way to stop them from escaping.

Guide.title: [SPACE]: Vault
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vault.png)Vault
* Move

* * As ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vault.png)Vault has no cooldown, you should use it and save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/violent-leap.png)Violent Leap whenever possible. When staging your dives, use wall climb to set up on high ground or jump over walls to get to your target.
* Evade

* * You can wall climb to make yourself more difficult to hit. Especially against close-range heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, wall climbing is great for getting out of Hammer range and dodging Shatter.
* Wall climb reset

* * Using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/violent-leap.png)Violent Leap after wall climbing allows ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard to wall climb again without needing to touch the ground.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Downpour
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/downpour.png)Downpour
* Goes through walls

* * No matter how many walls or structures are in the path, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/downpour.png)Downpour's spikes go right through.

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard to 3rd-person peek around corners and see where the enemy is positioned. Then, stick 'em with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/downpour.png)Downpour. The hidden path is more difficult for them to avoid.
* Blocked by barriers, and projectile-absorbing and destroying abilities

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma, for example, can negate your ult by deploying his shield above himself or by aiming ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp up. If you want to hit him (or any hero with these types of abilities), you’ll need to wait until they don’t have their cooldowns available.
* The same could be said for cleanses and escape abilities, as the long start-up animation, plus the travel time for farther away enemies, gives them plenty of time to dodge.
* Be smart

* * The enemy can still kill you when they're immobilized. They just can’t move around. You can’t just 1v5 wipe them or mindlessly attack. Still use cover and make sure you have your team’s resources to help you.
* Pulls down fliers

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/downpour.png)Downpour has a tall vertical area of effect at 30m high. Unless the enemy is flying super high, you can pull them down with your ult.

Guide.title: Deep Leap
content: * Counter high mobility

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard can have difficulty keeping up with targets who have lots of mobility, like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn. The extra Leap distance helps him to close the gap and stay in a more advantageous range for him.
* Faster engages
* * With the increased distance, you won’t have to break up your approach into as many stages since you can dive from farther away.
* More often, you’ll be able to bypass the enemy frontline and instantly reach the backline with Leap.
* Pairs with Off The Top
* * You can go all in on Leap perks and structure your game plan around Leap and Slash. Just know you’ll be sacrificing Lifesteal and Wall uptime to do so.

Guide.title: Anarchic Zeal
content: * Self healing

* * A full-duration ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard with Anarchic Zeal will heal you for approximately 50 HP per target.

* Combined with the damage reduction, this makes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard significantly more tanky, and alleviates some healing resource demand on your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports.
* Run with Reconstitution
* * When planning to use Anarchic Zeal, you should select Reconstitution as your Minor Perk to capitalize on the Lifesteal.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard can trap an enemy in a corner between his body and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall while holding ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard.

* Every couple of seconds, they’ll retrigger ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall and Reconstitution's energy refill. Enjoy watching them panic as you slowly drain their life.

Guide.title: Reconstitution
content: * Significantly increased uptime

* * Upon reading the Perk description, you may think it sounds weak. What makes Reconstitution powerful, however, is that ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard uses the base ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard resource before depleting the overfill. Also, the overfill does not decay, so you can hold onto it as long as needed.

* Between the instant refill and overfill, you’ll be able to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard considerably more often or for longer uses.

Guide.title: Explosive Impalements
content: * Extra burst damage

* * Very good for securing elims with your team and solo kills. You don't have to do anything special because all ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard players should already be using the combo listed above of shoot > Leap > Melee. Basically, a free extra 40 damage.

Guide.title: Maps
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard's mobility is best utilized on maps with lots of walls to climb, and plenty of high ground to move around on. Since he has limited range, his playstyle is hindered on maps with large open areas and maps with long sightlines. He also likes to set up his dive engagements by utilizing corners and structure, so maps with sectioned-off areas give him more opportunities. Another map feature that helps ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard shine is tight choke points and doorways. On maps where the enemy team funnels through these tight areas, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall puts in work and easily carries fights by cutting off the enemy.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Team comps built around ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard can quickly react to his movement, baits, and hard engages. Because ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard is constantly repositioning, heroes with limited mobility or range have a hard time playing with him. Also, he doesn’t offer much protection to his team, and doesn’t have the movement range to peel for his backline, so teammates need to have some self-sufficiency. There is some flexibility in hero selection, however, since ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard isn’t a full-on brawl or dive ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank.
**Example of a team comp built around Hazard:**

* **Tank**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya

* **DPS**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/venture.png)Venture

* **Supports**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio

Guide.title: Individual synergies with other heroes
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja's dashes and vertical mobility easily allow her to assist![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard when he hard engages. While he’s staging, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja is also great at applying poke pressure to help create space for his dive. They just need to coordinate ability use timing, because if ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard traps someone with a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall to their back, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja needs to have dashes available to blast them with Explosive Bolts.
**Lucio**

* Lucio has the speed and agility to engage alongside ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard. He also doesn’t struggle to stay alive on his own when ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard is off on a solo mission, trying to isolate the enemy backline. One thing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard can struggle with is disengaging after he’s committed to a fight. Lucio’s speed boost gets ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard into position faster, and gets him safety more efficiently as well.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko

* The reality of having no barrier and standing still while blocking is that ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard is going to get stunned and anti-healed often. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu comes in super clutch in these scenarios and can end up being ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard's only hope of survival. Additionally, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko can go in with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard for an aggressive attack, then immediately TP out until the next dive.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Effectively countering ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard has a few steps. You need to be able to deal with his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/violent-leap.png)Violent Leap if you want to stay alive. Heroes with poor mobility are easy targets for him to put a Wall behind, isolating them from their team and signing their death sentence. Heroes who can jump or escape in this situation have a much easier time surviving.

To deal with Leap and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/spike-guard.png)Spike Guard, your best tools are knockback and stuns. His Leap doesn't travel very far, and his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/bonespur.png)Bonespur has limited range, so boop him away or stun him in place, and his effectiveness becomes very limited.

* Bonus Tip: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/downpour.png)Downpour is literally a vertical projectile so you can block it with barriers if you cover above yourself.

Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt may very well be the sole universally loved hero in OW. Whenever there is a meta where Rein is strong, the community generally feels pleased with the state of balance. One of the original heroes who helped define the franchise as a shield and melee hero in a first-person shooter. Everything about his game plan revolves around his shield and hammer, with the rest of his kit supplementing these two.

If you are returning to Overwatch or brand new, having just a single tank per team in the main 5v5 modes has greatly altered the playstyle for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt. A common term thrown around in very early days was “main tank” and “off tank.” Basically, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank heroes with shields were considered “main tanks” and those like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog who didn't have a shield were considered “off tanks.”

These days it is no longer ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt's job to just stand at the frontline and shield damage. Now he functions as front line, point presence, rush down enemy back line, and often leads his team in damage.

Guide.title: Playing As
content: * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-shield.png)Barrier Shield and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/charge.png)Charge as repositioning tools. Use both to take space and get yourself close to melee range.

* Start ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike behind cover and peek the moment it fires to minimize damage taken.

* Check your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike charges and ally positions before using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter so you don't end up knocking down the enemy team but having no follow up to actually eliminate any of them.

Guide.title: Playing Against
content: * Use stuns and knock back to shut down his approach. If he can't get into ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer range, he's very underwhelming.
* Burn his barrier from off-angles rather than stacking in front of it where his team can safely attack you.

* When you see the Enemy walking suspiciously far up, expect![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter. The moment you see him drop the shield and wind up, use your barrier or escape ability.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Takes space
* AoE damage
* Damage mitigation
* Choose between dealing or mitigating damage
* Poor range
* No vertical mobility

Guide.title: Taking space
content: Taking and controlling space is one of the primary jobs for tanks and this is exactly where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt excels. A giant hammer swinging force walking with his team behind his huge shield can be extremely difficult to stand in the way of. The enemy team doesn’t want Rein to be close to them so as he walks forward, they walk back. When he is on defense, any enemy hero who wants to advance forward has to willingly put themselves into Rein’s optimal range where he is able to land ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer swings.

Guide.title: AoE damage
content: Against enemy teams that like to position multiple people grouped closely together, the huge AoE hitbox of his hammer deals massive cleave damage. Hitting three enemies per swing is not uncommon and results in dealing approximately 300 dmg per second! Additionally, the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike projectile has a long hitbox and penetrates through enemies, further increasing Rein’s power against grouped enemies.

Guide.title: Damage mitigation
content: Damage mitigation is so important in Overwatch that it has its own designated column on the in-game scoreboard. No other tank can keep up with the sheer amount of damage mitigation ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt offers. Having a shield with no cooldown enables reactive blocking against core enemy cooldown abilities and ultimates. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-field.png)Barrier Field trades in Rein’s favor in every interaction. All he has to give up is a bit of shield health, and Rein can completely cancel out enemy abilities with 10+ second cooldown timers.

His shield also has by far the largest health pool of any shield and regenerates its own hp after not being deployed for a couple seconds. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt's large shield health allows him to activate the passive during fights when his hp is low by simply not putting down his shield.

Guide.title: Has to choose between dealing or mitigating damage
content: The biggest weakness of having a shield in one hand and a hammer in the other is the inability to use both simultaneously. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt is actually the only shield tank that cannot mitigate and deal damage at the same time. Consequently, when facing off against a tank like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa, they will have the advantage in being able to damage ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt while not taking any damage themselves. Even ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va can use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/micro-missiles.png)Micro Missiles at the same time, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive and Ult both allow him simultaneous damage output and mitigation. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt has to constantly choose between 100% defense or 100% offense.

Guide.title: Poor ranged damage
content: Two final and most severe weaknesses are being a melee hero and not having any vertical movement. While ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike does count as a ranged ability, the long cool down and slow speed make it unreliable when actually using it at range. On map areas with long lines of sights, Rein often has to burn up all his shield health while slowly trying to get into melee range, leaving him with little to no shield for aggressive plays, or to save himself if he gets low health. Most heroes in OW can rotate outside of his melee range and continuously fire damage without threat of retaliation.

Guide.title: No vertical mobility
content: On maps or objectives with a lot of high ground, Rein can feel pretty useless as he has no way of contesting or moving vertically. In these scenarios, the best move is often to simply shield teammates and hope they can get some picks. The only other options are to take long paths that allow access to high ground areas, or use a teammate's ability like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform to move him. Either way, Rein has no means of moving back and forth between high ground and low ground areas which allows enemies with mobility to easily avoid him.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Rocket Hammer
content: Swing a massive hammer in a horizontal arc.
**Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer
* Damage and penetrates shield abilities.
* First swing is always right-to-left, then swings back and forth until releasing down primary fire.
* Hitbox is rectangular. Longest range is at both 45 degree angle corners.

* * Swing crooked or quickly whip aim left and right to extend the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer hurt box forward.
* Always try to cleave multiple enemies in single swings when possible.
* Begin Swing animation while partially behind cover and step into open when hitbox can make contact with the enemy to minimize damage taken while attacking.

Guide.title: Secondary FIre: Barrier Field
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt holds a large rectangular shield in front of himself which absorbs all projectiles and explosions.
**Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-field.png)Barrier Field
* Shield regenerates its hp after not being used for 2 seconds
* * When shield health is low, utilize cover, or team healing to allow shield time to regen.
* While ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-field.png)Barrier Field is deployed, Rein walks 30% Slower.
* * “Shield Hopping” means you jump while at full speed, shield in the air, then release shield on ground to be able to move at 100% speed while weaving in chunks of damage mitigation.
* In general it is unsafe to make aggressive plays when the shield is cracked (Lower than 700hp).
* Obvious use is shielding random damage and poke.
* Best use is flashing shield to directly block high value cool downs from enemy team

* * Ex: Bait out ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog hooks through movement, positioning and timing, then block just as enemy Hook comes out. Rein can attack much more safely for 6 seconds.

* Bottom of Shield needs to be in contact with ground to block abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter.

* Hold both ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-field.png)Barrier Field and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer to 3rd-person free look while shielding.
* * Good to see where teammates are positioned behind.
* Peek around corners.

Guide.title: [E]: Fire Strike
content: Wind up, then swing hammer to shoot a fiery projectile that permeates enemies and shields.
**Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike
* Can animation cancel a hammer swing into ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike, for burst damage.

* Slow startup and recovery animation leaves ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt vulnerable to damage and crowd control abilities.

* * Best started behind cover, then step out at the moment of shooting ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike, and back into cover during recovery animation.
* Always try hitting multiple targets with a single use.
* Great for finishing off enemies attempting to run away or retreat behind cover.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Charge
content: Charge straight forward for 3 seconds on the ground at high speed.
**Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/charge.png)Charge
* Can minimally control left and right movement.
* Cancel at anytime by pressing SHIFT.
* * Take an enemy to the edge, then cancel to send them flying off the map.
* Cancel and hold jump to carry momentum through the air.
* Jump cancel plus hold Swing to quickly attack out of charge.
* More often used for mobility or to close distance on enemies than actually pinning a target.

Guide.title: [Q]: (Ultimate) Earthshatter
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter

* Most Tank heroes have abilities that will block shatter, such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-array.png)Barrier Array, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/particle-barrier.png)Particle Barrier, or bypass shatter by going airborne such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/boosters.png)Boosters and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack.

* * As ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, it is your job to track when the enemy Tank has these abilities available to use, and when they are on cooldown.
* Generally, you should save your ultimate until after you have seen these abilities used to increase your odds of a successful Earthshatter.
* Solo-shatter's can be high-value.
* * You don't always need to knock down 5 people to win the fight with your ultimate.

* It would be better to solo-shatter and eliminate the enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta than to knock down 4 of his teammates only to have him use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence to keep everyone alive.

Guide.title: Crusader's Fire
content: * Guarantees you have a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike to follow up on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter.
* Standard 250 HP heroes can be killed by Shatter > Fire Strike(x2), so this perk makes your shatter's more consistently lethal.

Guide.title: Crusader's Resolve
content: * Good in matchups where you are forced to play more passive such as when facing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga.
* Also a decent choice if your Supports have lower healing output.

Guide.title: Shield Slam
content: * Lose the ability to hold secondary fire down and look around without rotating.
* The slam itself is ok, but generally not worth taking over the increased attack speed.

Guide.title: Ignited Fury
content: * Save at least one ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike for when you get into melee range. The increased attack speed is very strong in brawls and will help you win the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank fight.

Guide.title: Kings Row
content: * The first fight on King’s row almost always occurs at the choke point directly between the capture point and the attacking team's spawn. A shield tank is typically chosen to defend this area. Shields block almost every type of damage in OW but ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike let Rein damage through the shields. Team fights get forced on the payload where Rein can use it for cover throughout the map and even safely ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter through it from behind.

Guide.title: Eichenwald
content: * Rein is crazy strong on the first and third point of Eichenwald, and can find creative ways to be useful on the second. On defense, hammer, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-field.png)Barrier Field completely dominate the choke points and dictate what the attacking team is allowed to do. Basically, don’t die on first point, and the enemy team won’t be able to win the fight even if they pick off other teammates.

Guide.title: Lijiang Tower
content: * Horizontal movement and flat ground control are two of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt's greatest strengths. All three points of Lijiang Tower are almost completely flat. Rein can walk everywhere or use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/charge.png)Charge to quickly traverse the Control areas. At least one hero has to be on point from the enemy team which means there will always be at least one target for the hammer!

Guide.title: Dorado
content: * Rein can’t really do anything other than sit on the payload when playing on Dorado. The defending team will gladly let him sit there as they rain down damage on his entire team, eventually winning the fight and watching the payload slowly move back where it started. On defense, either you shield bot on high ground with your team, or you put yourself in a very dangerous position and try to force a head on fight.

Guide.title: Circuit Royal
content: * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma. The main reason Rein struggles on Circuit Royal is due to how perfect ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's kit fits this map. You are pretty much guaranteed to have a broken shield before you get into swinging range. If you make it to the final point, everyone is so spread out that Rein gets blasted from every direction any time he attempts to make a play.

Guide.title: Ilios Well
content: * Placing a giant hole in the center of the map, separating the two sides is the Achilles heel of the armor-clad knight. The well serves as the perfect ring around the rosie tool for enemies to permanently stay outside of melee range. Additionally, Rein is vulnerable to boop abilities that knock him into the hole.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Rein plays best in Rush style team comps where the entire team moves together. Other brawl and close range damage heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper pair strongly with Rein, though he can also benefit from having ranged heroes and flankers on his team to make up for his weaknesses.
**Two types of Reinhardt based team comps:**
1. Everyone plays hard grouped on him and runs over the enemy team.

**Example**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira
2. Teammates play to make up for Rein’s weaknesses such as range and high ground pressure.

**Example**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko

Guide.title: DPS
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei's and Rein’s kits are the perfect frontline pairing. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/ice-wall.png)Ice Wall can be used offensively to separate the enemy front line from their team and allow Rein to swing freely without threat of the enemy backline’s ranged abilities. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei can also use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/ice-wall.png)Ice Wall defensively to save her Rein or allow for safe passage across an open area.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/symmetra.png)Symmetra

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/photon-projector.png)Photon Projector needs time to charge up to full damage. The range is also fairly short. Both of these qualities massively benefit from having a Rein shield constantly near the enemy team. Sym and Rein attacking the same target together has immense damage potential. Moreover, teleporting a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt to high ground or behind enemy lines often leads to a super fast fight win.

Guide.title: Supports
content: **Lucio**

* Speed Boost, the #1 greatest ability Rein could ever be given. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio speed basically makes up for every one of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt's weaknesses. Enemies without strong movement abilities get completely ran over by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio + Rein if they don’t have a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio of their own to speed away. Rein just needs to better manage his shield and hp to capitalize on opportunities to rush down vulnerable enemies.
**Not** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/brigitte.png)Brigitte

* Pro Tip: Contrary to what a decent amount of the player base seems to believe, Brig is one of the worst supports to play with and against ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt. She doesn’t provide enough healing for Rein to play aggressively, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot boops people away from Rein which he does not want, and the OW iteration of Brig is not tanky enough to stay front line with her tank.
* Bonus tip: She also sucks against Rein because if she gets in range for her melee, she gets deleted.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: The best way to disable a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt from destroying your team is to play outside of his melee range. Heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio provide extra movement speed to his entire team making it extremely difficult for an enemy Rein to stay in his optimal Range. A combination of mobility and long range damage make choices like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn impossible for Rein to deal with on his own. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa as a counterpick, somewhat depends on the current power level of the two heroes. In general, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa simply stop Rein from doing everything he wants to do. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin block Hammer swings and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strikes, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify makes all Reins damage negligible and is invincible to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter.
**Mirror Matches**
Most mirror matches become ego duels. The Rein who decides to play smarter wins
* Tracking enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter Ult charge is super important.

* When ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter is ready, players often stop Fire Striking and position more forward. Use these cues to alert yourself to an incoming Shatter and block!

* More important than dealing more damage through swings, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike usage makes a huge difference in Ult charge built.
* Focus on using Shield to block high value enemy cooldowns from hitting team.

* If both teams have an ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana, the Rein who blocks ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Darts is gonna win the mirror..
