Guide.title: Tank
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin, Throw, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify seem like they were specifically designed to counter Rein’s kit. Rein can’t ever walk past ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa as she can freely move him around wherever she sees fit. He can’t front line battle her as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify mitigates too much damage while critical hitting Rein’s big head hitbox. If the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa is smart, she is almost never in range of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer anyway making it a one sided battle.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog

* The armor rework has made this match up more manageable for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt. Nevertheless, all Hog has to do to win the fight is land one hook on Rein and yank him around the corner into his trap. Rein has to block every single hook and hope he can slowly win the fight by taking advantage of the enemies lack of shield.

Guide.title: DPS
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah

* To put it simply, you can’t do a single thing to fight against ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah's flight. Inconsistently, you’ll hit a cool firestrike on your airborne target but it doesn't matter since that’s less than half her health. Block as many rockets as you can, pray your teammates can shoot her down. The best thing Rein can do is apply enough pressure and damage on the rest of the team that the enemy supports won’t be able to give resources to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah, making it easier for your team to take her out.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei

* Just as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/ice-wall.png)Ice Wall is the perfect tool to help Rein, it’s also the perfect tool to make him completely useless. When walled off, Rein will rarely live even with a full HP shield. The play is to try and trick the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei with your timing and approach, making her waste wall, then going aggro during its cooldown.

Guide.title: Supports
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio

* No matter how hard Rein tries to chase people down, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio can speed boost everyone out of his range. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio's boop can also save teammates from your approach or throw off the trajectory of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/charge.png)Charge. His ranged damage is also valuable to burn down ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-field.png)Barrier Field.

Guide.title: Overview
content: As the leader of the Junkers, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen is always there to lead the battle charge. Her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/commanding-shout.png)Commanding Shout inspires her allies to fight by giving them increased speed and overhealth.

No matter what map she's playing on or what Heroes either team is running, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen is always looking to rush down the enemy. She’ll take any opportunity she can get to bypass the enemy frontline and take out their ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports through brute force.

Without any barriers or damage mitigation, self-healing and smart positioning are what keep her alive and fighting. When she can get her team to stay close and follow her around, they can steamroll right through even the best defenses.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Only use Shout when you see an opportunity to push up and aggressively attack the enemy team. Don’t use it if everyone is far away.

* Keep up Wound damage. Cycle ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-blade.png)Jagged Blade, and Blade melee to always have Wounds applied.

* Wait out Ult counters. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rampage.png)Rampage can be easy to counter; don’t use it if the enemy has resources available like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko's Suzu.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * CC her. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen has no countermeasure to CC. Stun and knock her around to keep her at bay.
* Keep your distance. Keep moving and try to never let her get into axe range.

* Shoot her team. JQ has a lot of self-healing and can be difficult to kill. But she’s smaller for a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank and can’t protect her team from your damage.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Speed boosts
* Strong brawler
* Self-sufficient
* No barrier
* Abilities can be cleansed
* Short-ranged

Guide.title: Team overhealth and speed boost
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/commanding-shout.png)Commanding Shout is the best utility ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen brings to her team. The large AOE instantly grants her and her team overhealth and a speed boost. Because of this, she facilitates a very aggressive play style that revolves around Shout’s cooldown.

Guide.title: Deadly brawler
content: Once ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen closes the distance on you, she brawls with the best of them. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/scattergun.png)Scattergun deals high damage up close, and she has ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage to penetrate barriers and bypass many ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks' only means of protection.

Guide.title: Self-sufficient
content: Between healing from Wounds, overhealth from Shout, and life steal from Savage Satiation Perk, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen doesn't even need a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Support to heal her. Being self-sufficient enables her to push deep into the enemy team, get kills, and get out alive.

Guide.title: No barrier or immunity
content: The biggest weakness ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen leaves her team with is not having the ability to protect herself or her team. She stays alive through self-healing, but can't stop the enemy from damaging her or her allies. She especially feels her lack of protection against teams with a lot of crowd control because they can just stack one on top of the other, and she's unable to stop it.

Guide.title: Wounds and anti-heal can be cleansed
content: There are a lot of abilities in Overwatch 2 that cleanse ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen's wounds and anti-healing. Heroes with Fades like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper can cleanse themselves, and heroes with ally cleanses like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver can cleanse their teammates.

Guide.title: Only effective at close range
content: If ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen can't get close to the enemy, she is doing nothing and providing no value to her team. Furthermore, she needs to be touching multiple enemies if she wants to get max value out of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Scattergun
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/scattergun.png)Scattergun
* Slow rate of fire

* * At just over one shot per second, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/scattergun.png)Scattergun fires very slowly. Therefore, it can be helpful to individually click and fire each shot to improve your accuracy.
* Aim for the upper chest

* * The spread of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/scattergun.png)Scattergun hits hardest when aiming for the upper chest. This maximizes bullets landed and ensures some pellets will be critical hits.
* At point-blank range, aim straight for the head or chin.
* Reload before engaging

* * If you are poking before getting into close range, that’s fine, it builds a tiny bit of ult charge, but make sure you have a full clip before getting into the close range fight. That’s where you want to be, dealing high damage and not stopping to reload.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Jagged Blade
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-blade.png)Jagged Blade
* Cooldown begins immediately upon throwing
* * You can leave the Blade in the stuck enemy until you want to pull them in. It won’t decrease its uptime.
* Wounds
* * Wounds inflicted on all enemies the Blade passes through on return.
* Wounds always activate on hit when stuck. Only on recall with the Minor Perk.
* Melee wounds

* * Anytime JQ is holding the Blade (Not mid-air or stuck in an enemy), her melee attack inflicts wounds. Be sure to take advantage of the extra damage and healing by weaving melee attacks between every few shots.
* Pull back CC
* * Against any hero who plans to jump or dash away, stick them with Blade, and only recall it once they have activated their mobility ability.

* Example: stick ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston, then wait for him to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack, then activate as soon as he leaps to stop him in his tracks.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Commanding Shout
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/commanding-shout.png)Commanding Shout
* Use to initiate
* * When you are ready to go in, activate Shout to give extra health and movement speed that will empower your assault.
* Take advantage of the speed to run past the enemy frontline and target their more vulnerable backline.
* Use to react

* * When the enemy unleashes a high-value attack like an Ultimate, use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/commanding-shout.png)Commanding Shout to help you and your team survive. Speed to run away and health to sustain the damage.
* Large AoE
* * Communicate with your team or ensure there are allies in range to increase the impact of each Shout use.

Guide.title: [E]: Carnage
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage
* Rotate your camera to cleave

* * Quickly rotating your camera horizontally widens the hitbox of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage and can help hit extra targets.
* Watch your cooldown
* * Each enemy hit reduces the cooldown by 2 seconds. If you hit multiple, get in position swing to again sooner than usual.
* Try to wait out or bait out knockback abilities
* * Against enemies with knockback abilities, try to watch and track when they have them available. Getting hit with a knockback can turn a huge axe swing into a giant miss!
* Save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage for after seeing their knockback ability used.
* Shout and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage

* * Shouting before using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage can give you the extra speed needed to help land the axe swing.

* Shout can also be cast mid ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-blade.png)Jagged Blade Throw

Guide.title: Ultimate: Rampage
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rampage.png)Rampage
* Track your Ult counters

* * Abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu easily cleanse the Anti-heal and stop the Wound healing. Stuns and knock-back like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy-javelin.png)Energy Javelin or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart can be used on reaction to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rampage.png)Rampage's startup animation.
* Be careful not to use your ult when you haven’t seen these types of abilities recently used.
* Line up enemies

* * Stand in front of one enemy, and aim for the enemies behind. You don’t need to hold onto ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rampage.png)Rampage waiting for a 5-man ult, but always try to hit multiple targets.

Guide.title: (Passive): Adrenaline Rush
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/adrenaline-rush.png)Adrenaline Rush
* Keep an eye on your health

* * Since ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen can have a lot of self-healing, it’s important to pay attention to how much health you have. That way, you’ll always know when you can keep attacking, and when you need to fall back to safety and get healed by your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports.

* Try to always be inflicting wounds by rotating between melee, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-blade.png)Jagged Blade, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage.

Guide.title: Rampant Charge
content: * All in on your ultimate compared to Battle Shout bringing lower, but more frequent value.
* Make sure to use all your CDs before activating ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rampage.png)Rampage.
* You can play hyper aggressive when you have ult because you'll be able to chain two ability cycles together.

Guide.title: Battle Shout
content: “_Commanding Shout fully reloads Scattergun and increases allied reload speed by 50%.”_
* Extra aggression
* * Battle Shout empowers JQ and all allies in Shout AoE to be more aggressive thanks to the decrease in reload time.
* Reload speed buff
* * Reloading after 5 shots ensures you start reloading before Shout ends and lets you benefit from the 50% increased reload speed.

Guide.title: Willy-Willy
content: * Land easier Blade direct impacts, and get an bit of extra burst damage to help secure elims.

* Decent, but only take if you are getting hard CC'd everytime you try to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage and need more ranged presence.

Guide.title: Savage Satiation
content: _“Carnage's impact damage gains 100% lifesteal.”_
* Recommended Major Perk
* Extra healing
* * Each enemy hit with her axe gives 105 HP healing. Multiply by the number of enemies hit, plus consider that each enemy hit also reduces the 8-second cooldown by 2 seconds.
* JQ becomes insanely more tanky when running Savage Satiation.

* If you hit just two enemies with an axe swing, JQ gets 390 total healing (Impact lifesteal plus Wound), and gets to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage again 4 seconds later.

Guide.title: Maps
content: Maps with primarily flat areas around the objective are the best for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen. She has good ground mobility from Shout, but lacks vertical mobility or the range to contest enemies on high ground. Maps with too much high ground are difficult for her to find consistent value on. Additionally, areas that are really open or have long sight lines are bad for JQ, as she has no way of directly dealing with poke damage.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen thrives in brawl and rush comps where her sustain and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/commanding-shout.png)Commanding Shout AoE utility can snowball fights quickly. She pairs exceptionally well with DPS who want to fight inside her effective range like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mizuki.png)Mizukij who benefit heavily the speed and armor. Everyone pressing W together with Shout enables aggressive engages and lets them take space.

Heroes with burst damage like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe are effective at converting ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jagged-blade.png)Jagged Blade pulls into eliminations.

For Supports, Junker Queen has plenty of self-healing, so she primarily wants utility to help her play aggressive. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio can initiate with @Speed Boost, which allows Queen to save Shout to use in response to the enemies' counterattack attempt. Against any low mobility comp, this will create an overwhelming fight that runs them over.

Kiriko also works extremely well, as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu can negate anti-heal or crowd control that would otherwise shut Queen down mid-fight, while ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush is practially a second ult for Queen.
In ranked, where coordination can vary, Queen excels when her team commits decisively; half-engages are what punish her most.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: The most reliable way to counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen is to deny her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage range, and limit her Wound uptime. Displacement abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy-javelin.png)Energy Javelin, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot should be used every single time you see her wind up for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/carnage.png)Carnage

She struggles into poke and high-ground control compositions that force her to take chip damage before she can get into her own optimal range. Heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn, or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari can pressure her from distance, forcing her to burn Shout defensively just to close space. Once Shout is used, she has no mobility or overhealth, and becomes vulnerable to burst focus fire.

Anti-heal and disengage tools are also critical. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana’s ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade negates her lifesteal which dramatically lowers her survivability. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu can straight up make it as if ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rampage.png)Rampage never happened by healing and and cleansing all allies.

Overall, do not take extended brawls on her terms. Kite backward and wait out ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/commanding-shout.png)Commanding Shout, then go aggro. Whenever possible, position outside of her range and her value drops sharply.

Guide.title: Overview
content: Always down for a good time and looking to create chaos, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga is a walking turret who slams into enemies and mows them down with his double chainguns. If you want to laugh in the face of danger while face tanking every enemy attack, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga is the Tank for you. Between the overhealth generated by his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/berserker.png)Berserker passive and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga simply outputs more damage than the enemy can survive, while healing faster than the enemy can kill him.

He’s the ultimate Tank dueler and will win a 1v1 against every other Tank. If another Tank player doesn’t understand how to counter him, then a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga mirror is their only hope of survival. Even against small and mobile targets, players with good aim make full use of switching between Gunny and Cha-cha. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga wants to stay right up on the enemy Tank where he can stand firm and hold down both triggers. While he can’t chase enemies onto high ground, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun allows him to dominate the flat game.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Focus the enemy Tank. Double chainguns are the perfect Tank-busting weapon. Try to keep the enemy Tank close and run after them if they try to get away.

* Don’t always use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun to hard engage; go for knockdowns instead. Mix it up by cancelling mid-run to stay with your team and bait out the enemy's cooldowns.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cage-fight.png)Cage Fight prevents all movement abilities, so focus on trapping high mobility heroes.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Save your damage mitigation or mobility abilities to prevent him from damaging you during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga can’t be stopped during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun. Position out of his charge range, or prepare to dodge him.

* When he has ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cage-fight.png)Cage Fight ready, either play spread so you don’t get caught, or get everyone inside so you and your team can help each other survive the ult.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Good vs tanks
* Has self sustain
* Immune to CC
* Needs to deal damage
* No verticle mobility
* Easy to ignore

Guide.title: Tank Buster
content: No Tank wants to duel ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga. The best ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga Tank counters are those who can mitigate his damage during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive. No Tank can outdamage or out-sustain him on their own. When the enemy Tank is carrying, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga can shut them all down.

Guide.title: Self-sustain
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/berserker.png)Berserker passive constantly grants overhealth from critical hits and burning targets. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive’s life steal and damage reduction make you nearly unkillable for 3 seconds. Although he takes a lot of damage, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga has strong self-agency in managing his health pool.

Guide.title: CC immunity
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun is the only Tank ability that makes you completely unstoppable and even unable to be Hacked. You can time ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun to counter enemy stuns and interrupt some movement abilities.

Guide.title: Relies on dealing damage to survive
content: Because ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga's healing is based on damage dealt and being able to ignite enemies, abilities that mitigate damage or grant invulnerability counter him. Against teams with barriers or fast and small heroes, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga deals less damage overall, which translates into less survivability.

Guide.title: No vertical mobility
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun can be used for decent horizontal mobility, but ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga can’t deal with enemies on high ground. He can shoot them, but is then limited to single chaingun use because of the massive bullet spread using double.

Guide.title: Easy to avoid
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga's movement is very linear. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun's path can only be altered to a small degree, but when he’s firing both chainguns, he moves incredibly slowly. These make him easy to avoid, which is especially problematic given that his best ability has a short 3-second duration.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Incendiary Chaingun
content: **Tips for** Incendiary Chaingun
* Poke
* * Whenever your target is more than about 10 meters from you, or is very small, you’ll want to begin by shooting them with Gunny until you ignite them.
* Anti-flier
* * Even though the damage falloff gets pretty bad when the flier is far away, your high rate of fire and accuracy make you good at dealing with fliers.
* Once you ignite them, they have to retreat to cover because the threat of dying becomes too high.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Volatile Chaingun
content: **Tips for** Volatile Chaingun
* Auto-crit
* * The point of firing Cha-cha is to auto-crit ignited enemies. It’s free double damage and healing.
* Switch back to Gunny once the ignition duration ends.
* Team burning effects

* * Volatile Chaingun works with allied burning effects such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/torbjorn.png)Torbjörn's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/molten-core.png)Molten Core.

Guide.title: Gunny and Cha-Cha (Firing simultaneously)
content: **Tips for Gunny and Cha-Cha**
* Only for close range
* * Firing both chainguns simultaneously massively increases bullet spread. Therefore, use both only when your target is very close.
* The damage is doubled, and you can keep the target permanently ignited if they can’t shield or cleanse.
* Tank Buster

* * Gunny and Cha-Cha make ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga the Tank buster he is. Tanks' large bodies and high HP make them the perfect target. If the enemy Tank lets you stay close to them and endlessly shoot, that’s all you have to do to win.
* Walk speed

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga moves painfully slow while firing both chainguns. Enemies can shield, dance, or rotate around cover to avoid you. Whenever this occurs, you’ll need to switch back and forth between single and double chainguns to stay in range.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Overrun
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun
* Knockdown

* * Scoring a knockdown is the best use of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun because the knockdown damage and time often convert into a quick elimination.
* Unstoppable

* * Since ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga can’t be CC’d or Hacked during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun, you can purposely use it to counter enemy CC.
* He can be stunned during the brief startup animation, so you’ll need to predict the timing of enemy ability usage in some cases.
* Cancel and Circle runs

* * You shouldn’t commit to slamming into the enemy with every ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun use. You’ll just be feeding and tilting your teammates.

* Instead, contest space with the threat and pressure of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun without committing to the slam.
* Either cancel the run or keep running and circle back into your own team.
* Bait out enemy cooldowns

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun is a very short 5-second cooldown. Almost every other ability has a longer cooldown, so if the enemy reacts to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun with their cooldown in an attempt to counter, you can punish them with your next ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun.

Guide.title: [E]: Cardiac Overdrive
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive
* Manage Armor

* * Ideally, you want to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive when you still have armor health to maximize damage reduction.

* Additionally, when ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive ends, if you don’t have armor left, you’ll need to disengage and get healing.
* Wait out Tank Damage mitigation

* * A short 3-second duration and a long 12-second cooldown make ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive easy to waste.

* Track whether the enemy Tank has damage mitigation available, like a full health ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt shield, or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix. They can easily absorb all the damage you output during Cardiac, thus stopping you from gaining any lifesteal.
* Ally healing

* * Although ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive no longer grants ally damage mitigation, it still grants them lifesteal.

* When nearby allies are low on health and fighting an enemy, you can often save them with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive.

Guide.title: (Passive): Berserker
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/berserker.png)Berserker
* Keep the fire burning

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga deals more damage and heals himself faster against burning enemies, so you should always ignite people with primary fire before using secondary fire.
* At close range, firing both guns together is always best.

* Incendiary Chaingun can naturally headshot enemies. You don’t actually need to wait for someone to be on fire to benefit from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/berserker.png)Berserker.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Cage Fight
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cage-fight.png)Cage Fight
* Isolate enemies

* * The best use of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cage-fight.png)Cage Fight is to isolate one or two enemies inside your giant barrier. They’ll be cut off from their allies, and the rest of your team can safely focus on eliminating the caged foes.
* Trap high mobility enemies

* * Deal with those pesky heroes constantly outrunning you by locking them in the cage. An enemy like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist can’t even use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam while in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cage-fight.png)Cage Fight.
* Cage Fight Counters

* * Keep track of what enemy heroes have counter abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/life-grip.png)Life Grip. Wait until you’ve seen these abilities recently used before activating your ult.

* When the enemy counters ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cage-fight.png)Cage Fight with an ultimate like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence, it's better to cancel the ability and Overrun away.
* Numbers game

* * Even when using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cage-fight.png)Cage Fight, you should still ensure your team has a numbers advantage. Trapping 5 members of the enemy team backfires if it's just yourself and one other ally still in the fight.

Guide.title: Kinetic Bandolier
content: * Niche

* * In most scenarios where you’ve run out of ammo, you’ll also have used ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive and won’t have enough health to charge straight into the enemy to keep attacking.
* Plus, in these cases, you also won’t be running the full distance and therefore won’t get the max 150 ammo reloaded.
* Less downtime

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga's reload animation is much longer than most, so cutting down reload time is beneficial.
* Useful into poke and dive comps where you spend more time poking, then suddenly need to rush in.

Guide.title: Pyromaniac
content: * Adds a small burst of instant overhealth whenever you ignite an enemy. Good for survivability, and best when having to play more passively.

Guide.title: Firewalker
content: * Best Major Perk

* * Ignited enemies take 15 damage per second, and can immediately be auto-crit by Cha-Cha. Since ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga is unstoppable during Overrun, he can easily ignite multiple enemies with each use.
* Burst damage

* * Slam onto an enemy, and they're instantly ignited. If you center slam their head, you’ll even get healing from the slam's critical hit. Plus, you’ll be dealing damage faster because you don’t have to spend time igniting them with primary fire before getting in the auto-crits.

Guide.title: Combat Fuel
content: * Don’t need the extra Overhealth

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga heals himself and reduces so much damage that you won’t even notice 100 extra Overhealth during Overdrive.
* Plus, you need to land 50 critical hits in between each use? Realistically, you’ll probably be averaging 50-60 overhealth with each Cardiac use.
* Soft counter to anti-healing and damage mitigation

* * Where Combat Fuel can be useful is in matchups with anti-heal like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana nade, or Tanks who can mitigate your entire Cardiac duration. The extra overhealth could theoretically keep you alive.
* Still recommend always selecting Firewalker.

Guide.title: Maps
content: The best maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga have small but open objective areas. If the objective is broken up by too much natural cover, it's easy for the enemy to rotate around him since he moves so slowly while firing both chainguns. Other Tanks can’t go toe-to-toe with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga, so he excels on objectives that pull teams into close-range fights. The maps ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga struggles most on are those with lots of high ground, where dive comps are dominant. He has no vertical mobility, so ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun gets little to no value against enemies who can run away to high ground he can’t reach. The same can be said of maps with huge open areas where the enemy can keep their distance from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga.

Guide.title: Watchpoint
content: Gibraltar

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Team comps built around ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga can support his all-out aggressive plays. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga gets hard-focused by the enemy. Outside of a few seconds of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive's damage reduction, he has no protection from damage. Due to this, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga requires a lot of team resources to be allocated to him, so he works best with heroes who are self-sufficient. Allies also need to be able to quickly react to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga's Overrun since he sometimes uses it to bait, and sometimes goes deep for a hard engage. Lastly, the best teammates position themselves somewhat close to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive, within the 10m range.
**Example of a team comp built around Mauga:**

* **Tank**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya (for 6v6)

* **DPS**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper

* **Supports**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana

Guide.title: Individual synergies with other heroes
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe

* Although ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga doesn’t have a shield for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe to hide behind, his presence demands the full attention of the enemy team, which creates an opening for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe to snipe and throw ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite. The burning of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite also triggers Volatile Chaingun’s auto-crits. This combo is especially good against squishies because the massive burst damage of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite, combined with critical hits from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga, is very difficult for an enemy to survive. Hitting enemy Supports with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite forces out healing cooldowns and takes away sustain from their Tank.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga spends a lot of time dueling the enemy Tank in battles that are largely determined by sustain. Because he is a slow and huge bullet sponge, but he also deals high damage, fights are determined by which Tank receives more healing. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper's flank playstyle is great for harassing or assassinating the enemy’s Supports, which greatly helps ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga win the Tank duel. Additionally, when ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper is frontlining with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga, the extra lifesteal of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrivemakes them an unkillable wall of damage for 3 whole seconds.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko

* The easiest way to kill ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga is to apply an anti-heal debuff to him with an ability like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rampage.png)Rampage. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga primarily relies on lifesteal to survive, so if he gets hit with an anti-heal, he dies unless he can use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun to escape quickly. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu is the best ability to cleanse ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga of anti-heal effects and simultaneously grant him a burst of healing. On top of the cleanse, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga in Kitsune Rush just deletes enemies. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko also deals decent damage to benefit from the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive, unlike Lifeweaving, who is the only other Support with a cleanse.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: By far ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga's most important ability is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive. No matter what hero you are playing, the most important component to countering him is to negate the value of Cardiac.

You can do this by saving your damage mitigation to block during its duration (e.g., ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-shield.png)Barrier Shield, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/deflect.png)Deflect), or by using an escape tool to get away from him when you see him glowing (e.g., ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/jump-pack.png)Jump Pack, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coach-gun.png)Coach Gun).

The other thing you need to watch out for is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/overrun.png)Overrun. First off, don't get slammed. Make sure to save a mobility tool to dodge him, or play near cover where you can move out of his path. Additionally, his charge is on a very short cooldown, so make sure you are always alert and don't get caught off guard where you don't realize you are within its range.

* When you want to really shut him down hard, get an ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana to anti-heal him, and a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko to cleanse burning allies.
