content: ana
kiriko

Guide.title: Overview
content: Created to be the defender of Numbani, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa holds the front line better than anyone else. She is arguably the most difficult Tank to kill and has decent damage to go along with that survivability. While she lags way behind in mobility, her long-range damage outclasses the rest of the Tank roster. Good Orisa players learn how to cycle her cooldowns and utilize cover when waiting for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify to come back online. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa is a good choice if you want to play on the objective and constantly attack.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Rotate and maintain distance. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa should always move around the objective with her team, trying to keep the enemy team away.

* Don’t use all her abilities together. Use just ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin, then after it ends, use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify, then ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy-javelin.png)Energy Javelin. Using them together greatly reduces her survivability.

* Always play near cover. Because there will always be gaps between ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify uses, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa needs cover to hide behind to stay alive.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Ignore ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa. The best way to counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa is to avoid her and target the rest of her team. She’ll try to stop you, but she can’t chase you down.

* Wait out ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify. If you see her golden, either hide so you don’t take damage, or switch targets, and attack someone else.

* Go beams. If all else fails, the easiest way to counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa is to play a beam hero. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa is free ult charge to them.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Fortify
* Good as a counter-pick
* Ranged damage
* Vulnerable vs beams
* No team damage mitigation
* Slow and immobile

Guide.title: Fortify
content: Becoming unstoppable and reducing all incoming damage by nearly half is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa's greatest strength. She's the only tank who can simultaneously be CC immune while walking forward and attacking.

Guide.title: Great counterpick
content: Lore accurate, she counters ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist through her crowd control, and with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify's knockback immunity. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa is also an excellent counterswap to shut down ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard.

Guide.title: Ranged damage
content: Most tanks have either very low or zero long-range damage. In the poke phases of fights, or from medium to long distance, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa will be bringing more value to her team than any other Tank.

Guide.title: Vulnerable to beams
content: Because ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin does not block beam damage like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/symmetra.png)Symmetra, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa becomes weak against beams anytime she doesn't have ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify available.

Guide.title: No team damage mitigation
content: Unlike most other Tanks, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa doesn't provide any overhealth or barriers for her team. She can only absorb attacks with her own body or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin, but doesn't directly bring any extra survivability to her teammates.

Guide.title: Immobile
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa's biggest weakness is being slowed while firing, having no vertical mobility, and just a tiny bit of movement buff from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin. Heroes with a lot of mobility can simply avoid ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa, and she can't do much about it.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Augmented Fusion Driver
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/augmented-fusion-driver.png)Augmented Fusion Driver
* Keep your distance and poke

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa has better ranged damage than any other Tank. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga can compete, but with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify, his burning gun doesn’t even crit ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa anyway. Deal as much damage as possible before letting the enemy Tank close the distance on you.
* Don’t overheat
* * It’s always better to stop shooting just before overheating than to get hit with the 3-second overheated penalty.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Energy Javelin
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy-javelin.png)Energy Javelin
* Play keep away

* * Since ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa generally outranges the rest of the Tanks, she wants to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin to keep the enemy pushed back and away from her.
* Peel for your backline

* * The knockback of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy-javelin.png)Energy Javelin is a strong tool for keeping any enemy away from your backline. If you see an enemy Tank or DPS attacking your team behind you, try to hit them with the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy-javelin.png)Energy Javelin.
* Wall collisions

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/energy-javelin.png)Energy Javelin deals extra stun and damage when it knocks back the enemy into a wall. Try to take advantage of this by rotating around your target so they are between you and a wall or structure.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Fortify
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify
* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa's most important ability

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify makes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa nearly unkillable and literally unstoppable. When using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa can press forward, counter CC, and force the enemy team to fall back.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify has a long cooldown, so it’s important not to waste. Only activate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify when the enemy team has to focus you because you are being an active threat through your damage and positioning.
* Use while you still have Armor

* * Using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify while you still have armor stacks the damage reduction (up to 50%). Additionally, you’ll be more likely to still have Armor health when ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify ends if you still had some when you first activated it because of this.
* If ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify ends and you have no Armor, RUN!
* Counter Ults

* * Save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify when the enemy has stun Ultimates like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/blizzard.png)Blizzard, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/gravitic-flux.png)Gravitic Flux, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/downpour.png)Downpour, and similar.

Guide.title: [E]: Javelin Spin
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin
* Cycle with Fortify

* * Don’t use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin while using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify. You need to use these two survival tools separately, or the enemy has a massive window of time to kill ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa.
* Secure elims

* * Since ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin blocks enemy healing and damage projectiles while also CC’ing the enemy, it’s quite effective at finishing off low HP targets.

* Get between your target and their Supports, then activate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin to push them towards your team
* What doesn’t Spin block?

* * Doesn’t block beams or splash damage, and doesn’t destroy airborne deployables like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/symmetra.png)Symmetra's turrets before they land.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Terra Surge
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/terra-surge.png)Terra Surge
* How long should I charge ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/terra-surge.png)Terra Surge?
* * You need to channel ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa Ult for about 3 seconds to one-shot DPS and Supports.
* Ignores barriers
* * Slam damage cannot be blocked by barriers like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt Shield.
* Breaking LoS stops damage

* * LoS can be used to prevent damage. So any environmental structures or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mei.png)Mei and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard's walls can block the damage for example.
* Get some height

* * If ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa is above the enemy (![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform, jumping, jumping off high ground, etc.) the enemies will first be pulled all the way up to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa, then have to fall way back down to the ground before being able to walk away.
* Always jump before activating, but whenever possible, use the payload or environment to get extra height.

Guide.title: Defense Protocol
content: * Makes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/terra-surge.png)Terra Surge an ok panic button. The healing will help you take more damage, and can save you when you are at low health.

Guide.title: Mobile Fortification
content: * Very powerful and enables aggressive play when ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa is already at her most powerful. Feels unstoppable to the enemy team.

Guide.title: Charged Javelin
content: * Match up dependent

* * Against ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga, it could be considered the better Major Perk since it can be used to help counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive.

* Against ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya, deploy a barrier anytime she uses bubble to block her damage and relieve the pressure of needing to break her barrier and charge her.

* In theory, you can use the Barrier to block ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra's ult LoS and try to end it early. The 600HP barrier may not survive long enough to rely on this tech, however.
* Double Barrier tip
* * When on defense or when the enemy team is returning from spawn, shoot the Barrier straight up. By the time it lands, you’ll only have 3 seconds before your next Barrier.

Guide.title: Protective Barrier
content: * Match up dependent

* * Against ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga, it could be considered the better Major Perk since it can be used to help counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive.

* Against ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya, deploy a barrier anytime she uses bubble to block her damage and relieve the pressure of needing to break her barrier and charge her.

* In theory, you can use the Barrier to block ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra's ult LoS and try to end it early. The 600HP barrier may not survive long enough to rely on this tech, however.
* Double Barrier tip
* * When on defense or when the enemy team is returning from spawn, shoot the Barrier straight up. By the time it lands, you’ll only have 3 seconds before your next Barrier.

Guide.title: Maps
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa is always going to be a good choice on maps that favor poke comps. An objective area with wide-open space and long, straight payload routes that play into her strengths. Because she’s very tanky, she’s not bad on small maps either, but it makes it harder for her to execute her keepaway game plan. She can contest high ground with her ranged damage, but she can’t ever access the high ground herself, so she’s also at a disadvantage on maps with lots of high ground that favor dive comps.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Pair ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa with other poke heroes and shut down the enemy team before they can even get close to your team. She's also an excellent protector, so when the enemy team is running dive or rush, she can be a nuisance to them, stop all CC, knock them around, and keep her team safe to attack freely.

Since she's pretty stationary, it's easy for Supports like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari to keep her health nice and full.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: To counter Orisa, you need to exploit gaps in her cooldown cycles. She's virtually unkillable if she has ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/javelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin available. If you see her use both of these cooldowns, you have a short window where she's vulnerable. Go aggressive quickly before the Fortify cooldown refreshes.

In order to pull this off, you need to have the resources still available after she's used hers. Therefore, as soon as you see her activate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify, focus on defending, backing up, and saving cooldowns. Then, you will have everything you need to punish her and win the fight.

Guide.title: Overview
content: The leader of Talon and the main villain of Overwatch is also the main villain of every backline. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist is one of the best disruptors and harassers in the entire game. Equipped with multiple movement abilities, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist is hard to lock down and can jump on you at a moment's notice.

His knockback and AoE damage make it hard to advance on him, but his mobility allows him to easily approach you. Oftentimes, the only way players can shut down a skilled ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist player is by running multiple direct counters and heroes with lots of crowd control.
He’s not the best at contesting the objective or frontlining choke points, but his ability to assassinate the enemy's backline more than makes up for those weaknesses.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Use your superior mobility to quickly get in and get out. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist should constantly disrupt the enemy and get in the way of their attacks.

* Always save one ability (Punch, Slam, or Block) to survive or disengage from your dive. Dumping all three into a team with full health just results in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist feeding.

* Track enemy stuns like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart, and either Slam Cancel Power Block to dodge or don’t Block unless you’ve already seen the stun used.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * While he’s blocking or charging ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, stun him. He’s sitting still, and cancelling his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-block.png)Power Block is the best method for eliminating ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist.

* Dodge his engage attack. Keep track of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist and watch for when he’s coming in with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch. If you dodge his initial attack, he misses out on overhealth and will have to reset.

* To counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist, play heroes with stuns or high mobility heroes who can evade him. If you can’t run away or stun him, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist will harass you all game.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Mobile
* CC
* Disruption tools
* Vulnerable to CC
* Melee
* Hard to play

Guide.title: Hyper-mobile
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist has frequent mobility tools that he can use for both horizontal and vertical movement. Nowhere is safe from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist. He can rapidly traverse the map, bypass the enemy frontline, or retreat to safety.

Guide.title: Crowd Control
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch is on a short 4-second cooldown and can be instantly refreshed by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-block.png)Power Block. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist has more frequent knockback than any other hero. He’s great at controlling space by repeatedly displacing the enemy.

Guide.title: Disruption
content: Even when ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist doesn’t get the kill, his presence is extremely disruptive. When he’s diving a hero or group of enemies, they have to use their cooldowns to counterattack. He takes up a lot of attention, and during that distracted time, the rest of his team has greater opportunities to make big plays of their own.

Guide.title: Vulnerable to stuns
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-block.png)Power Block has damage reduction, but Doom has no way of actually blocking stuns. During his channelled abilities, he’s barely moving and is an easy target. Since his best moves are movement-based, landing a stun on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist shuts him down hard.

Guide.title: Melee hero
content: The main limiting factor of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist's kit is that he is primarily a melee hero. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hand-cannon.png)Hand Cannon gives him a bit of range and poke, but it’s more of a supplemental ability to increase the lethality of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist has to get in super close, and that exposes him to a lot of danger.

Guide.title: High skill ceiling
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist is one of those heroes that only shines in the hands of a committed one-trick. If you are just casually playing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist and he’s not your main, be prepared to have a lot of rough games. He has a multitude of hero-specific tech, and players need to have high game sense to read and track enemy resources.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Hand Cannon
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hand-cannon.png)Hand Cannon
* Range

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hand-cannon.png)Hand Cannon’s effective range is about 10 meters. Farther than that, the pellets are too spread out and the damage falloff begins to kick in as well.
* Poke and prefire

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hand-cannon.png)Hand Cannon can be used to get in a bit of poke damage before committing to a dive engagement.

* Always fire off one or two ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hand-cannon.png)Hand Cannon before ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punching or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slamming to chip down the enemy's health and deal more overall damage.
* Auto-reloads
* * Keep an eye on your ammo because your primary fire auto-reloads anytime you aren’t firing it.

* There is a brief cooldown after using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hand-cannon.png)Hand Cannon before it begins reloading, so if you need more ammo, don’t fire any shots.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Rocket Punch
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch
* Engage with Punch

* * The short cooldown and refresh on Empowered ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch make ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch better for engaging than ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam when you don’t need ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam's verticality.
* Hitting a stun on your first attack also makes your follow-up easier.
* Wall slams

* * You should always be trying to line up the enemies with walls or structures behind them. You can strafe or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam into position, then ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch into a wall.
* Hold onto empowered

* * When you have Empowered ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, cancel with primary fire or by using another ability if you don’t have a good target. It’s important not to waste Empowered ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Seismic Slam
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam
* Get into position

* * Slam is great for jumping over walls or the enemy team to get into position for a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch.
* Just make sure you end up behind cover or somewhere the enemy team can’t kill you if you use both in abilities in a row like this.
* Get out

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam's fast speed and capability for vertical, diagonal and horizontal movement make it really good for getting out of dangerous positions.
* After Punching or Blocking, you’ll often need to Slam away so you can stay alive then hard engage after the enemies' resources are low.
* Slam cancel

* * Activating Block or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch before during your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam will cancel the ability but keep the momentum. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam vertically, then cancel and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist will go flying into the air.

Guide.title: [E]: Power Block
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-block.png)Power Block
* How to increase Empowered rates

* * Wait until the enemy is already attacking. Don’t preemptively ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-block.png)Power Block, hoping the enemy will start attacking you.

* Block slow travel speed projectiles like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fire-strike.png)Fire Strike and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-launcher.png)Rocket Launcher. You have enough time to block these types of projectiles after seeing they’ve been fired at you.
* Create pressure. If you’re being a huge threat to the enemy team, they’ll be focus firing at you which results in more damage to Block.
* Bait stuns
* * Cancel with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam when you know the enemy is going to try and stun you.

* Example: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart cooldown is twice as long as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-block.png)Power Block and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam. Therefore, you can use Block, Slam to the side before Sleep hits you, then have both abilities back before ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana has another ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart.
* Tank high damage ults

* * Staying alive is actually the main use of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-block.png)Power Block. If you don’t have your movement to dodge, use Block to tank high burst damage attacks like Pulse Bomb.

Guide.title: (Passive): The Best Defense…
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/the-best-defense.png)The Best Defense...
* Overhealth

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist can generate up to 200 overhealth. This is easiest with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/meteor-strike.png)Meteor Strike because it generates more shields per enemy hit.

* Generating temporary shields is the key to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist's survival. Carefully aim your abilities to ensure you are constantly gaining the overhealth. If you don’t, you’ll need to disengage much sooner.
* Decay
* * Overhealth doesn’t decay until after 3 seconds, and the decay is slow.
* Don’t rush just because you have overhealth. You still have time to carefully plan out your attack path and target.
* Only generated when dealing ability damage
* * Overhealth doesn’t generate from ability use, but only ability damage.

* Example: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch being collision canceled by another knockdown ability (Charge, Bash, Punch, B.O.B.) generates no overhealth.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Meteor Strike
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/meteor-strike.png)Meteor Strike
* Refresh cooldowns and health
* * Unless there is a tight group of low HP enemies, it's always better to hold off on activating the Strike until your health and cooldowns have recovered.
* Read movement
* * Wait and watch your target to see how they are moving. They know you are in ult and will try to dodge. Predict which direction they are moving and select that location.
* Get ready to dodge

* * Against enemies with projectile stuns, they often try to hit ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist as soon as he lands. In these matchups consider Slamming away as soon as you land.
* Zoom in vs zoom out

* * When zoomed in, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist stays on his current ground level or drops to the lowest available ground.
* When zoomed out, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist will instead move onto the highest targeted floor.

Guide.title: One-Two
content: * Quick Punch

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist starts to auto reload while charging ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, so One-Two makes the biggest difference on primary fire uses when not full charging ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch.

* Dump all ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hand-cannon.png)Hand Cannon ammo into the enemy, quick ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch into a wall, finish them off with the refreshed primary fire, Slam away.
* Great with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch

* * Because you don’t have to spend time charging Empowered ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, One-Two gives you rapid burst damage potential.

Guide.title: Survival of the Fittest
content: * A bit weaker overall than One-Two
* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist gets plenty of elims

* * Because he has AoE abilities, and your team follows up on your engages, most kills by your team will have some damage assist from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist and count as an elim for the extra overhealth.
* Not good if your team is getting rolled
* * On the occasion you need more solo play-making potential, One-Two would be better to take.
* When your team isn’t getting a lot of elims, you won’t get much benefit from choosing Survival of the Fittest

Guide.title: Aftershock
content: * The problem with Aftershock is that you have to give up Power Matrix. Only choose this perk if the enemy team has no projectile stuns.
* Engage with Slam so you get easy follow-up shots during the slow. Ideally, you'll already have an empowered punch so you can finish for an easy KO.

Guide.title: Power Matrix
content: * Best Major Perk
* Creates new counterplay

* * Previously, we stated ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist is particularly weak against stuns. Power Matrix gives him counterplay against stuns. As long as he times correctly, Power Matrix absorbs and negates all projectiles.
* Shares Defensive Matrix counters

* * Unfortunately, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist is not totally invulnerable during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/power-block.png)Power Block. Abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog Hook, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion still counter Power Matrix.

Guide.title: Maps
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist and his incredible mobility are best utilized on maps where teams tend to play spread out. The only thing he requires is natural cover to rotate around. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist typically takes space in chunks so long sight lines and wide open areas are difficult for him. Tight areas with lots of walls and structures give him more opportunities for wall slams off ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch which greatly raises his overall impact. Additionally, his knockback is quite far so maps with nearby ledges give him the chance for environmental kills.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Ideal team comps built around ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist take advantage of his explosive playstyle. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist's gameplay loop constantly shifts between engaging and disengaging. Heroes with similar styles or who have high value burst abilities are the best pairings.

Essentially, every ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist comp utilizes a dive playstyle that anchors on his attacks. Thanks to his block and bonus health, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist is rather self sufficient so he doesn't demand a lot of healing resources which opens up more flexibility for Support pairings.

Guide.title: Individual synergies with other heroes
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya (6v6 Game Modes)

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist complement each other's kits really well in 6v6 formats. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist's aggressive dives become more lethal and consistent when protected by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier. If the enemy can't CC ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist when he's punching in because of the bubble, he's very difficult to shut down. Their ults are also a great combo since ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge holds the enemy in place for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist to slam on.

* They play split up, where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya holds down the front line and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist harasses the backline.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji

* The only thing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist need to cart games is a bit of coordination. As long as they can time their attacks and target the same enemy, they can quickly earn their team the numbers advantage. Alternatively, one can follow the other after the enemy team uses their defensive resources to survive the first attack.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana's ranged healing and damage can assist ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist in his deep dives. Whenever she lands an anti, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist should be able to secure the kill unless the enemy uses an invincibility or cleanse.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist is also a great nano target and can get multiple kills during the boost. Lastly, anytime ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana sleeps someone and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist has ult, that's a guaranteed kill.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: To counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist, crowd control is practically required. The way to play around Doom without stuns is if you have the mobility to constantly avoid him. Considering his mobility is among the best in the game, this is easier said than done.

Never shoot him while he's blocking unless he is currently under roughly 20% HP, or has no Supports nearby that can heal him. Simply not giving him empowered punch is the best way to survive his attacks.
The easiest time to stun him is during his block. If he starts to bait this by canceling his block into slam and dodging your moves, it's a mind game to see who will waste their abilities.

The other best time is while he channels ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, or immediately after he uses ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/seismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam since you know he won't be able to suddenly move unless he uses his ultimate.

Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran is a Dive-oriented DPS who uses a combination of burst damage and damage over time attacks. Her kit is very combo-heavy, as none of her abilities are designed to be used in isolation from the rest of her kit.

Mobility and ability combos are the tools ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran has at her disposal to outplay the enemy. She has good damage potential, but needs to be at medium-close range, where she can attack with her secondary fan and fade. Off angles and flanks are where she should be spending most of her time. Similar to other flank DPS heroes, she finds the most success by using her mobility to bypass the enemies' frontline and isolate the targets that are behind the rest of their team.

If you enjoy heroes with high skill expression, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran is an excellent choice going into the brand new Season 1 of Overwatch.

Guide.title: Playing As
content: * Alternate between 2 Primary Fire > 1 Secondary Fire, to maximize DPS.

* Only use one ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dancing-blaze.png)Dancing Blaze dash to attack, and always save one charge to escape fights and survive.
* Both Ults are valuable. Although it’s better to secure elims with Ascent, bringing yourself immediately back into the fight and helping your team win is a great use of the revive ult.

Guide.title: Playing Against
content: * Heroes with the mobility and range to stay outside of the 10m range of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fan-the-flames.png)Fan the Flames have an advantage in the match-up.

* Crowd Control and stuns are very effective for shutting down ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran's rush. Target her and finish her off when she tries to escape.

* Quickly target ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran during her ult. If she’s at low HP or takes a second to aim, you can eliminate her while she’s channeling ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vermillion-ascent.png)Vermillion Ascent.

Guide.title: Strengths
content: * High survivability thanks to mobility, dodge, and self-healing abilities.
* Good combination of damage over time from burning, and burst damage from combos.

Guide.title: Weaknesses
content: * Needs to stay within the short range of her secondary fire to maintain high DPS output. Many heroes have the tools to make this a very difficult task.
* Mechanically challenging. Requires the capability to quickly chain ability combos, track burning duration, and control quick rush speed.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * High survivability
* Good DoT and burst damage
* Short ranged
* Mechanically difficult
* Weak to Crowd Control

Guide.title: High survivability
content: High survivability thanks to mobility, dodge, and self-healing abilities. Although she has to play at closer ranges, her kit comes with plenty of tools to stay alive.

Guide.title: Good DoT and burst
content: Good combination of damage over time from burning, and burst damage from combos. While many heroes have one or the other, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran has multiple methods of getting eliminations.

Guide.title: Short ranged
content: Needs to stay within the short range of her secondary fire to maintain high DPS output. Many heroes have the tools to make this a very difficult task. Against other highly mobile heroes, it can be difficult to chase. When the enemy is running longer ranged hitscans, getting into position is dangerous.

Guide.title: Difficult to play
content: Mechanically challenging. Requires the capability to quickly chain ability combos, track burning duration, and control quick rush speed.

Guide.title: Weak to Crowd Control
content: Stuns are especially good at shutting her down. Other than a perfectly timed![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dancing-blaze.png)Dancing Blaze, she's completely vulnerable to getting chain-stunned to death.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Zhuque Fans
content: **Tips for** Zhuque Fans

* Best ranged damage tool. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/zhuque-fans.png)Zhuque Fans have no falloff damage and igniting some at range is a solid method of building ult charge.
* Even when you are trying to set up a flank, you should still be trying to get in as much poke damage as possible while repositioning.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Fan the Flames
content: **Tips for** Fan the Flames
* Short range and low base DPS. Only use to ignite, or to keep enemies ignited.

* Deals 25% ignition, same as primary fire body shots. When the enemy ignition UI is at 75%, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fan-the-flames.png)Fan the Flames will simultaneously ignite and trigger amplified burning damage.

* You can HOLD primary fire, and tap secondary fire to animation cancel the recovery of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/zhuque-fans.png)Zhuque Fans and min/max your damage output.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Inferno Rush
content: **Tips for** Inferno Rush

* Treat Rush like a dash or jump. The initial boost can be aimed vertically, but during the rush, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran cannot gain additional height.

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/inferno-rush.png)Inferno Rush is her best escape tool. When near high ground or walls, jump+SHIFT while aiming up to quickly boost yourself over the wall to safety.

* One charge for engage, one for disengage. Since you have two boosts available and want to be within Fan’s range, your go-to combat loop should be to use the first charge to pounce the enemy. Try to get the KO or at least get their team to use multiple cooldowns, then use your E to buy time, and SHIFT to get out.
* * Never use both dashes offensively unless your entire team is grouped and committed to fighting the same target as you.

Guide.title: [E]: Dancing Blaze
content: **Tips for** Dancing Blaze
* Requires precise timing. The base duration is less than 1 second, so you’ll need to be very precise with your activation timing.

* * Try not to preemptively activate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dancing-blaze.png)Dancing Blaze. Instead, watch the opponent and react to their ability animations to dodge their attack.

* Slight movement control during the dodge. Even though it’s not much, moving to a different spot during the invisibility is very important to make it difficult for the enemy to instantly attack you upon reappearing.

* Best in crowds. If you are within range of multiple opponents, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran will continue attacking each target once, resulting in her staying invulnerable for longer.
* * However, this does not increase her movement range.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Vermillion Ascent and Vermillion Revival
content: **Tips for** Vermillion Ascent

* Not invincible. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran can be killed while channeling ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vermillion-ascent.png)Vermillion Ascent. Make sure you have enough health (~175HP+) to survive long enough to aim and charge forward.
* Huge AoE. Check the visual indicator to verify which enemies will be in the explosion radius.
* * Although there is falloff damage from the center of impact, all enemies hit will be 100% ignited.

* Always follow up your Ult with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fan-the-flames.png)Fan the Flames to quickly amplify burning damage.
* The dive goes pierces through barriers, but the actual explosion can be blocked. Make sure you wait out barrier abilities before activating her Ult.
* Combo tool.

* * Think of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vermillion-ascent.png)Vermillion Ascent as just one part of a combo. You can either start the combo with it, or use it mid-combo. The dive is not an instant-win or instakill button. To get high value, you’ll need to quickly land primary and secondary fires along with the Ult.
**Tips For** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vermillion-revival.png)Vermillion Revival
* If you die near enemies, wait until your team pushes up to create a safe revival space for you. When they are unable to, save your Ult charge for your next life.

* Not a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va Bomb. Although ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran explodes upon revival, the burst damage is very low. Be very cautious when reviving, as you’ll need to quickly evade or burst down nearby targets with your secondary and primary fire.
* * Use as much of the allowed.

Guide.title: Flanker Passive
content: **Tips for** Flanker **Passive**

* Between her movement, dodge, Ult, and subrole passive, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran is quite self-sufficient. Always keep a mental note of where nearby health packs are located, and try to track whether someone else has already grabbed them.
* Especially when flanking behind enemy lines, grabbing a health pack will often make the difference between

Guide.title: Smoulder
content: * Extends the time of burning.
* Does **not** extend ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fan-the-flames.png)Fan the Flames amplified damage time.
* Useful for extending damage on enemies that retreat to cover. Will sometimes score an elim where the enemy could’ve just barely lived otherwise.
* Further delays the self-healing passive from activating.

Guide.title: Heat Shield
content: * Turns ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vermillion-ascent.png)Vermillion Ascent into a survival tool. The large AoE makes it consistent and realistic to expect to hit multiple targets per use.
* Enables more aggressive use of your ult. Hitting 2 targets, for example, generates 150 overhealth.
* Use the overhealth generation mid-fight to as a form of healing, or at the start of an attack to make yourself more tanky.
* Recommended Minor Perk.

Guide.title: Short Fuse
content: * Rushing through multiple targets in a scrambly fight is a great way to spread burning, inflict damage, and evade damage.
* Hitting the same target twice counts as double cooldown reduction (3s total).
* Be smart about where you position yourself when the Rush ends. You’d have to get 6 impacts to fully refresh the Rush if you don’t have either charge up.

Guide.title: Hungering Blaze
content: * Extremely potent survival ability.

* Being in range of multiple enemies is even more important when using Hungering Blaze. As mentioned under Ability Tips, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran will stay invulnerable for longer and additionally heal herself more.
* Recommended Major Perk.

Guide.title: Maps
content: On _Control_ and _Flashpoint_maps (e.g., Nepal, Lijiang Tower, Suravasa), ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran thrives by leveraging verticality and flank routes to harass isolated enemies and secure early picks. She needs to use a get-in-get out strategy on these smaller maps or else the enemy team can peel for her target, then focus fire her to a quick death.

On _Escort_, _Hybrid,_ and _Push_ maps (e.g., New Queen Street, Dorado, Colosseo), use her mobility to similarly threaten Supports and DPS set up in the backlines of their team. The more linear layout of these maps merits longer poke phases compared to the two previous modes.

Anran’s kit rewards players who can read team rotations, abuse environmental cover to be difficult to predict or eliminate, and punish enemies whose anti-dive abilites are on cooldown (E.G., ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/flashbang.png)Flashbang, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade).

Because ranged combat is her primary weakness, on maps with long sightlines like Midtown and Circuit Royal, she gets outclassed by hitscans like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: The best Tanks to have on your team are able to use damage mitigation to help you stay alive, or can follow up on your engages. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya can give ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/projected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier to allow Anran to slip behind enemies, and safely attack without being CC'd. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va can fly in with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix and her burst damage for a coordinated dive assassination.

Since ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran lacks consistent pressure from her damage, she can also works well with heroes such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/soldier-76.png)Soldier: 76 or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy who can constantly apply poke pressure and can follow up on Anran's dive from range.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Crowd control such as slows, stuns, or displacements are the best ways to coutner ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran during her attacks. Kocking her back is good to disrupt her attack, or get out of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fan-the-flames.png)Fan the Flames range. If you can stun her out of her dash or immediately when she reappears after ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dancing-blaze.png)Dancing Blaze, you should be able to get the elimination.

Movement and the use of cover to prevent her from repeatedly landing hits makes it difficult for her to keep up burning damage on you. Once her burn gauge resets, she struggles to re-establish pressure.

High-burst DPS such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy, or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/vendetta.png)Vendetta can intercept Anran before she can be effectice. They also excel at finishing her off during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/inferno-rush.png)Inferno Rush or after ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dancing-blaze.png)Dancing Blaze.

Don't forget to keep an eye on her death location when you hear her use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/vermillion-revival.png)Vermillion Revival, becuase she can be an easy kill if she's located away from her team.
