Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion is the tanky ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank-buster DPS of Overwatch who can be incredibly frustrating to play against due to a combination of high damage and high survivability.

He can quickly shred through the large health pool of any ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank, or rapidly destroy their barrier health. When his team can protect him and sustain him through enemy damage, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion feels unstoppable as he takes over lobbies. Grenade jumps give him the flexibility to reposition and go for creative surprise attacks.

The disparity between the damage output of Recon and Assault Configurations is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion's main weakness. Both teams attempt to outplay the other by minimizing or maximizing the value he can get from each turret use.

Guide.title: Playing As
content: * Use allies and cover for protection during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion deals incredibly high damage but is not invincible.

* When you see an enemy is going to be hit by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/a-36-tactical-grenade.png)A-36 Tactical Grenade explosion, be ready to track them during the knockback for easy kills.
* Always pause after firing the first shell to see where the enemy is trying to escape to. Use the 2nd and 3rd shells to follow their movement and trap them to confirm the kill.

Guide.title: Playing Against
content: * Turret form only lasts for 6 seconds. Most of the time, your best play is to hide and wait for a few seconds. Don’t peek or else you’ll be killed or have to waste resources to not die.

* Attack aggressively after his turret mode ends. His damage is low in Recon so you can ignore him and target his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports during his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault cooldown.

* Heroes with damage mitigation to shut down his turret form, or the mobility to outrun him, are the best counters. The key to beating ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion comps is to minimize the value he gets from each ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault use.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Good vs tanks
* Tanky DPS
* AoE lockdown
* Dependent on cooldowns
* Fat and immobile
* Easy to dodge ultimate

Guide.title: Tank buster
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion is the best hero in all of Overwatch when it comes to deleting ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks. He can melt through a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya bubble and kill her before she gets another or can run away. Many ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank players feel forced to swap to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion-specific counters and off their mains. The team with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion will always win the tank duel because his damage is too high to heal through without ults.

Guide.title: Tanky DPS
content: The most health in the DPS roster, armor health, passive damage reduction, and he hides his head hitbox behind him while in turret form. In standard modes, he also has access to two self-sustaining abilities. This survivability helps ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion be a good dive counter because dive heroes simply can’t kill him fast enough.

Guide.title: Area lockdown
content: Grenade, Assault mode, and Artillery ult all excel at taking control of areas and sight lines. Grenade’s large explosion radius forces enemies to run away, and the high damage of Assault mode makes standing in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion's LoS too dangerous. Whenever the enemy is trying to contest the objective, his ult is excellent for blowing up anyone who wants to stay on point.

Guide.title: Dependent on a single cooldown
content: The enemy team only has to plan their strategy around ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault. If they have the means to deal with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion during his turret form, winning the team fight becomes rather easy. @![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion players who waste the cooldown leave their team exposed and at a major offensive disadvantage.

Guide.title: Large and slow
content: Turret form is a double edged sword. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion deals high damage but moves very slowly which makes him easy to kill. Even after his size reduction in Season 17, he still has a larger hitbox than most non-Tank heroes. He has the survivability needed to make up for it, but he can also end up feeding enemy ult charge, and get burst down by projectiles.

Guide.title: Ultimate is easy for most heroes to avoid
content: Other than heroes with no escape abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta, most heroes have the necessary tools to avoid ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion ult after they hear the audio cue. Unless you combo with an allies stun, his ult is difficult to get kills with against many team comps.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Configuration: Recon
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-recon.png)Configuration: Recon
* Be proactive
* * Just because you aren’t in the high damage turret form doesn’t mean you should passively wait around. While in Recon mode, still focus on poking and pressuring the enemy.
* Stay with your team and near cover

* * While ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault is on cooldown, you are more vulnerable. If you are in Recon only because you don’t have turret available, stay further back with your team because the enemy will be looking to suddenly attack.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: A-36 Tactical Grenade
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/a-36-tactical-grenade.png)A-36 Tactical Grenade
* Nade Jump
* * Shoot the Grenade at ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion's feet, and the explosion will launch him into the air.
* Useful to take high ground positions, run away from the enemy, or to get into attacking position with Assault mode,
* Use the Knockback
* * Purposely use Grenade’s knockback for easy follow-up damage. The enemy will briefly be locked into an aerial movement arc, which makes them easy to track.
* Cut off Backline
* * Shooting Grenade at the enemy's backline forces them to move away because of the AoE damage.
* Landing a hit will damage them and cause them to retreat for healing.

* Even if you miss, the threat of the Grenade still makes space. When trying to kill the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank, a Grenade at their ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports trying to heal them is the best way to get the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank kill.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Reconfigure
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/reconfigure.png)Reconfigure
* When to Transform into Assault
* * Counter enemy approach
* * When the enemy has committed to trying to move into your team, Assault mode can push them back.
* Exposed target to kill
* * Anytime an enemy is far from cover or has no way to quickly protect themselves, transform into Assault mode and shred them.
* When to Transform into Recon
* * Start Assault cooldown sooner
* * After transforming, the entire enemy team falls back and you have no targets, you can cancel to transform back into Recon and get the cooldown started faster.
* To run
* * When you are being overwhelmed by enemy pressure, go back into Recon so you can run away faster.

Guide.title: (During Reconfigure) Primary fire: Configuration: Assault
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault
* Tank buster

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks either need to use up all their damage mitigation abilities to survive a turret-ing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion, or they die.

* Assault mode is your best anti-tank tool, because of how easy it is to hold down fire and unload high damage into ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks.
* Especially against ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks who don’t have multiple damage mitigation abilities.
* Control sight lines

* * While ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion is in Assault mode, the threat of instant death makes every enemy hero hesitant to peek.
* Whenever your team needs to take over a sightline, go into the turret and suppress anyone who stays in your LoS.
* Stay near cover

* * Just because you have incredible damage and decent survivability doesn’t mean you're invincible. The most important key to being a good ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion player is staying alive. Always keep a corner partially covering your body or close enough to dip behind when your life gets low.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Configuration: Artillery
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-artillery.png)Configuration: Artillery
* Combos

* * The easiest way to guarantee value and elims is to combo your ult with any type of ally stun. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/gravitic-flux.png)Gravitic Flux, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/earthshatter.png)Earthshatter, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/terra-surge.png)Terra Surge, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/blizzard.png)Blizzard are all good examples of ults that CC the enemy and give ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion guaranteed Artillery hits.
* Shot placement and timing
* * The first shot alerts your target and forces them to move. Use the next two shots to track and predict their movement.
* Target selection
* * Two outer ring hits will kill any DPS and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Support, so they should be your choices.

* Heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana never have escapes, so they are always a free target.
* Bait out escape abilities

* * When targeting a hero with an escape ability like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade, either wait until you see their ability used or bait it out.

* Ex: Use only one shot on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira to bait out ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade. Once you see where she moved to, you can then use your 2nd and 3rd shots to get the kill.

Guide.title: (Passive): Ironclad
content: **Tips for Ironclad**

* Between Armor Health, 20% damage reduction, and no frontal head hitbox in Assault mode, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion can tank a lot of damage for a DPS hero.

Guide.title: Configuration Reload
content: * Purposely use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/a-36-tactical-grenade.png)A-36 Tactical Grenade before activating ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault, and again before its duration ends.
* Grenade is really good for burst damage and for pressuring enemies hiding behind corners out of your LoS.
* This is generally the go-to Minor Perk, and Armored Artillery is more of a counter-pick.

Guide.title: Armored Artillery
content: * Good against dive
* * When multiple heroes full dive you and you can’t run away, the overhealth can save your life and force the enemy to retreat.
* Activate ult and instantly drop one on your body and on your attackers. If allies are nearby, this should buy them enough time to peel for you.

Guide.title: Lindholm Explosives
content: * Even better for pressuring backlines

* * The splash damage forces ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports not only to retreat, but also hide way behind cover where they won’t get hit by the splash damage. This extra space often allows your team to kill the other enemies that are not outside of their Support's LoS.
* Damage difference
* * Lower single-target damage per second output, in exchange for AoE damage.

Guide.title: Self-Repair
content: * Greatly increased survivability

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion is already quite tanky and with Self-Repair, he feels impossible to kill for many heroes. Primarily use to heal yourself to help out your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports and get yourself back to full health quicker.
* Increase uptime
* * During Assault mode, the enemy will target you if they don’t run away. Alternate between healing and firing so you don’t have to fully disengage.
* Counter dive by pairing with Armored Artillery

* * Against full dive comps, running these two perks give ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion the self-sustain required to survive dive attacks by multiple enemies simultaneously.

Guide.title: Best Maps
content: The best maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion favor medium-ranged fights. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion doesn’t want flankers and melee heroes to get close to him, but he also doesn’t want long-range heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hanzo.png)Hanzo to have the advantage at long ranges. He wants to position on high ground whenever possible, and can access most areas with Grenade jumps. Map areas with multiple flank routes are difficult for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion since he’s best at firing in a straight line down one sight line. Maps with long, narrow hallway-like sightlines are the perfect spots for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion to set up in Assault configuration.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Team comps built around ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion keep him alive and attacking throughout his Assault mode. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks who can directly protect him with damage mitigation are the best fit. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports with high amounts of burst healing or some form of invincibility enable ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion to play turret super aggressively. For DPS, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion benefits most from heroes who can flank and pull attention in a direction opposite of himself. His team should look to play around his turret form just as the enemy team does. When ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion goes into turret, the entire team presses the attack.

Guide.title: Individual Hero Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma's Barrier and Grasp can be cycled to protect ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion from damage and crowd control. He can also use his shield to cut off the enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank from their ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Support's healing to make it easier for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion to kill the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank. When both heroes have their ults, place all shots just before ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma slams everyone down and you’ll instantly kill everyone caught in the Flux.

* If ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma lands an ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion stun while ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion is turreting, that enemy is basically guaranteed to die.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji flanks and dives the backline while ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion stays with the rest of their team and pressures the attack from main. The split attention is very difficult for enemy teams to deal with. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji easily kills ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports if they don’t get peel, but ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion will delete the frontline if everyone is turning around to help with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports. Additionally, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji's deflect can be used to protect ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion if he’s turretting while boosted by a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Support ult like Nano.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste

* Bap is the perfect ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Support for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion because ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion's large body and slow movement make it easy for Bap to land direct hits with his healing projectiles. When ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion gets into danger, throw lamp on him and he’ll likely kill the enemy before they have time to break the lamp and kill ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion. Also, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion utilizes the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/amplification-matrix.png)Amplification Matrix better than any other hero. Assault mode through the window melts anyone who can’t instantly escape.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Although some players main ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion, most often you'll see him used as a counter pick against Tanks like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston.

If you want to get into the rock-paper-scissors, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma are good Tanks to counter Bastion.

The main thing you have to worry about when playing against a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault. By comparison his lethality is very low in recon mode.

To get him to waste his turret form, soft engage, or push up without using long cooldowns, then back off when he ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/reconfigure.png)Reconfigures. Be patient, because turret mode only lasts for 6 seconds. Don’t peek or else you’ll be killed or have to waste resources to not die.

Attack aggressively after his turret mode ends. His damage is low in Recon so you can ignore him and target his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports during his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault cooldown.

Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja is a hybrid sniper hero who excels in poke battles and quick bursts of aggression. She likes to position either behind her frontline Tank or take a soft flank angle. Especially when there is high ground nearby the objective area, Freja looks to use Updraft to take the superior position on the enemy team.

She can hold her own in close-range battles as well, thanks to the short cooldown on her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/quick-dash.png)Quick Dash. When your team needs a combination of poke pressure and burst damage, Freja is one of the best DPS choices for the job.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Use Updraft to leap over walls and barriers, allowing you to attack enemies the rest of your team can't reach.
* Save at least one Quick Dash charge to dodge enemy flanks and dives.
* Focus on landing direct hits with Bola Shot to gain the Hindered and pull-in effects.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Freja excels at focusing down one target, but is weak when there are multiple enemies. Position near your allies so you don’t end up in a 1v1 situation.
* If you see her use Updraft, know you have a 10-second window where she can’t target you behind cover or run away to high ground (unless she's using Rising Winds).
* Counter Freja by outranging her with a hitscan sniper, or overwhelming her with a close-range, high mobility hero.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Mobile
* Burst
* Debuff abilities
* Sniper
* Situational Ultimate
* Easy to counter

Guide.title: High Mobility
content: Up to three charges of Quick Dash, vertical leap, and the float effect from Take Aim give Freja some of the best in-class mobility. The ability to dash, float, and leap synergizes well with her crossbow kit and allows her to take side angles, shoot over barriers, and disengage quickly.

Guide.title: Burst Damage
content: The explosive bolt from Take Aim deals 130 damage on a direct hit, and even without perks, Freja can fire three in a row with Dash refreshes. While she won’t always have the most consistent damage, when it matters most, she can burst down a single enemy very quickly.

Guide.title: Debuff Abilities
content: Her Minor Perk, Frost Bolts, applies a 20% slow debuff on targets and greatly helps to even the odds against high mobility enemies. Moreover, while it's not explicitly stated in the ability description, Bola Shot direct hits apply Hindered debuff to the enemy. Freja can use her ult to movement lock or cancel channeled abilities of an enemy and turn the tide of a fight in her team's favor.

Guide.title: Travel Projectile Sniper
content: Freja’s kit is best suited for medium to long-range combat. Landing shots with her primary and secondary fire at these longer ranges becomes more difficult because of the travel speed. She shares similar weaknesses to Hanzo, but trades the ability to one-shot for more consistent damage.

Guide.title: Situational Ultimate
content: Unlike many of the other DPS heroes, Freja’s ultimate isn’t typically going to win fights on its own. Bola Shot has good situational power and sets up her teammates for follow-up on the CC, but most often, she’s just hoping to get a single pick with each use.

Guide.title: Multiple ways to counter
content: Freja has weaknesses on both ends of the ranged spectrum. Close-range mobility heroes and long-range hitscans have favorable matchups against her. Whereas most heroes only have one easily exploitable range weakness, Freja gets countered by both types of heroes, so expect to always be playing into multiple counters.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Revdraw Crossbow
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/revdraw-crossbow.png)Revdraw Crossbow
* Max spread doesn’t kick in until the 12th shot in a row.
* * Even when using Relentless Barrage, you can hold down primary fire until after the 3rd Take Aim bolt before you need to pause and reset her bullet spread.
* Leading shots
* * Use Revdraw bolts to lead shots and measure how much you need to lead the explosive bolts.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Take Aim
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja)
* 1 Explosive, 6 standard bolts
* * Fire Take Aim explosive bolt, then spam 6 primary fires, 1 explosive bolt, then repeat to maximize uptime.
* Float Effect

* * Pausing in the air can be great for firing over walls and barriers, while also giving you time to line up your shot. Just be careful not to overuse the float and become predictable, because Freja is very easy to kill while floating.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Quick Dash
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/quick-dash.png)Quick Dash
* Spam explosive bolts
* * The best way for Freja to confirm single target elims is by using Quick Dash to chase down an enemy and fire multiple explosive bolts at them.
* If your target is not receiving any healing, two direct hits will eliminate a standard 250HP hero.
* Dodging
* * When facing any dive enemies targeting you, be sure to save at least one Quick Dash to dodge their attack and get in an extra explosive bolt.
* If Freja gets caught with no Dashes, she’s as good as dead.

Guide.title: [E]: Updraft
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/updraft.png)Updraft
* Take high ground
* * Before fights or at the beginning of fights, look to use Updraft to set up on high ground. Freja’s range becomes even stronger when she can control overlooking positions.
* Jump to shoot over barriers
* * Whether it's a Tank deployable barrier or a wall, the best use of Updraft is to leap above cover and target enemies who think they are positioned outside of danger.
* Pressuring the backline with a couple of quick explosive bolts can force them to retreat and give up supporting their team.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Bola Shot
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/bola-shot.png)Bola Shot
Always go for direct hits
* Even though the AoE damage can be useful on a group of enemies, you should always focus on landing the direct hit. Both the Hindered and pull effect only activate on direct hits.
Prevent the enemy from disengaging

* Dive heroes who rely on mobility tools to get in and get out, and are perfect targets for Bola Shot. Tanks like Winston, Doomfist, and Wrecking Ball can easily be eliminated if you save Bola Shot for just before they try to jump away from your team.
Set up combos

* The grav-like pull effect of a direct impact can be a powerful combo setup. Whether the follow-up is an ally's ultimate or standard ability, it makes for easy wins. Unlike Graviton Surge, the pull effect is too short to wait and react to, so you’ll have to call it out and go on the assumption that your shot will land.

Guide.title: Passive: Bounty Hunting
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/bounty-hunting.png)Bounty Hunting
* Final Blow stocks carry over through death
* * You don’t need to panic and try to get the 3rd final blow before dying. Take your time, and don’t unnecessarily risk your life attempting to get the final blow.
* Ult charge bonus stores
* * The bonus charge will be stored if Freja already has ult. If you are at 3/3 as indicated to the right of your ultimate charge, Freja will immediately gain 25% upon using her ult.
* Moreover, if she lands a final blow with her ult, those will count towards the next bonus, so it’s possible to immediately be at 50% ult charge if you get a triple kill.

Guide.title: Relentless Barrage
content: * Recommended Minor Perk

* Significantly increases spam uptime. If you hit multiple direct hits in a row using the standard combo listed under ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) tips (6 primary fire > 1 Take Aim > repeat), you would have infinite ammo and never stop to reload.

Guide.title: Momentum Boost
content: * Good use is as a counter pick against dive and melee heroes. The extra dash distance can give you the space needed to evade their attacks.

* Activating ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) mid-air still freezes Freja, which minimizes the benefit of this Perk.

Guide.title: Aerial Recovery
content: * Recommended Minor Perk.

* Every time you jump and use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/updraft.png)Updraft + ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) slow, you'll heal for over 75 HP. Even more when used off a ledge.

Guide.title: Rising Winds
content: * Considering the long cooldown of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/updraft.png)Updraft, doubling its uptime is a considerable buff.
* * Best when playing maps with walls to jump and shoot over.
* Also good as a counterpick against melee and very close-range heroes

Guide.title: Maps
content: The best maps for Freja complement her medium-long range positioning. She struggles one map areas with tight spaces and a lot of flat ground. Finding longer sight lines and high ground to set up on is the way Freja primarily wants to position on any map.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja It is a hybrid character with short to long-range capabilities and good mobility. This allows her to adapt to most team comps.

Ideally, she has a strong frontline presence from a Tank like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina, so she can position behind them and spam. These Tanks are also difficult for the enemy to bypass, so ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja doesn't have to worry too much about getting rushed down.

For Supports, her favorite is a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy pocket, but she works great with pretty much every Support. When using Aerial Recovery, she's less reliant on team sustain so she gets a lot of benefit from Support ulitility like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/binding-chain.png)Binding Chain.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: One way to counter ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja is to have better mobility than her, and be able to chase her down and take her out at close range. Heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio can pull this off.

Another way is to outsnipe her. She is in the air often so heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/widowmaker.png)Widowmaker, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta can delete her if they are ready and waiting for a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/updraft.png)Updraft > ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/take-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja).

If your hero doesn't fall into either of these categories, remember that Freja excels at focusing down one target, but is weak when there are multiple enemies. Position near your allies so you don’t end up in a 1v1 situation.
Also, when you see her use Updraft, know you have a 10-second window where she can’t target you behind cover or run away to high ground (unless she's using Rising Winds).

Those with damage mitigation should look to block ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/bola-shot.png)Bola Shot when the hear the ult voice line.

Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hanzo.png)Hanzo is a high-skill sniper DPS built around patience and precision. Guided by his belief, “with every death comes honor,” Hanzo sneakily takes out his target with his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/storm-bow.png)Storm Bow. Every arrow is a test of discipline, rewarding players who value timing and predicting enemy movement—or getting a random lucky headshot while spamming down hallways.

In a team comp, Hanzo’s purpose is pressure and picks. He excels at controlling sightlines, punishing predictable movement, and opening fights with an early elimination. Optimal Hanzo play revolves around off-angles and high ground, where he can catch a target off guard.
Even though he excels at range, rapid-fire arrows, and a dash make him capable in a close-range scramble as well. Unlike other snipers, you can’t simply dive Hanzo for an easy counter.

He also has the unique power to reveal enemies' positions to his team with Sonic Arrow. When played correctly, Hanzo forces enemy teams to slow down, respect space, and play around the ever-present threat of instant death.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Spam fully charged shots down long-sight lines. Even when not getting kills, his arrows pose a huge threat and force the enemy team to play cautiously.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/wall-climb.png)Wall Climb to control position on high ground where it’s difficult for the enemy to contest Hanzo.

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sonic-arrow.png)Sonic Arrow before the fight starts to gain information about enemy positions before they can see you.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Respect his sightlines. If he’s already aiming down the main choke point, stay behind a barrier or take a different path.
* Vary your left/right strafing movement to make it more difficult for him to predict your direction.
* If you are playing a flank or dive hero, keep pressuring him so he can’t freely shoot the rest of your team.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Pick potential
* Info gathering
* Versatility
* Inconsistent
* Vulnerable to dive and rush
* Low utility

Guide.title: Pick Potential and Threat
content: Hanzo’s ability to one-shot squishy heroes makes him a constant threat in fights. A single well-placed arrow can instantly swing the match's momentum. Just the threat of being instantly killed puts immense pressure on the enemy team and makes them cautious to push up.

Guide.title: Information Gathering
content: Sonic Arrow gives Hanzo great scouting capabilities. Knowing enemy positions and pathing gives his team extra time to adapt their position and strategy.

Guide.title: Versatile
content: Wall Climb and Lunge let Hanzo access high ground, safely shoot over walls, and play off-angles. When pressured, he can either escape or pop Storm Arrow to battle it out.

Guide.title: Inconsistent
content: Hanzo’s effectiveness is heavily aim-dependent. Missed shots provide little value, and even the best Hanzo players have times when they can’t land a headshot. Compared to many DPS, Hanzo struggles to bring consistent value to his team.

Guide.title: Vulnerable to Dive and Rush
content: Although Hanzo has the threat of Storm and Frost Arrow, he struggles against high mobility dive heroes, who are especially difficult to land shots on. These heroes also tend not to stand in straight lines or on the objective, so they naturally counter Hanzo’s main game plan.

Guide.title: Low Team Utility
content: Beyond Sonic Arrow, Hanzo doesn’t bring any benefit to his team outside of getting solo kills. He doesn’t directly enable team play, and he’s not particularly good at peeling for his backline.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Storm Bow
content: **Tips For** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/storm-bow.png)Storm Bow
* Spam chokes early for pressure and possible picks. Then slow down and aim carefully once enemy positions are revealed.
* Pay close attention to enemy movement patterns and use that information to make educated guesses on how they will move so you can get more consistent headshots.

* If you normally use a custom reticle, consider going into Hero settings and setting Hanzo’s to default. His reticle can help you adjust your aim vertically based on distance to account for arrow drop.
* When battling an enemy at closer range, or when they are already at low HP, use partially charged arrows to get the kill faster.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Sonic Arrow
content: **Tips For** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sonic-arrow.png)Sonic Arrow
* Use Sonic Arrow _before_ fights to scout rotations
* Don’t waste Sonic Arrow by shooting it at enemies out in the open.
* Shooting walls will reveal enemies directly behind that wall.
* Mid-fight, use Sonic Arrow to help your team chase down enemies attempting to retreat to safety.

Guide.title: [E]: Storm Arrows
content: **Tips For** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sonic-arrow.png)Sonic Arrow
* Storm Arrows excel at burst damage on tanks, barriers, and targets with limited movement, like a turret form Bastion.

* Don’t panic activate Storm Arrows. Good players will try to bait you into using Storm Arrows, then disengage. After a few seconds, they will full commit to a real attack then you will be left defenseless.
* Activate when you’re confident shots will land.
* You can shoot Storm Arrows into small rooms to attempt to finish off damaged enemies.

Guide.title: (In Air) [SPACE]: Lunge
content: **Tips For** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/lunge.png)Lunge
* Prioritize saving Lunge to defend yourself by creating space when the enemy team has flankers and dive heroes.
* Avoid predictable Lunge patterns; smart opponents will pre-aim it and punish you for being locked into the movement.

Guide.title: [SPACE]: Wall Climb
content: **Tips For** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/wall-climb.png)Wall Climb
* Wall Climb lets you take angles most heroes can’t contest. Always abuse vertical positions.
* Pair Lunge with Wall Climb to access unexpected angles, like jumping over a wall or around a corner.
* Use Wall Climb to briefly peek over walls for information without fully exposing yourself. Then climb back up to shoot at your designated target.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Dragonstrike
content: **Tips For** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonstrike.png)Dragonstrike
* Dragonstrike can also get a ton of value when used for zoning; it’s not just for kills.

* * You can split the enemy team in half by shooting ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonstrike.png)Dragonstrike in the middle of the team. Those in front won’t be able to retreat, and the rest of your team will have an opportunity to eliminate them.

* First shoot Sonic Arrow to see enemy positions, then fire ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonstrike.png)Dragonstrike through the walls to make it harder for the enemy to avoid.
* * Especially effective in narrow chokes or on objectives.
* Combo with crowd control like Graviton Surge for the most lethal and consistent ult usage.

Guide.title: Sonic Disruption
content: * Useful for inconveniencing enemy flankers who rely on health packs to get back into the fight.
* If there is a flanker like Tracer, or a Tank like Wrecking Ball harassing your team, grabbing health packs and attacking you again, Sonic Disruption can be used to hinder their gameplay loop,.

Guide.title: Dragon Fury
content: * Even if you only hit one out of every 3 shots, the increased draw speed is very strong for Hanzo.
* Take by default. Especially powerful when being pressured by Tanks.
* Recommended Minor Perk

Guide.title: Frost Arrow
content: * AoE effect, hitting a surface also triggers the explosion and will inflict slow on nearby enemies.
* Can be used during Storm Arrow, but not with Sonic Arrow.
* Try aiming at your target's feet to either get an easy body shot or floor explosion. Then, go for a headshot while they are slowed
* * Especially effective in combination with Dragon Furty.

Guide.title: Scatter Arrows
content: * In theory, you can get some cheeky KOs against retreating enemies inside rooms or around corners, but it’s too niche to be worth taking in any scenario over Frost Arrow.

Guide.title: Maps
content: The best maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hanzo.png)Hanzo have open long and narrow sightlines lines like Circuit Royal, first point Colosseo, and Havana. These are areas funnel the enemy into predictable positions he can spam arrows down and abuse the threat of a long-range one-shot.

Since he can ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/wall-climb.png)Wall Climb to high ground repeatedly, he does especially well by taking the high ground surrounding objectives.

Maps with enclosed objective areas are difficult for him because outside of using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/storm-arrows.png)Storm Arrows, he's at the disadvantage in close-ranges.

The only draw back to high ground maps like Dorado, is that these are also common maps for the enemy to play his main counters like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va.

Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junkrat.png)Junkrat uses his explosives to take over tight spaces, punish predictable movement, and dominate enemies through relentless explosive spam. Thriving on mayhem rather than precision, Junkrat turns choke points and objectives into death traps.
Much of his value comes from preventing the enemy Tank from being able to play the game. Tanks have a difficult time surviving his high damage output and dealing with crowd control abilities.

In a team comp, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junkrat.png)Junkrat excels at controlling space with bouncing projectiles and shutting down flanks with his trap. He is strongest when fights funnel through chokes or objectives, where he can bounce frags off of walls for unpredictable eliminations. While he is less effective in open map areas, Junkrat specialists have mastered the art of using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/concussion-mine.png)Concussion Mine jumps to quickly traverse open areas or take to the skies and battle fliers.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Spam chokes relentlessly. Look for walls you can ricochet ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/frag-launcher.png)Frag Launchers off of to attack enemies that don’t have LoS on you.

* Control space with traps and mines. You should always have a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/steel-trap.png)Steel Trap out to cover the enemy's forward approach or protect your flank.
* Target large and slow enemies like Tanks instead of trying skill-shot small mobile heroes.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Avoid tight corridors, rooms, hallways, and low areas. These are the perfect places for Junkrat’s frags to farm your team.
* Keep an eye on the floor. Break traps for your teammates so they don’t walk in and die.
* Heroes with long-range capabilities or small, high-mobility characters have favorable matchups against Junkrat.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Burst
* CC
* Random eliminations
* Low-ranged
* Vulnerable during ultimate
* Struggles vs Fliers

Guide.title: Burst Damage
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/concussion-mine.png)Concussion Mine combos allow Junkrat to instantly delete squishy targets or heavily damage tanks. When executed cleanly, his burst potential is among the best in game.

Guide.title: Frequent Crowd Control
content: Two Concussion Mine charges, a Trap, and even his Frags have a bit of knockback. Altogether, Junkrat makes it difficult to walk forward. He can control enemy movement better than they can.

Guide.title: Random Eliminations
content: Choke spam really is Junkrat’s specialty. Partly due to his Frags bouncing around and hitting targets he completely missed or didn’t even know were standing there. Even better when he’s shooting over structures or bouncing shots off of walls.

Guide.title: Limited Effectiveness at Long Range
content: Junkrat struggles in open maps where enemies can outrange and avoid his projectiles. Smart opponents can exploit range to maintain the advantage. The slow projectile speed makes his consistency fall off the farther away he gets.

Guide.title: Vulnerable During Ultimate
content: Junkrat is one of the only heroes who cannot protect himself during his ult. If an enemy finds you, it’s a free kill. Additionally, if you send ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rip-tire.png)RIP-Tire straight at the enemy, they can easily break it.

Guide.title: Very Little Counterplay Against Fliers
content: Even though we’ll see crazy clips of flying Top 500 Junkrats, the reality is that fliers destroy Junkrat. If you are doing really well, expect to see ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/jetpack-cat.png)Jetpack Cat counter-swaps.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Frag Launcher
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/frag-launcher.png)Frag Launcher
* Position where the enemy players cannot see you. Aim grenades to bounce off surfaces and around corners rather than shooting directly at your targets.
* Spam chokes early to pressure the enemy team and build ult charge. As the enemy takes space and moves up, reposition to maintain optimal spacing.
* Grouped up enemies are the optimal target for Frags and Mines. You’ll output more damage thanks to the AoE, and even if you miss one, you may hit another enemy.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Concussion Mine
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/concussion-mine.png)Concussion Mine
* Use mines offensively for burst combos. Frag > Mine will insta-kill 225 HP heroes like Juno.
* Mine jumps can quickly reposition you to high ground for a better angle or surprise attack.
* When getting overtaken by the enemy, Mine jump away to escape.

Guide.title: [E]: Steel Trap
content: Tips for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/steel-trap.png)Steel Trap
* Place traps just out of direct sight, around corners, in front of doorways, on staircases, or in high-traffic paths.
* Leave a Concussion Mine inside of Steel Trap and instantly detonate it when you see the trap triggered.
* Throw trap behind retreating enemies to stop them in their tracks and secure the kill.

Guide.title: (Passive): Total Mayhem
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/total-mayhem.png)Total Mayhem
* Never try to activate Total Mayhem by dying on purpose when you could've lived.
* Sometimes you may get a free kill post-death by as a nice bonus, so if you are for sure going to die, you can try to die right on top of the enemy.
* Technically most effective in tight spaces where it’s difficult for the enemy to move away.

Guide.title: Ultimate: RIP-Tire
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rip-tire.png)RIP-Tire
* Use RIP-Tire while safely positioned away from enemies to avoid being killed while driving it around the map.
* Take unexpected routes, climb walls, go over buildings, and zig-zag to avoid Tire getting destroyed.
* Typically, you should avoid Tanks as most will survive the explosion unless they are already damaged.

* Track enemies' escape tools such as Moira’s Fade. If they haven’t used it yet, try to bait them out by driving into them without detonating. Then chase them down after to outplay them and get the KO.

Guide.title: Mine Recycling
content: * Rewards efficient mine usage. Try to purposely save a Mine for landing the final blow.
* Very powerful and enables hyper-aggressive play. You can use one Mine to jump in, another to kill with the Frag-Mine combo, then a refreshed third to jump back out.
* Recommended Minor Perk

Guide.title: Nitro Boost
content: * Makes it much more challenging for the enemy to predict Tire movement and destroy it.
* Particularly valuable on vertical or open maps.

Guide.title: Frag Cannon
content: * Increased projectile speed makes landing direct hits more consistent.
* Best on maps with longer sight lines, but never a bad choice.
* * The increased speed throws some players' muscle memory off, but most find the adjustment very helpful.
* Take it when you are focusing on long-range spam.

Guide.title: Bomb Voyage
content: * Makes your Mine jumps more lethal. Especially when paired with Mine Recycling and using the aforementioned three Mine jump-kill-jump method.
* Best used when playing flanks or surprising enemies by jumping over a wall and quickly raining Frags on them.
* Pick Bomb Voyage when you want to position more aggressively.

Guide.title: Maps
content: The best maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junkrat.png)Junkrat have narrow corridors small objective areas and some high ground to play around. Lijiang Tower's Control Center, and New Junk City are good examples of the types of map layouts that let Junkrat pump a barrage of frags down onto objectives, off walls, and into small rooms.

He struggles on maps with long sightlines and open areas like Junker Town and Havana. The slow travel speed of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/frag-launcher.png)Frag Launcher and short range of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/concussion-mine.png)Concussion Mine let long ranged projectile and hitscan heroes out-class him on these maps.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junkrat.png)Junkrat mainly positions on off angles, near but separate from his team. Because of this he has a lot of flexibility with Tank pairings. When he has a barrier Tank, he can play more with his team and spam behind their protection. With more mobile Tanks, he mine up to reposition and follow-up on their aggression.

For the second DPS, having a hitscan like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe is very helpful to cover his weakness against fliers like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah.

Utility based Supports like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade can capitalize on his high burst damage to explode enemy heroes and get quick elims.

You can also get creative with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wuyang.png)Wuyang and his controllable primary fire to bombard enemies positioned behind cover where only he and Junkrat can keep attacking them. Dive in with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tidal-blast.png)Tidal Blast, and you are practically guaranteed to secure a kill if you land on someone and knock them down.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Don't have walls close behind you or stand next to structures. These are the areas ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junkrat.png)Junkrat aims to bounce his frags off of. You are less likely to get hit by random nades if you avoid tight corridors, rooms, hallways, and low areas.

Staircases and doorways are common places for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/steel-trap.png)Steel Trap, so keep an eye on the floor. Break traps for your teammates so they don’t walk in and die.
Flanking him at close range is dangerous because you put yourself in range of his frag-mine combos. Whenever possible, play outside his optimal range.
In open areas and places with long sightlines, hitscans and long-range heroes have the advantage against Junkrat.
