Guide.title: Overview
content: When you want to DPS but you’re forced to Support, Baptiste is the hero for you. Often compared to a Soldier:76 who also heals, his hitscan burst weapon is good for dealing with fliers and laying down constant poke pressure. With a bit of mobility from Exo Boots and his Immortality Field, Bap has the flexibility to fit into many different team comps and doesn’t have any terrible matchups.

All his healing is AoE-based, so he gets the most value with grouped-up teams and low-mobility allies. You’ll find Bap positioned behind his team or taking high ground to pressure the enemy team with his Biotic Launcher.

Guide.title: Playing As
content: * Multitask healing and damage. Don’t tunnel vision on only healbotting or only attacking, and forget to keep your team alive.
* Be patient with Immortality Field. Wait for the enemy to commit their abilities and ultimates before deploying it.
* Don’t sit still. Use Exo Boots to take high ground, fall to safety, and jump back up to the fight.

Guide.title: Playing Against
content: * Don’t commit long cooldowns or ultimates until after you’ve seen him use Immortality Field. Try to attack with your standard attacks or short CDs, retreat, then re-engage after he’s used it.
* Watch his jumps, and track him in the air. He’s easiest to elim while he’s locked in the jump arc.
* His primary fire has severe damage falloff. Keep your distance and take him down with heroes like Ana, Kiri, and Widowmaker.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * DPS
* Immortality Field
* AoE and burst Healing
* Long cooldowns
* Weak vs dive comps
* The two-edged sword

Guide.title: DPS Support
content: As far as Supports go, Bap has some of the best offense. His damage output is on par with some DPS heroes. If you feel your team is lacking damage, swapping to Bap can make up for it without sacrificing sustain.

Guide.title: Immortality Field
content: Just having an ability that makes everyone in its AoE unkillable is a power of gigantic proportions. The use of Immortality Field can control the pace of fights and determine when the enemy team can get elims.

Guide.title: AoE and Burst Healing
content: Bap is unique in having great single-target, AoE, and burst healing. Whether the enemy team is focusing one ally or his whole team is taking damage, Bap has no trouble providing the sustain needed.

Guide.title: Long Cooldowns
content: The primary and most exploitable weakness of his kit is that both his cooldowns are on long timers. When trading Regen Burst or Immortality Field with enemy abilities, they will generally have their abilities to use again long before Bap has his.

Guide.title: Vulnerable against dive comps
content: Enemy Tanks like D.Va and Winston, or DPS like Venture and Tracer, see Bap as an easy pick. He can make up for this a bit later in a game with Rocket Boots Major Perk and make avoiding their attacks easier.

Guide.title: Exo Boots are a two-edged sword
content: Jumping over a wall and blasting the enemy makes for some cool aggro play, but anytime Bap jumps, it's like painting a huge target on his face. Depending on the enemy comp and specific situation, jumping or staying grounded may be the better play, and it can be difficult to know which to choose.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Biotic Launcher
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-launcher.png)Biotic Launcher **(Primary Fire)**
* Weave in healing shots
* * To maximize his APM, alternate between primary and secondary fire. Stand behind your tank or teammate and aim for the enemy.
* Your ally in front of you will protect you from damage, receive your healing, and your damage goes through them to hit the enemy.
* Aim for the upper chest

* * The three-round burst recoil kicks vertically, then resets in between each burst. Aiming for the upper chest of enemies will help you consistently land shots and get in a few headshots with each burst as well.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Biotic Launcher (healing)
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-launcher.png)Biotic Launcher **(Secondary Fire)**
* Aim for the legs
* * Splash healing is twice the direct impact healing. Therefore, it’s better to at least get the splash healing with every shot than it is to hit some direct hits and completely miss some shots.
* Aiming for legs means even when you miss, the projectile will explode on the ground and still give your ally healing.
* Splash heal on walls
* * Trying to heal aerial allies like Pharah or Genji can be very difficult. If they are near walls or ceilings, aim for the surface and get the AoE healing on them.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Regenerative Burst
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/regenerative-burst.png)Regenerative Burst
* Be extra careful when not available
* * The long cooldown is easy for enemies to track. If you don’t have Regen Burst, Bap can’t heal himself if he gets dove. Stay near your other Support until you can use it again.
* Double healing for critical health allies
* * The best time to use Regen Burst is when you or your teammates are already at very low health. They heal more, and you gain more ult charge.
* AoE persists once activated

* * Your ally only needs to be in range when activating the ability. So Bap could Exo Boost into the air, activate Regen Burst on an Echo, and she could fly away and keep getting the healing over time.

Guide.title: [E]: Immortality Field
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/immortality-field.png)Immortality Field
* Treat like a 2nd Ult

* * Just because you automatically get it back after 25 seconds doesn’t mean you should just throw Immortality Field out the moment your team takes damage. Don’t die without deploying, but also be disciplined, and use it only if you are certain it's the only way to keep yourself or an ally alive.
* Place behind cover
* * Immortality Field has very low HP, so if the enemy can see it, they will destroy it.
* Whenever possible, deploy behind a barrier or wall that still allows your team to be within its AoE.

Guide.title: (Ctrl): Exo Boots
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/exo-boots.png)Exo Boots
* Don’t spam jump
* * If you become predictable with super jumps, the enemy will start killing you while airborne. Vary how much charge to change height.
* Take the high ground
* * Bap should always be positioned above the battlefield. He’s safer and has an easier time landing the lobbed healing shots.
* Shoot over walls and barriers
* * Jump over cover to land final blows on retreating enemies, or get into the LoS of allies being cut off.
* Remember to be careful when jumping above barriers and walls, as the enemy could be waiting and pick you off.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Amplification Matrix
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/amplification-matrix.png)Amplification Matrix
* Deploy in front of your team

* * When in a poke-heavy comp, it's best to put the window in front of your team where everyone can shoot through it. The double damage of a whole team will either destroy the enemy team or force them to retreat.
* Deploy behind your team

* * When you need double healing, or are paired with another projectile Support like Juno, you can place window right in front of you and behind the rest of your team. Great for when you need to burst heal a tank and save the fight.
* Don’t be a Reddit Bap

* * You may see cool clips of Baps you put down Immortality Field and Amp Matrix to get a triple kill all on their own. This is incredibly unreliable and a waste of Bap's two most important abilities.

Guide.title: Assault Burst
content: Makes Barrier Field tosses much more consistent and forgiving. The AoE is huge, so even if your placement isn’t perfect, you have a much higher chance of getting yourself and your teammates within the field.

Guide.title: Expanded Field
content: Makes Barrier Field tosses much more consistent and forgiving. The AoE is huge, so even if your placement isn’t perfect, you have a much higher chance of getting yourself and your teammates within the field.

Guide.title: Automated Healing
content: * Nice to have for some extra healing. May not feel game-changing because his cooldowns are so long, but the extra 120 can make the difference of life and death for an ally.

Guide.title: Rocket Boots
content: * Strengthens Bap's biggest weakness
* * With only vertical mobility, Bap struggles against high mobility enemies. He just jumps up and gets destroyed mid-air. With Rocket Boots, he becomes significantly more evasive.
* Also comes in handy when jumping over barriers and walls, as you can mix up your movement and make it less likely to get sniped out of the air.
* The best choice, especially against dive comps.

Guide.title: Best Maps
content: Range and verticality are two of Bap’s best capabilities. Maps with space for Bap to sit back and spam his primary and secondary fire are excellent choices. High ground is his best friend when it comes to safely assisting his team and escaping enemy attacks. Most enemies can’t keep up with Bap if he can jump up and down from a high ground area.

Guide.title: Worst Maps
content: The worst maps for Bap are those that favor dive comps because he doesn’t synergize very well with dive, and is an easy target when there are multiple dive heroes on the enemy team. Additionally, if the map's main high ground areas are too high for Exo Boots, then his only mobility tool becomes useless.

Guide.title: Watchpoint
content: Gibraltar

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Team comps built around Baptiste can take full advantage of his superior AoE sustain abilities. Biotic Launcher healing, Regenerative Burst, and Immortality get the most value when used in teams that tend to position close together. He has difficulty healing small and highly mobile heroes. Although he has excellent vertical mobility, he can’t keep up with flankers and dive heroes who quickly engage the enemy.
**Example of a team comp built around Baptiste**

* **Tank**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma

* **DPS**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/bastion.png)Bastion

* **Supports**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta

Guide.title: Individual Hero Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa

Orisa holds down the frontline better than just about any other Tank. She’s also large and slow, which makes Bap’s healing easy to consistently land direct impacts. Her poke style pairs perfectly with Bap's kit because they want to hold the same corners, play on the same sightlines, and other teammates tend to play right next to Orisa as well.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy

Cassidy and Bap together are a potent hitscan duo. Between the two of them, dive is easy to deal with, brawl can be poked down before they close the distance, and they can contend with any poke comp. When Cassidy ults, throw a lamp on him. If the enemy team can’t block or stun cancel, they’re goners!
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta

The perfect poke backline. Zen and Bap output such oppressive poke damage that enemy teams struggle just to walk forward. Their only weakness is to dive. Even then, they can use Immortality Field and Regen Burst to survive the dive, then discord to counterattack and win the duel. Amplification Matrix placed in front of Bap and Zen melts through barriers and deletes any enemies who can’t get out of their LoS.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Don’t commit long cooldowns or ultimates until after you’ve seen him use Immortality Field. Try to attack with your standard attacks or short CDs, retreat, then re-engage after he’s used it.
Watch his jumps, and track him in the air. He’s easiest to elim while he’s locked in the jump arc.
His primary fire has severe damage falloff. Keep your distance and take him down with heroes like Ana, Kiri, and Widowmaker.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters names
content: ana
kiriko
widowmaker

Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno arrives from orbit armed with her versatile Mediblaster! With both self and team mobility abilities, she helps her team quickly move around the map and rush down the enemy team. Equally effective in damage and healing, all her abilities can be used defensively or offensively.

She brings the most value to her team when positioned close enough to her Tank to deploy Hyper Ring in front of them. Rather than having a lot of self-healing, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno's mobility, shields, and Pulsar Torpedoes allow her to survive enemy attacks.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring when you see your tank trying to rush down the enemy team.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno is vulnerable when flying around and locking on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes. Be mindful of enemy hitscan heroes, and stay out of their LoS.
* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/glide-boost.png)Glide Boost is your best defense. Save it to escape enemy flank attacks.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Keep poking her. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno can’t heal herself, so she relies on shield regen and the Support heal passive. Even the smallest amount of damage to her interrupts the passive self-heal.

* All of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno's healing requires LoS. Stop her from healing with barriers or by forcing her attention away from her allies through your attacks.

* Without Pulsar Torpedoes, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno struggles to defend herself against high mobility heroes. Get past her team and chase her down.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Mobile AF
* Lots of team buffs
* Lock-on projectile
* Healing and damage fall-off
* Struggles vs dive
* No self-healing

Guide.title: Highly Mobile
content: Between ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/glide-boost.png)Glide Boost, double jump, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno is one of the most mobile Supports. She can keep up with her team as they move around the map. Her movement also enables her to escape danger and quickly reposition for her own attack.

Guide.title: Team buffs
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno is the only Support who can give her entire team both damage and speed buffs. Increasing the abilities of an entire team is extremely powerful. She has great utility from the high playmaking potential of Hyper Ring and Orbital Ray.

Guide.title: Lock on projectile
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes are great for a burst of guaranteed healing for your team. They are equally as strong for finishing off low HP enemies. Once locked on, the Torpedoes will even chase around corners.

Guide.title: Severe healing and damage fall off
content: If ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno finds herself at medium-long range from her teammates or enemy targets, Mediblaster’s healing and damage drops significantly. Although they are a hitscan weapon, she’s not good at pressuring the enemy at long range, or at providing healing to far-away allies.

Guide.title: Struggles in dive metas
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno is very easy for dive comps to eliminate. She doesn’t have any CC, self-sustain, or invincibility. Additionally, played in a dive team, those heroes don’t Hyper Ring to traverse the map, and they don’t want to stand in place to benefit from Orbital Ray.

Guide.title: Low self-healing
content: While she has some shield health, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno doesn’t have any means of burst healing herself like most other Supports do (outside of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orbital-ray.png)Orbital Ray). She’s reliant on her other Support, self-healing passive, or has to be able to hide for long enough to activate shield regen.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Mediblaster
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/mediblaster.png)Mediblaster
* Damage and healing

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/mediblaster.png)Mediblaster is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno's primary source of damage and healing. Focus on healing your team unless everyone is near full health, then focus on attacking.

* When allies are at full health, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/mediblaster.png)Mediblaster pass through instead of being absorbed. Try to line up enemies behind the allies ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno is healing because the moment your ally is at full health, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/mediblaster.png)Mediblaster will be damaging the enemy and building ult charge.
* Stay medium range or closer

* * Because ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/mediblaster.png)Mediblaster has harsh healing fall off, always try to stay within a medium range to your allies in order to maximize your healing output.
* Healing fall off begins at 20 meters.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Pulsar Torpedoes
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes
* Offensive use

* * Always try to lock onto the enemy backline as they are the most difficult for your team to target. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes is one of the best backline tools to pressure or kill enemy backlines.
* Don’t always double jump and glide around trying to lock on to more targets. Be mindful of enemy hitscan heroes, and stay out of their LoS or they’ll snipe you out of the air.
* Maximize lock-on targets
* * It’s generally a good strategy to try and lock onto as many enemies and allies with each use. This generates much more ult charge.
* High priority targets like low HP allies, or critical enemies, are more important to lock on and fire, than trying to always acquire more targets.
* Cooldown reset

* * When trying to use offensively, if you don’t find your targets, letting the ability time out without firing will put ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes on a short two-second cooldown instead of the full 10 seconds.

Guide.title: LShift: Glide Boost
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/glide-boost.png)Glide Boost
* Horizontal movement

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/glide-boost.png)Glide Boost doesn’t give vertical movement, so make sure to activate it at the height you want to glide at.
* If the enemy has more melee and short-range heroes, spend more time gliding higher in the air. When they have more ranged and hitscan heroes, staying close to the ground is safer.
* Escape tool

* * Glide Boost is the only way ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno can escape enemy attacks and flankers. When the enemy has heroes trying to flank or dive you, like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji, try to only use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/glide-boost.png)Glide Boost in response to their dive. Using it to just move around will mark ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno as an easy kill until it comes off cooldown again.

Guide.title: [E]: Hyper Ring
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring
* Deploy anywhere
* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring can be grounded or floating in mid-air.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring permeates barriers and environment and can be used on both sides of a wall, ceiling, or floor.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno instantly gains the speed boost upon activating the Hyper Ring without needing to pass through it.
* Can be passed through multiple times to reapply the speed buff.
* Speed Boost out of spawn

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno can deploy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring anytime after the “4” in the final five-second countdown to doors open. Doing so helps your team get to the objective first and gets Hyper Ring back faster than waiting until after the doors open.

Guide.title: Q Ultimate: Orbital Ray
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orbital-ray.png)Orbital Ray
* Offense or Defense

* * Because ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orbital-ray.png)Orbital Ray gives both healing over time and a 30% damage boost, it can be used to gain an offensive advantage or defensively to survive enemy Ultimates.

* If your other Support has a strong defensive ult, like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence, look to use your ult more aggressively.
* If your other Support has an offensive ult like Nano Boost, it is better to save Orbital Ray for a defensive use.
* Can’t be blocked or stopped

* * Once ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orbital-ray.png)Orbital Ray has been activated, it will travel through walls, structures, and barriers. For example, you can activate it in a room next to the objective area, then go around and catch the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orbital-ray.png)Orbital Ray back on the objective.
* AoE
* * Allies receiving the healing and damage buff glow with a blue aura.
* To get the healing and damage boost, a hero needs to stay within the AoE of the beam which is displayed as a green circle on the ground.

Guide.title: (Passive) [Space]: Martian Overboots
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/martian-overboots.png)Martian Overboots
* Extra height

* * The extra height can be useful for setting up ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno can target heroes behind barriers and walls.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno can double jump, Glide Boost, and hover between high ground areas. Traveling from one high ground to another is important since she often doesn’t jump high enough to make it from ground level.
* Use sparingly

* * Constantly double jumping, gliding, and hovering in the air makes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno an easy target. Don’t expose yourself too often or else the enemy will catch on and start picking you off in the air.
* One double jump per aerial

* * The double jump can be used before, during, or after ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/glide-boost.png)Glide Boost. Whichever you choose, it can only be used once and only refreshes after landing back on the ground.

Guide.title: Familiar Vitals
content: _“Pulsar Torpedoes lock onto allies 35% faster.”_
* Save low HP allies

* * The only weakness of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes is the time it takes to lock on, then the slow travel speed of the projectile. Teammates sometimes die before the healing arrives. 35% increase for only healing Torpedoes may not sound like a lot, but in critical moments it means the difference between life and death for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno's allies.

Guide.title: Locked On
content: _“Reduce the cooldown of Pulsar Torpedoes by 1 second for each enemy hit.”_
* Good when able to play more offensively
* * Getting to use her Torpedoes more often puts extra pressure on the enemy team and builds Ult charge faster.
* You need to frequently get at least one or two enemies locked on.

* Don't tunnel vision on only dealing damage, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes are your best source of burst healing for your allies.

Guide.title: Faster Blaster
content: * Burst value
* * When picking this Perk, you gain ~30% fire rate increase during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/glide-boost.png)Glide Boost.
* That gives you the option for both burst damage and burst healing.
* Good for dueling.

Guide.title: Lift Off
content: * Extra verticality

* * The extra 3rd jump can be use at any time, including during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/glide-boost.png)Glide Boost. This allows ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno to reach new heights and access some high ground that is normally just above her reach.

* Good for hopping above a wall to fire ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes, and for escaping from close-range enemies who lack vertical mobility.
* Counter Perk

* * Against melee, and close-range enemies, Lift Off can be the better Major Perk to choose, because it will help ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno keep distance from her attackers.

Guide.title: Maps
content: The best maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno are flat, have a lot of open space, and encourage fights to be on the objective. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring gets the most value when her team needs the extra speed to get to the next objective quickly, or when helping her team flank or rush down the enemy backline. If the enemy can set up on high ground or far from the objective, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring’s value decreases. Because Orbital Ray moves in a slow and fixed path, fights that stay in one place also raise its potential. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno's horizontal movement is best on flat ground maps and maps with lots of small side rooms she can glide through while evading the enemy.

Guide.title: Watchpoint
content: Gibraltar

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno wants to enable her team with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring. Therefore, she pairs best with heroes who primarily rely on burst damage to win fights.

Whether it's ground-based brawlers like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reaper.png)Reaper who can now quickly chase down squishies, or already hyper mobile heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/anran.png)Anran to increase their already great movement, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring enables hyper-aggression and fast fight wins.

Since she offers both high sustain and some utility, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno pairs well with most Supports. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orbital-ray.png)Orbital Ray is a hybrid of defense and offense, so if your team needs a full-on defensive ult to survive an enemy wombo-combo like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nano-boost.png)Nano Boost + ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonblade.png)Dragonblade, go with someone like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio who can use their ult defensively, while you save yours for an offensive push.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Keep poking her. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno can’t heal herself, so she relies on shield regen and the Support heal passive. Even the smallest amount of damage to her interrupts the passive self-heal.

All of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno's healing requires LoS. Stop her from healing with barriers or by forcing her attention away from her allies through your attacks.

Without Pulsar Torpedoes, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno struggles to defend herself against high mobility heroes. Get past her team and chase her down.

Once you've seen her use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/glide-boost.png)Glide Boost, that is your time to hard focus Juno. She won't be able to instantly activate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/survivor.svg)Survivor from her other abilities, and she can't fly away. Making her an easy target.

Guide.title: Overview
content: Since the launch of Overwatch, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy has been one of the headlining Supports. Although her kit has been controversial in different metas, Mercy has helped shape Overwatch into the game we know today. The unique features of her kit are the ability to resurrect a fallen ally, as well as a continual damage boost with no cooldown.

For players who take the role of supporting literally, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy is a great choice because she is an enabler, rather than a solo playmaker. You’ll rarely see her featured in the Play of the Game, but a good Mercy player can hard carry all the way up to the highest ranks of play.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Pocket the win condition. Always be on the lookout for who on your team is going for the all-in, win-or-lose play, and stay on them.
* Manage beam usage. If everyone has a lot of health, stay on Damage Boost until someone needs healing to live and attack.

* Use your movement to survive. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy can’t defend herself, so you have to be evasive through Guardian Angel movement.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Don’t let her get off free resurrections. If her teammate dies, expect her to be looking for an opportunity to rez. Be ready to punish her.
* Bait out Guardian Angel without using your movement ability. Then chase her for the kill.

* Target ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy . Eliminating Mercy first is more efficient than trying to kill her allies through her healing.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * High-reward plays
* Number advantage
* Good survivability
* Relies on the team
* No self-defence tools
* Single target assistance

Guide.title: High reward plays
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy's whole playstyle is all about managing risk and reward. Going for a rez is always risky, but the payoff of instantly having your teammates back is massive. Additionally, pocketing an ally empowers them to get away with riskier plays than usual. A ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn, for example, can’t survive on a deep flank by herself, but with a Mercy pocket, she could wipe the whole enemy team.

Guide.title: Numbers advantage
content: Rez effectively forces the enemy to earn one more elimination than your team every fight. A resurrection completely negates the effect of whatever abilities and resources were invested to get the kill.

Guide.title: High survivability
content: Even though ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy doesn’t have any CC and no invincibility, she’s very difficult to kill. Guardian Angel makes her evasive and challenging to track or chase. She’s also healing herself anytime she’s healing an ally, and has the Support passive to self-heal as well.

Guide.title: Team reliant
content: No matter how insane your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy play is, you still need your team to be securing eliminations. Mercy isn’t the kind of hero who can carry a team's poor performance. She can damage boost an ally all game, but if they're not landing meaningful damage, it doesn’t do much.

Guide.title: Poor self-defense
content: When ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy is being attacked, she’s primarily reliant on her allies to either defend her, or be in range to use Guardian Angel to escape. If she’s ever caught out on her own, or no one is helping her, she has almost zero chance of winning a 1v1 duel.

Guide.title: Single target assistance
content: Depending on her team's 2nd Support, the single-target nature of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/caduceus-staff.png)Caduceus Staff can be a major disadvantage. If multiple members of her team need healing all at once, they’re gonna have to get in line because outside of her Ult, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy can only heal one at a time. Same goes for damage boost, if two teammates are making a play together, you have to pick just one to boost.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Caduceus Staff (Healing)
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/caduceus-staff.png)Caduceus Staff **(Healing)**
* Keep allies topped off
* * Make sure you’re not sitting with heal beam on someone who is at full health while another teammate is at low health. You should be frequently changing heal targets.
* Jiggle peek corners

* * Your beam only breaks after losing LoS for over one second. This timer resets every time you regain LoS. Jiggle peeking a corner increases your uptime while simultaneously keeping ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy safer and taking less damage.
* Heal Tanks cut off by barriers

* * A common tactic for enemy Tanks is to cut off healing to your tank with their barriers, like Sigma Shield or Winston bubble. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy heals through barriers, unlike many other Supports.
* Self-healing

* * No longer a unique passive, now her subrolw ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/medic.svg)Medic passive. But it's worth noting as the shared healing in extremely important to Mercy's survival.

* Stacks with healing boosts from Biotic Grenade, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/valkyrie.png)Valkyrie, and when healing multiple targets during Ult.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Caduceus Staff (Damage Boost)
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/caduceus-staff.png)Caduceus Staff **(Damage Boost)**
* Don’t be a heal bot
* * If all you’re gonna do is heal, you might as well pick a different Support who can do it better. Mercy’s most important utility is her damage boost.
* Damage boost the most lethal teammate

* * Whichever teammate is currently in position to make the biggest play should be the target of your damage boost. It doesn’t matter which hero they are using. The only thing that matters is if they are going for a big play. Typically, whoever is the most forward has the most play-making potential. You’ll need to identify from moment to moment, as your win condition is constantly changing.
* Prioritize allies not dying
* * Although you should be looking to damage boost as much as possible, don’t forget to also keep an awareness of critical health allies.
* Jiggle peek corners
* * Same tip as healing, but even more important with damage boost. Usually, when you are damage boosting, you will be more aggressively positioned and exposed to more potential danger.

* Your beam only breaks after losing LoS for over one second. This timer resets every time you regain LoS. Jiggle peeking a corner increases your uptime while simultaneously keeping ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy safer and taking less damage.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Guardian Angel
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/guardian-angel.png)Guardian Angel
* Don’t end up between an ally and an enemy
* * You don’t want to be a meat shield, so be careful not to overshoot your target when the enemy is in front of them.
* Likewise, if the enemy is behind you, jump past your ally to once again keep them between you and the enemy.
* Manipulate movement

* * Standard ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/guardian-angel.png)Guardian Angel, crouch super jump, jump forward, backwards, in place, straight up are just a few of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy's movement options available every single time she’s GA.

* Pressing crouch after arriving at your target location causes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy to perform a super jump.
* Directional input influences the distance travelled. You can jump forwards, arrive then jump backwards, etc.

Guide.title: [E]: Resurrect
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/resurrect.png)Resurrect
* You don’t have to rez
* * Just because an ally has died doesn’t mean you have to go resurrect them. Even if they are shouting in voice chat. If the enemy team is surrounding the death location, don’t do it.
* Use cover

* * You should always look to use cover and corners when resurrecting. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy can activate rez, then move around a corner or ceiling during the casting, and still rez. She just can’t move too far away or the ability will get canceled.
* Call for protection
* * The best way to increase your odds of surviving Resurrect is to get protected by your Tank or healed by the other Support. Tanks can shield with their body or a barrier.

Guide.title: Caduceus Blaster
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/caduceus-blaster.png)Caduceus Blaster
* Defend yourself
* * Occasionally, your teammates won’t defend you against an attacker. In these situations, try to Guardian Angel away to dodge, while also shooting the enemy with your Blaster.
* Automatic reload

* * Blaster reloads itself while ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy has Staff equipped. No need to manually reload before putting away the Blaster.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Valkyrie
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/valkyrie.png)Valkyrie
* Defensive Ult

* * Used defensively, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/valkyrie.png)Valkyrie can heal your entire team and allow them to survive enemy attacks and ults they couldn’t otherwise. The increased move speed and stacks of self-heal are also great for keeping yourself alive.
* Offensive Ult

* * Granting your whole team 30% damage boost is the more powerful use of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/valkyrie.png)Valkyrie. Unless the enemy team has a strong defensive ult of their own, they shouldn’t be able to survive the extra incoming damage.

* Look for allies to Ult combo with, and save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/valkyrie.png)Valkyrie for when they are ready to use their ult.
* Will your team survive?

* * It can be fun to Blaster in, especially during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/valkyrie.png)Valkyrie, but first take an assessment of health and threat to determine if your team can afford to not have your chain healing

Guide.title: (Passive): Angelic Descent
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/angelic-descent.png)Angelic Descent
* When to float
* * Pocketing fliers

* * Anytime you’re pocketing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo, you’ll need to be alternating between Guardian Angel, float, and fast fall. Mixing up your movement allows you to stay in the air with them, and also makes you harder to target.

* After executing a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/guardian-angel.png)Guardian Angel super jump, float in the air IF the enemy has melee or short-range heroes, or if floating puts you safely behind a ceiling. Otherwise, it’s better not to float because of the slow movement.

Guide.title: Angelic Resurrection
content: * Considering how impactful Resurrect is, but also how vulnerable ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy becomes during it, the Overhealth can be the difference between a won and lost game.

Guide.title: Divine Momentum
content: * Counter dive

* * Against teams that are running dive comps or have people constantly flanking and targeting you, the extra distance ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy travels by bunny hopping or crouch jumping can be your only means of survival

Guide.title: Chain Boost
content: * Good in poke and brawl
* * First off, you need two allies to be playing near each other most of the game. Secondly, you want both of those heroes to have kits that benefit from damage boost.
* If your team is running two ranged heroes, Chain Boost is great for increasing their pressure and threat.
* When your team is running a brawl comp, Chain Boost makes their deathball more lethal and helps them run over the enemy more aggressively.

Guide.title: Flash Heal
content: * Wait for your target to be below half health.
* * Never waste the 15-second cooldown on the base 50 healing. Always wait to get the triple healing on low HP allies.
* More time to damage boost
* * The burst healing cuts down the amount of time you need to spend healing a low-health ally, thus increasing the amount of time you can spend damage boosting.

Guide.title: Maps
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy's best maps have lots of space for her to move around. In tight or cramped map areas, she has difficulty evading the enemy. She never wants to be close to the enemy, so always try to find areas that allow you to keep your distance, no matter the map. Because she pairs so well with ranged DPS like Ashe and Sojourn, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy also works great on maps with long sight lines where these heroes are strong.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: The best comps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy tend to be poke-heavy since she can sit back and damage boost to give her allies the advantage. Other than during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/valkyrie.png)Valkyrie, she's limited to single-target healing, so brawly team comps have the worst team synergy.

The best Tanks are those that can survive without needing constant healing, and get benefits from short bursts of damage boost. Tanks like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma fit both of these, and he's a staple of poke compositions.

For DPS, burst damage and pocketing the carry are where Mercy truly shines. Pretty much whichever hitscan or ranged DPS is on her team (e.g., ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/widowmaker.png)Widowmaker, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/emre.png)Emre, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/soldier-76.png)Soldier: 76, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy, etc.) can have a Mercy attached to them and carry the whole team.

Of course, a shoutout must be given to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo for the flying Mercy pocket. Unless the enemy team goes multiple counters, these duos are extremely difficult to deal with.

Generally, Mercy wants her other Support to have AoE healing to complement her single-target healing. Pretty much anyone other than ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/illari.png)Illari can provide enough sustain to pair with Mercy. These can work as well, but her team needs to be playing an all out offense and winning team fights quickly.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Hitscans are good for shooting Mercy as she floats, or during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/guardian-angel.png)Guardian Angel. Also, high mobility heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va can easily chase her down, and kill her with burst damage.
Don’t let her get off free resurrections. If her teammate dies, expect her to be looking for an opportunity to rez. Be ready to punish her.
Bait out Guardian Angel without using your movement ability. Then chase her for the kill.

Target ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mercy.png)Mercy . Eliminating Mercy first is more efficient than trying to kill her allies through her healing.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters names
content: dva

Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta disproves the myth that Supports are healers. Although he is a peace-seeking monk, he’s not above eliminating his enemies with huge bursts of damage. His kit is more damage-oriented than it is healing or sustain. Between spamming primary fire and charging up a volley of orbs, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta outputs massive amounts of damage for a Support hero.

Don’t ignore his healing, however, as the ability to passively attach automatic healing on an ally enables them to play extremely aggressively. Generally, he’ll want to position himself at the back of his team where he can launch his orbs down the main paths. When the opportunity arises, he’s a deadly flanker who often gets easy picks on enemies who forget to watch out for this dangerous Support.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Charge secondary fire behind cover. Never charge out in the open where the enemy can attack you.
* Discord the enemy closest to your team. The more of your allies that can attack your Discord target, the more benefit you’ll gain.

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/translocator.png)Translocator to counter enemy ultimates. Especially when the enemy has powerful ults like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonblade.png)Dragonblade or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge, save Trans to save your team when they use their ult.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta can’t escape flank and dive attacks. Coordinate with at least one teammate and surprise attack him simultaneously for an easy kill.

* Cleanse ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord by breaking LoS before committing to your attack. You don’t want to move in deep just to get blown up by the extra Discord damage.

* If you don’t see ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta , assume he is charging up a volley. Get behind a barrier and watch your flank.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * High damage
* Discord
* Strong Ultimate
* Low healing
* Squishy AF
* Immobile

Guide.title: High damage
content: He has the highest damage output of any Support. A fully charged volley can instantly delete most heroes, and neither of his attacks have damage falloff. This makes him an excellent choice when playing Support, and you feel your team is losing because of a lack of damage and pick potential.

Guide.title: Discord
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta is the only hero who can constantly boost his entire team’s damage throughout the entire match. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord can be a reliable means of killing enemy Tanks or quickly shutting down an enemy DPS during their ultimate.

Guide.title: Strong defensive ult
content: During ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence, anyone in the AoE is nearly unkillable, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta is literally invincible. The enemy team could invest three ultimates to kill your team, only to have them all negated by your one ult.

Guide.title: Low healing
content: If you play ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta, be prepared to have your team ask for a swap to a, “main healer.” Other than his ult, his healing is extremely low and slow compared to the rest of the Supports. Because of this, he is difficult to make work if your other Support isn’t doing a ton of healing.

Guide.title: Glass cannon
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta has no damage mitigation, self-healing, or escape tool. He relies on his damage to defend himself. He has a large hurtbox and is always being targeted by enemy dive comps. Generally, Zen is considered an easy kill.

Guide.title: Poor mobility
content: Overwatch is full of high mobility heroes in every role. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta is very slow-moving and has no movement abilities. The minor Perk, Ascendance, does give him limited air movement, but doesn’t give any sort of increased speed, or invincibility. On large maps or in team comps with a lot of mobility, Zen wastes a lot of time trying to catch up with the fight.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Orb of Destruction
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-destruction.png)Orb of Destruction
* Higher damage per second
* * Compared to always charging up secondary fire volleys, spamming primary fire has significantly higher overall damage.
* Target the enemy backline

* * Even though they may be more difficult to hit, his high damage and infinite range allow ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta to have the advantage in most long-range fights.

* In most team comps, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta can pressure the enemy backline better than anyone else on his team.

* The only heroes he loses to are snipers like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/widowmaker.png)Widowmaker because hitscans are more consistent than projectile weapons.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Orb of Destruction (Charge)
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-destruction.png)Orb of Destruction **(Charge)**
* Charge behind cover
* * Charging in the open gives the enemy time to shoot you while you are doing zero damage to them.
* Stay hidden, then pop out with just enough time to line up your shot, shoot, then get back to safety.
* Don’t break Discord LoS
* * Even though you shouldn’t be exposing yourself while charging, you should also try not to cleanse Discord from your target by staying behind cover for too long.
* This is particularly true when the rest of your team is already targeting the Discorded enemy.
* Duck and release

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta can manipulate his head hitbox by ducking and shooting the volley simultaneously. This places his head much lower than normal and is useful for dodging enemy sniper head shots.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Orb of Harmony
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-harmony.png)Orb of Harmony
* Harmony your flankers

* * Anytime you have allies going on flanks or diving the enemy backline, you should give them![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-harmony.png)Orb of Harmony before they go in. Even if they break LoS they’ll still have 5 seconds of healing to help them survive and fight longer.
* Harmony your other Support

* * In a typical ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta comp, the 2nd Support can handle healing the rest of the team. They don’t want to waste their abilities to heal themselves, however, so Zen should always be aware of the other Support's health. Anytime they start taking damage, give them Orb of Harmony.
* Tank duels

* * If the two tanks are having a sustain battle by standing in the open and seeing who will die first, then you should leave ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-harmony.png)Orb of Harmony on your Tank.

* They’ll need the extra healing, plus ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord damage in order to win the exchange.

Guide.title: [E]: Orb of Discord
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord target prioritization: While target prioritization is rather nuanced, here are a few guiding principles to help you maximize Discord’s power:
* * 1. Discord the most threatening enemy. Whichever enemy has the highest possibility of killing you or a teammate should be your first priority in Discord targets.
* 2. Discord the most aggressive enemy. Most of the time, this will be the enemy pushed up the farthest into your team.
* 3. Discord in duels. If you end up in a 1v1, always start by getting Discord on them.

* 4. Discord channelling ultimates. Heroes who have a channelled ultimate like Sojourn and Genji should always get a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord as soon as you hear their voiceline.
* Wait for the enemy Tank to push up
* * If you Discord the enemy Tank too early, they can easily hide for a second and cleanse Discord. Then you won’t be able to reapply for 6 seconds. That’s a big window in Overwatch time!
* Watch for flankers
* * As soon as you see an enemy flanking you or another ally, put Discord on them. They’ll either retreat, or they’ll be forced to deal with the extra damage and threat to their life.

Guide.title: (Melee): Snap Kick
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/snap-kick.png)Snap Kick
* Get off me!

* * Ever since ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta was given a knockback melee, his survivability has gone up. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/snap-kick.png)Snap Kick is very useful to keep some distance between you and your attacker.
* Combos

* * The damage plus brief movement lock from the knockback gives ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta a nice little combo: Kick + body shot deals 110 damage, and Kick + headshot deals 160 damage!
* In small rooms or near walls, you can Kick, shoot, shoot, repeat until the enemy dies.
* Understand the enemy's strengths.

* * If the enemy deals more damage at close range, try to stay far enough away to never have to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/snap-kick.png)Snap Kick them.
* Example: Rein or Reaper are attacking you. Don’t walk up to kick them. Keep walking backwards and only Kick them if they forcefully get into your range.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Transcendence
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence
* Counter ult

* * Use Transcendence to counter enemy ultimates. Especially when the enemy has powerful ults like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dragonblade.png)Dragonblade or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/graviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge, save it to save your team when they use their ult.
* Blocked by LoS and barriers

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt's shield, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston's bubble and all other barriers cut off ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence's healing. If you see one ally blocked by a structure or barrier, try to get around to keep them alive.
* Second chance at life
* * The most important thing in OW is being alive. If you’re definitely going to die, it’s worth it to use Transcendence to save yourself if the rest of your team is alive.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyattatakes a long time to get back to the fight so the strategy of saving Transcendence doesn’t work out in the end.
* If it’s just you and one other teammate alive versus 5 enemies, then let yourself die because you’ll waste Transcendence and die as soon as it is over.
* Go forward, then retreat

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta should push way up during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence so his team can be in optimal range to attack during the healing ult.

* Just don’t forget to get back to safety before ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence's duration runs out, or you will die as soon as it's over.

Guide.title: Discordant Repair
content: * New positioning possibilities

* * Instead of just increasing one of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta's abilities, Ascendance gives him a completely new power that opens up a lot of new playmaking opportunities.
* Hover between high ground

* * Maps with lots of high ground are usually difficult for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta , but with Ascendance, he can keep the high ground once he has it.

* Example: Numbani opening capture point. Zen can use staircases to get to any of the high ground areas. Afterwards, he uses Ascendance to float between high ground to reposition for either defensive protection or an offensive attack.
* Shoot over walls and barriers
* * Charge up a secondary fire, then double jump above a wall or a barrier and attack from an angle not possible without hover.
* Find new flank spots

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta loves flanking and looking to delete an unsuspecting foe with a fully charged right-click. Many maps have perimeter paths that ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta can only traverse with Ascendance. Be on the lookout and experiment.

Guide.title: Focused Destruction
content: * Increased offensive threat
* One-shot 300HP heroes

* * Normally, a fully charged volley will kill the standard 250 HP hero. With Focused Destruction, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta now eliminates all heroes up to 300HP like Mei and Reaper.

* You can spam secondary fire more often because of the faster charge speed, but the same tips and principles apply from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-destruction.png)Orb of Destruction (Charge) tips above.

Guide.title: Dual Harmony
content: * Recommended Major Perk
* The net gain is +40% healing which translates to faster ultimate charging. Moreover, keeping two allies with sustain is a lot stronger than a bit more healing on a single target.

Guide.title: Maps
content: The best maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta allow him to abuse his superior ranged poke damage. Long sight lines and plenty of corners to peek around make it easier for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta to perform well. Because he has poor mobility, maps with very tall high ground either leave him at a disadvantage on the floor or force him to waste time finding a long walking path up. Small maps can also prove challenging to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta since he wants to keep his distance and has trouble dealing with flankers. Game modes with payloads give him a natural moving cover to always play around. Additionally, his team benefits from Zen sitting on cart, since it allows the rest of them to push up.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta is the master of poke comps. Not only is his ranged damage insane with no falloff, but ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord combined with a poke team's focus fire will delete any enemy. Pretty much any hero with ranged damage works great alongside him.

He can also be an extremely powerful asset in dive comps for similar reasons. The dive allies collapse on the discorded target, instantly turning the fight into a 5v4, and win from there. The only drawback is if the enemy team is also running dive; Zen will be the first one targeted, and he'll need an ally like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/baptiste.png)Baptiste or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko to help protect him.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: The thing every hero needs to do against Zen is cleanse his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord by breaking LoS. If you are someone who needs to push up: walk in, get discorded, briefly retreat to clear the mark, then push up for real. If you are a ranged hero sitting back, just hide for a second before peeking again.

For specific counters, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/particle-barrier.png)Particle Barrier cleanses discord, and any hero with the mobility to dive Zen can quickly take him out early if they can get close.

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta can’t escape flank and dive attacks. Coordinate with at least one teammate and surprise attack him simultaneously for an easy kill.

Cleanse ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/orb-of-discord.png)Orb of Discord by breaking LoS before committing to your attack. You don’t want to move in deep just to get blown up by the extra Discord damage.

If you don’t see ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta , assume he is charging up a volley. Get behind a barrier and watch your flank.
