Guide.title: Overview
content: Daughter of Torbjӧrn and squire to the knightly Reinhardt, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/brigitte.png)Brigitte combines the best of their abilities into a unique melee Support kit. Armed with her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-flail.png)Rocket Flail, she swings away at her enemies and whips them back when they get too close. As a Support, her kit pairs best with heroes who don’t demand a ton of healing, but instead, look to make fights quick and decisive.

Depending on team comps, objective mode, and map, she’ll either sit back to protect her backline or position up front with her Tank and press ahead while pushing the enemy back. Brig players need to master decision-making rather than mechanics. Her abilities are easy to use, but knowing when and where to use her abilities can be quite challenging in this fast-paced and highly mobile era of Overwatch.

Guide.title: Playing As
content: * Protect your backline. Don’t let your other Support die because they are the key to keeping the rest of your team alive.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot off cooldown to maximize Inspire uptime. When in range, use Flail to proc Inspire and save Whip Shot.
* Primarily use Shield Bash as a movement tool. Use it to either quickly advance on the enemy or escape to a safer position.

Guide.title: Playing Against
content: * Poke. Brig can’t directly deal with poke damage, and it's a great way to pressure her Shield and keep her playing passively.

* Soft engage to get ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shotout, then use movement cooldowns when she can’t knock you away.
* Target her allies. Brig’s healing is pretty slow, so often the best strategy is to kill the rest of her team first, then her last.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Protector
* AoE healing
* 1v1 duelist
* Squishy
* Lacks burst healing
* Weak vs poke

Guide.title: Backline Protector
content: Brig specializes in keeping her fellow backliners safe from flanks and dives. Between her healing, a ranged knockback, and a Shield, Brig creates a second line of defense that the enemy must fight hard to break through. When paired with a high healing Support, Brig protects while the other Support pumps out endless healing.

Guide.title: AoE and ranged healing
content: While she doesn’t heal as quickly, she can heal indefinitely. Inspire and Rally have large AoE healing that the entire team can simultaneously benefit from, and Repair Packs are great for healing allies deep in enemy territory. Also, unlike many other Supports, Brig doesn’t have to swap between healing and damage.

Guide.title: 1v1 dueler
content: A Shield to block damage and high damage in close range makes her someone you do not want to end up in a 1v1 with. Other than Tanks, Brig can outduel any hero as long as she has a healthy Shield.

Guide.title: Brawl range, but squishy
content: Unlike early release Brig in the days of GOATS, the current Brig gets quickly punished for bad positioning and being overly aggressive. Her attacks have limited range, but if she tries to brawl with her Tank, she’ll get deleted.

Guide.title: Lacks burst healing
content: Aside from the tiny 25 instant health from Repair Pack, all of Brig's healing is slow. When an ally is on the verge of death, Brig is not the Support to heal them back to life. Be prepared for plenty of games where people ask you to swap because they think the answer is always, “more healing.”

Guide.title: Struggles against poke comps
content: Brig has very advantageous matchups, but she also has multiple hard counters. She can’t contribute anything to the poke phase of fights. She has a limited number of Repair Packs and would be much better off as any other Support if she’s gonna sit back and heal-bot. Also, there’s not much she can do on her own to counter poke comps, and she ends up spending most of the match hiding.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Rocket Flail
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-flail.png)Rocket Flail
* Cleave damage
* * Against closely grouped enemies, be sure to hit multiple enemies with each swing to maximize damage and ult generation.

* Rotate your camera in the same direction as Brig is swinging to widen the area ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rocket-flail.png)Rocket Flail hits.
* Proc Inspire

* * Even if you can only get in one swing between ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-shield.png)Barrier Shield, it's worth it to keep Inspire up.
* Not a Tank
* * Brig isn’t a Tank, so don’t get caught up trying to brawl the frontline all the time. You’ll just die over and over.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Barrier Shield
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-shield.png)Barrier Shield
* Corner Peek

* * Brig goes into 3rd person when using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-shield.png)Barrier Shield. Stand at a corner and use this to look around and gain information about enemy position and cooldown usage without having to take any damage.
* Safe approach
* * Use Shield to walk up or across the map while being protected.
* Block CC
* * Against enemies with CC, watch them and reactively block their attack with Barrier Shield.
* Don’t Break

* * Breaking your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-shield.png)Barrier Shield puts it on a long 5-second cooldown whereas you can normally activate it over and over with no cooldown.
* Even a 1 HP Shield will protect you from an instant kill ability like D.Va Bomb.
* You also can’t Bash for movement without Shield, so always try to leave some health.
* Don’t flash

* * The Shield's health only regenerates after not being deployed for a full 2 seconds. If you needlessly flash the Shield, you’ll keep resetting the timer and never recover health for when you really need it.

Guide.title: Alternate fire: Shield Bash
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/shield-bash.png)Shield Bash
* Movement
* * Believe it or not, the main use for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/shield-bash.png)Shield Bash is movement and not damage.
* Here’s your primary gameplay loop: walk up, proc Inspire, then Shield Bash back to safety.

* Against full dive comps, always save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/shield-bash.png)Shield Bash to escape. You can ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot one enemy away, then Shield bash away from the other.
* Bash Jump
* * Find vertical structures that are slanted backward like broken walls. Jump and Bash, then Brig will ramp off them and gain extra vertical height.
* Useful to get to the high ground for attacking or escaping.
* Countercharge
* * Abilities like Doomfist's Rocket Punch and Reinhardt’s Charge can be countercharged, resulting in both of you being hard knocked down.
* Tanks have way more health than you and are far more likely to survive the knockdown than you are. Try not to countercharge unless you have team resources to help you live the stun.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Whip Shot
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot
* Proc Inspire
* * Your first focus with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot is keeping Inspire's uptime high.

* Tanks are typically the easiest target to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot as they play more forward and are large.
* Protect yourself and your team

* * Brig is a backline protector. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot is her first line of defense against attackers. Knock enemies out of position, off high ground, or away from your allies.
* Combos
* * Flail → Bash → Flail → Whip Shot: your fastest burst combo. Deals 230 damage, and KOs 225 HP heroes who don't receive healing.
* Add an extra Flail against 250 HP enemies.
* Keep ‘em close
* * When you’re trying to kill someone, don’t Whip Shot unless it knocks them into a wall or is the final blow. Otherwise, they’ll be out of your range but still able to attack you.

Guide.title: [E]: Repair Pack
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/repair-pack.png)Repair Pack
* Healing priority

* * Most of the time, you’ll be paired with another Support like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana with way higher healing output than you. Let them focus on keeping your Tank alive.
* Brig’s first priority is keeping her 2nd Support alive, then healing DPS, and only heal Tank when there is no one else who needs it.
* Travel time

* * At max distance, it takes approximately .5 seconds for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/repair-pack.png)Repair Pack to get to your ally. Don’t wait too long, as soon as they are taking damage, give them one pack.
* Doesn’t stack
* * Only the instant 25 healing is added, so never double-heal the same target.

* Once the 2-second duration has expired, you can use another ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/repair-pack.png)Repair Pack on your ally. You’ll heal them for way more using this strategy.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Rally
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rally.png)Rally
* One-time armor

* * Brig heals all her allies during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rally.png)Rally and continually gives them overhealth, but only gives herself a single burst of 100 armor. However, the armor pool can be restored by ally healing.
* Coordinate with your other Support and keep your over-armor up.
* Ally overhealth

* * In between fights, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rally.png)Rally's overhealth lasts up to 30 seconds. So even if you use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rally.png)Rally early, or suddenly win the fight, your allies can still benefit from the extra health whenever they start taking damage.
* Defense or offensive ult?

* * Unlike other healing ults, Rally isn’t necessarily a defensive ult. It can save your team, but many offensive enemy ults will kill through its healing, where ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/transcendence.png)Transcendence or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier would keep them alive.
* Respond to the enemy’s commitment

* * A great time to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rally.png)Rally is when the enemy team has already committed to the fight by pushing way up into your team, or using their long cooldowns and ultimate abilities.
* Rally can turn the tide in your favor and win your team the fight.
* Go signal

* * The burst of healing and speed from Rally also functions as a signal to attack for your team. When you see your team has an advantageous opportunity but they're sitting still, Rally them together and push forward!
* Stay alive, you’re not a raid boss

* * Most importantly, don’t die during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rally.png)Rally. 10 seconds duration makes it one of the longest Support Ults. But that doesn’t matter if you’re dead.
* You still have to play safe and apply the same positioning principles you use without Rally. Push up a bit, go for realistic kills, and remember you’re far from invincible.

Guide.title: Passive: Inspire
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/inspire.png)Inspire
* Low healing per second, with large AoE

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/inspire.png)Inspire has the lowest single-target healing output of any Support ability. Its strength lies in its large AoE and high uptime when managed correctly.
* Requires LoS
* * Even if an ally is in range, Inspire’s healing won’t activate for them if they are behind an enemy Shield or some type of wall.
* Persists once activated
* * Once an ally is being healed by Inspire, they can leave Brig’s LoS and still get the full duration of healing.
* Useful when paired with dive or rush heroes that move faster than Brig can keep up.
* Proc Inspire off Ult deployables
* * Wrecking Ball Mines, B.O.B., and even Junkrat Tire all can be used to proc Inspire.
* Standard deployables do not proc ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/inspire.png)Inspire, however.

Guide.title: Combat Medic
content: * Recommended Minor Perk

* Keep an eye on your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/repair-pack.png)Repair Pack cooldowns when brawling. Try to not let it sit at 3 packs when you have the opportunity to swing on the enemy so that you can maximize the benefit and extra healing output.
* Good when the team needs extra healing
* * When you see the other Support struggling to keep your allies alive, Combat Medic is the way to go.

Guide.title: Morale Boost
content: * Pick when struggling to keep Inspire up.
* Whip Shot and Inspire

* * Inspire lasts four seconds, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot is a four-second cooldown. Therefore, if you land two Whip Shots in a row, you won’t even be benefiting from Morale Boost.
* If you find your Inspire uptime is low or are struggling to find consistent opportunities to proc Inspire, Morale Boost can be a good choice.

Guide.title: Inspiring Strike
content: * Movement
* * Bash movement is one of the most important tools Brig has in her arsenal. Gaining even movement speed buff just makes it that much stronger.
* Increased aggression
* * Brig can be more aggressive with her positiong when using Inspiring Strike because she can dive and rush down enemies faster, and disengage faster as well.
* The instant Inspire healing also makes her tankier in duels.

Guide.title: Whiplash
content: * Situational, but clutch

* * You won’t be benefiting from wall damage every time you ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot, but when you do, the extra damage can secure kills or create the pressure needed to win the fight.
* Best on enclosed maps
* * Maps with lots of structures and walls give you more opportunities to line up wall slams.
* Try to strafe and line up enemies with any structure to get more wall slams in each game.
* Unique breakpoints
* * The extra 50 damage creates new “one-shot” combos against 225 and 275 HP heroes:
* 235 damage combo: Flail → Bash → Whip Shot-wall-slam
* 280 damage combo: Flail → Bash → Flail → Whip Shot-wall-slam

Guide.title: Best Maps
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/brigitte.png)Brigitte's game plan can adapt to most scenarios because she combines close-range offensive capabilities and medium-range healing. Maps that favor poke comps, however, give her a lot of trouble. Long sight lines are the opposite of what Brig wants. Close small maps, corners, and natural cover are map features that best enable Brig.

High ground is a double-edged sword for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/brigitte.png)Brigitte players. On one hand, she lacks vertical mobility and has a hard time approaching enemies set up on high ground positions. On the other hand, once she is on the high ground, she can force the enemy to give up the space. Also, on defense, Brig’s ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot is incredibly strong for keeping enemies off and her team firmly in place.

Guide.title: Watchpoint
content: Gibraltar

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Team comps built around ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/brigitte.png)Brigitte have heroes who struggle to survive on their own but have strong offensive or utility kits. Brig is great at protecting her allies, so if everyone has a lot of their own survivability, she doesn’t bring her maximum value. She’s also great at enabling heroes through her ranged healing and Whip Shot. Brig needs at least one hero to position with, so she doesn’t fit well into teams that want to play spread out or reposition too quickly.
**Example of a team comp built around Brigitte:**
* **Tank**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya

* **DPS**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/symmetra.png)Symmetra, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja

* **Supports**: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/brigitte.png)Brigitte, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana

Guide.title: Individual Hero Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya performs best when she can keep her targets near the outer ranges of her primary fire. When the enemy Tank can get right on top of her, she can struggle in the match-up. Brig’s Whip Shot helps ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya to control space and maintain her ideal range. Once Rally comes online, the speed boost and armor enable ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya to rush down the enemy team and wipe out their backline.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/symmetra.png)Symmetra

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/symmetra.png)Symmetra and Brig pair extremely well together because of similar brawl-hybrid playstyles. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/symmetra.png)Symmetra gives Brig much-needed mobility through her TP. The range of Repair Packs and TP is nearly identical as well, which enables ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/symmetra.png)Symmetra and allies to be on opposite ends of the TP from Brig and still receive her healing. Anyone who gets TP dove by Brig and Sym is instantly dead because of their high damage and sustain combo.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana is one of the best healing and utility Supports in Overwatch. Her only weakness is being everyone's favorite dive target because she lacks a lethal threat outside of landing Sleep and Nade. Brig makes up for her weakness by being her protector. If ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana is safe to pump healing and cooldowns into her team, her team will not lose. This is only possible with Brig, however, because she is the best Support at keeping Ana alive while Ana keeps the rest of the team alive.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Poke. Brig can’t directly deal with poke damage, and it's a great way to pressure her Shield and keep her playing passively.

Soft engage to get ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/whip-shot.png)Whip Shot out, then use movement cooldowns when she can’t knock you away.
Target her allies. Brig’s healing is pretty slow, so often the best strategy is to kill the rest of her team first, then her last.

Guide.title: Overview
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball is a disruption-first Tank built around mobility, area control, and chaos creation rather than raw frontline durability. He may be an adorable hamster, but he won’t hesitate to slam down and blow up the entire enemy team.

In team compositions, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball's primary objective is to deny the enemy team space. No matter where they set up, Ball rolls in, boops them away, and tells them they can’t sit here. He doesn’t hold ground in the traditional sense, but he steals attention and cannot be ignored. By forcing multiple enemies to respond to him at once, Ball removes pressure from his team.

He excels at isolating vulnerable enemies and controlling the pace of fights. When played correctly, the enemy team can never relax or fully focus on what is in front of them because they never know when he’ll come rolling in.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Scout before fully committing. Roll through without using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/adaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield to learn enemy positions and bait out their crowd control.
* Path to attack from the enemy's rear or flank. Don’t roll or swing head-on into the enemy because that will make it easy for them to stop you.
* Go airborne, drop ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/minefield.png)Minefield, then slam down to boop and keep enemies in your Mines.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Track his ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/adaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield. If he hasn’t used them, don’t use your stuns yet, or he’ll easily survive.
* Pick a hero with kockbacks or stuns. Dealing with Ball is very hard without good CC.
* Don’t get isolated. Instead, position with at least one teammate so you don’t get caught in a 1v1 with Ball.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Great mobility
* Disruptive hero
* Great at stalling
* Vulnerable to CC
* Requires good game sense
* Difficult to play

Guide.title: Unmatched Mobility
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball can traverse enormous distances very quickly. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/grappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw is also a short cooldown, so he can reposition often. There’s nowhere on a map that ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball cannot quickly access.

Guide.title: Disruptive
content: Boops and knock-ups break enemy positioning and force them into disadvantageous areas. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball can knock the entire enemy team off high ground, and by the time they get back, he will definitely have another grapple.

Guide.title: Stalling
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/adaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield, health packs, quick movement, and spin to win. No one is better than ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball at stalling objectives and buying time for the rest of their team to return to the objective. He’s very difficult to eliminate and often wastes a ton of the enemy's time.

Guide.title: Vulnerable to Crowd Control
content: Unless he’s using Adaptive Barrier, Ball doesn’t have much counterplay to CC outside of just tanking the damage. Against teams that have multiple heroes with stuns, he really struggles to do anything.

Guide.title: Relies on Game Sense
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball isn’t so lethal that he can just mow over a team. Instead, he needs to have a keen understanding of what the enemy is trying to do, and know how to interrupt or stop their plan. It’s also crucial for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball players to track cooldowns and enemy positions. There is a lot to keep track of, and if you're just swinging and slamming without a clear purpose, you're going to lose a lot of games.

Guide.title: Niche Mechanical Tech
content: To really excel on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball, you need to spend a good amount of time learning his specific tech. Wall jumps, double boops, sling shots, and grapple retraction are just a few of the things you’ll need to learn to maximize his kit. You also need quick reflexes to keep up with his speed, and excellent tracking to finish off enemies you booped and slammed.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Quad Cannons
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/quad-cannons.png)Quad Cannons
* You can poke a bit to distract the enemy team, farm some Ult charge, but it's not very good ranged damage.
* The main use for your primary fire is to follow up on your rolls and slams. After you get the enemy low, burn through the rest of their health with primary fire and melee.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Grappling Claw
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/grappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/grappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw to access high ground, scout safely, and create unpredictable engage angles.
* Do not force attacks early. Remember, you are way faster than anyone else on your team. Avoid feeding by attacking the entire enemy team before your team arrives.
* While dueling, you can grapple anywhere above you and retract to get the height needed for a slam.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Roll
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/roll.png)Roll

* Think of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/roll.png)Roll as your primary movement tool instead of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/grappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw. Using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/roll.png)Roll to reposition or engage allows you to save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/grappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw cooldown.
* Avoid long, exposed rotations; always choose the shortest path to cover so you don’t get killed while rolling around.

Guide.title: [Crouch]: Pile Driver
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/piledriver.png)Piledriver

* Best used after scouting and identifying what heroes the enemy is playing. Don’t ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/piledriver.png)Piledriver into heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana unless you know for a fact they just used their stun.

* Can be performed from ledges. The ground just needs to be far enough below ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball to trigger ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/piledriver.png)Piledriver after that, he can move back onto higher ground for the actual slam.

Guide.title: [E]: Adaptive Shield
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/adaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield
* The amount of shields generated scales with the number of nearby enemies. Make sure to use them after you are fighting and near enemies, not before you engage.
* If there’s no immediate threat of death, like multiple stuns or you are very low on HP, save shields and rely on movement, Support healing, and cover to survive.

* Always try to force out the enemy's best crowd control abilities without committing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/adaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield; that way, you can roll out, then re-engage with shields before they get their cooldowns again.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Minefield
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/minefield.png)Minefield

* Go airborne (by rolling from high ground or swinging in), drop ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/minefield.png)Minefield, then ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/piledriver.png)Piledriver to launch up enemies, keep them near your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/minefield.png)Minefield.
* The objective area is the main zone you should be dropping mines on.
* Drop mines behind the enemy frontline to prevent their retreat and separate them from the rest of their team.

Guide.title: Steamroller
content: * Not very impactful as an extra 60 damage on Tanks isn’t making a notable difference. Also, Tanks should not be your main target.

Guide.title: Multi-Ball
content: * Extra area denial and counterplay to escapes. For example, if you try to slam and drop mines on a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira but they Fade away, chase them, then drop the additional mines to trap them for a kill.

* Even better when you save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/grappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw for after your Ult. Use high ground to roll in instead of swinging so you can immediately chase.

Guide.title: Hang Time
content: * Good against squishy heroes with poor mobility like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zenyatta.png)Zenyatta or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hanzo.png)Hanzo.

Guide.title: Adaptive Barrier
content: * Very strong as it gives you direct counterplay against crowd control, such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/roadhog.png)Roadhog ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart.

Guide.title: Maps
content: Because ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball can use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/grappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/roll.png)Roll to move both vertically and horizontally, he performs well on maps with high ground as well as flatter layouts. Ideally, there is high ground or a ledge for him to use for a Piledriver or to sneak up on targets.

When the enemy team holds the high ground, Wrecking Ball is the best hero to roll through and knock them off. On flat ground, your goal should be to separate and disrupt: roll through, bait out cooldowns you can dodge, then return a few seconds later to fully commit with shields to secure eliminations.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Heroes played with Wrecking Ball need to be **self-sufficient** or paired with an ally who can protect them. Unlike most other Tanks, he offers no direct protection to his allies; if you pick a hero like Zenyatta, expect to fend for yourself against flankers.

For offense, two types of heroes work best with Wrecking Ball. First are fellow dive heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo, who can use her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sticky-bombs.png)Sticky Bombs and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/focusing-beam.png)Focusing Beam combo on his slams to blow up almost any target. Alternatively, ranged heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ashe.png)Ashe or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn can snipe enemies popped into the air by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/piledriver.png)Piledriver.
If you are waiting and ready, Wrecking Ball will hand you easy headshots.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: Wrecking Ball is one of the best stalling heroes in Overwatch. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/adaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield and his high mobility make him difficult to eliminate. The easiest way to take him out is to chain CC with your allies. If you hit him with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mizuki.png)Mizuki’s ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/binding-chain.png)Binding Chain followed by a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/accretion.png)Accretion, he is likely dead. Knockback is also effective for stopping his momentum and causing his slams to miss.

He doesn't have much counterplay against fliers, so you have plenty of options like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/pharah.png)Pharah or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/jetpack-cat.png)Jetpack Cat.

If you play heroes without stuns, the most important thing is to hold your cooldowns until you see him use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/adaptive-shield.png)Adaptive Shield. If his shields are still available, it is nearly impossible to kill him, and your cooldowns will be wasted.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters names
content: mizuki
sigma
pharah
jetpack-cat

Guide.title: Overview
content: Having two separate ability kits in one hero enables ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra to be highly adaptable and perform well against almost any team composition. In Omnic Form, Ram can outrange most ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks, and with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/void-accelerator-omnic-form.png)Void Accelerator (Omnic Form), his ranged damage poses a significant threat to enemy backlines.

The core of his power lies in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form, where he gains bonus armor and access to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) — a hard-hitting melee projectile that pierces barriers. His playstyle revolves around chipping down enemy health and resources in Omnic Form, then transforming into Nemesis to rush down the enemy when they are most vulnerable. If the enemy team lacks stuns or knockback, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/annihilation.png)Annihilation is often a fight-winning ultimate.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form is the core of your power. It enables aggression and survivability. Only activate it when enemies are already within ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) range.

* Save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/ravenous-vortex.png)Ravenous Vortex for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form to slow enemies and prevent escape.

* Activate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/annihilation.png)Annihilation immediately after Nemesis ends to maximize survivability and Nemesis uptime.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra is less tanky and less lethal in Omnic Form. After Nemesis ends, that is your window to go on the offensive.

* Break line of sight (LoS) on his ultimate to end it quickly. Cutting off ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/annihilation.png)Annihilation's AoE for a total of 3 seconds will immediately cancel it.
* If Ram is walking toward you, expect a Vortex. Use mobility or cover before he throws it.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * High survival rate
* Good rush
* Hybrid hero
* Obvious cooldown rotation
* Countered by CC
* Huge Hurtbox

Guide.title: High survivability
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra gains 300 bonus armor whenever he activates ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form, including during his ultimate. He can block for the entire Nemesis duration and deploy a high-health barrier in Omnic Form. Combined, this gives him exceptional durability and strong stalling potential.

Guide.title: Good at rushing down
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form grants bonus movement speed, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/ravenous-vortex.png)Ravenous Vortex applies a slow, allowing Ram to effectively rush down targets. Pummel’s barrier-piercing damage secures kills once he closes the gap.

Guide.title: Versatile hybrid kit
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra can function in brawl, rush, and poke compositions. Omnic Form pressures high ground and backlines with ranged damage, while ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form enables frontline brawling.

Guide.title: Obvious cooldown rotation
content: Ram’s use of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form can feel very predictable and easy to play around. When the enemy has the mobility to kite Nemesis, Ram struggles to generate value for his team.

Guide.title: Countered by crowd control
content: Anytime Ram pops Nemesis, it's like he puts on a huge, “stun me” sign. He has no way of stopping stuns like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart or Shatter. Also, because of the short range of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form), knockback abilities shut down Nemesis just as effectively.

Guide.title: Giant Hurtbox with minimal shielding
content: Although Ram has high survivability thanks to his Block and armor, he’s also easy to turn into an ult battery. His large body allows heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/freja.png)Freja and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sojourn.png)Sojourn to use Ram to farm ammo for their guns. Everyone else can use him to farm ult. During Nemesis, it's open season for long-range heroes, and Omnic Form is easy for close-range heroes to aggro on.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Void Accelerator
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/void-accelerator-omnic-form.png)Void Accelerator (Omnic Form)
* Poke pressure

* * Before you get into ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) range, you should always be poking with primary fire as much as possible.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/void-accelerator-omnic-form.png)Void Accelerator (Omnic Form) is also good for contesting high ground since you don’t have any vertical mobility.
* Bait

* * Use Omnic form as a way bait the enemy while saving ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form. Once they’re approaching you, if they are investing a lot of resources like using their ults, use Vortex and shield to keep yourself protected, then use Nemesis after.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Void Barrier
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/void-barrier-omnic-form.png)Void Barrier (Omnic Form)
* Enable team poke
* * Don’t just use Barrier selfishly; look for moments where you can create opportunities for your allies to peek and go for picks behind the protection of your Barrier.
* Cut off the enemy Tank

* * Anytime an enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank is out in front of their team, deploy your Barrier behind them. They’ll be cut off from healing, and won’t have their team's damage to help pressure your team.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Nemesis Form
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form
* Respond to the enemy's offensive plays

* * You can’t survive aggressive enemy attacks and dives unless you have ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form available. When you read the enemy is trying to quickly advance on you, save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form until they have committed their cooldowns to the fight.
* Enable your aggression

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form transforms Ram into a massive walking threat. You can alternate between ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) and Block to tank damage while using the increased walk speed to take space and attack the enemy's backline.

Guide.title: (During Nemesis Form) Primary Fire: Pummel
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form)
* Counter damage mitigation

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) pierces barriers and damage-absorbing abilities like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/defense-matrix.png)Defense Matrix and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kinetic-grasp.png)Kinetic Grasp.

* Against ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tanks who use these abilities to survive, wait until they have taken a bit of damage already, then use Nemesis ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) to keep the pressure on while they’re trying to protect themselves.
* Brawl

* * Whether you are dueling a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank, DPS or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Support, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) is how you want to brawl your targets. The repeated bursts of damage from each strike will eliminate most enemies well before they can chip away at your massive health pool.

Guide.title: (During Nemesis Form) Secondary fire: Block
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/block-nemesis-form.png)Block (Nemesis Form)
* Stall

* * Use your armor and damage reduction to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank enemy damage and stall objectives. In overtime, you can buy your team time to return from spawn. In the middle of fights, you can take up enemy damage and prolong fights.
* Time with enemy attacks

* * Ram can weave in Block between Pummels against enemies with slow attack speeds like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sigma.png)Sigma and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt. Block every primary fire, then ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) once or twice to minimize damage taken while still getting in damage of your own.
* Body Block
* * Because you only have a single use of Barrier, the other way Ram can protect his team is by standing in front of them while holding block.
* Protect DPS during their ults, or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/support.svg)Supports when they're being focused.

Guide.title: [E]: Ravenous Vortex
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/ravenous-vortex.png)Ravenous Vortex
* Slow ‘em down
* * When the enemy is trying to push up on you, slow their advance with Vortex. Buy yourself time to wait out their duration-based abilities like channeled ultimates.
* Rush down
* * Use Nemesis’ movement buff to chase down your targets.
* Save Vortex for Nemesis because most heroes can’t dash out of Vortex, fliers get pulled down, and the slow effect keeps them in your Pummels.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Annihilation
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/annihilation.png)Annihilation
* Watch out for stuns

* * During ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/annihilation.png)Annihilation, the enemy knows Ram can’t use Barrier and can easily be CC’d. If you get knocked away or stunned for too long, your ult will quickly end.

* If there is one enemy ability like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart that will shut down your ult, first use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form to get that ability out. Then use ult right after.
* Extending the duration

* * As long as at least one enemy is in the AoE of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/annihilation.png)Annihilation, the ult will not end (up to 20 seconds max). Focus on staying alive with Block, and keeping the enemy in range.
* You can also activate ult in between the enemy team to force them to split up as they run away in multiple directions. Then, focus on the one closest to your team for a quick kill.

Guide.title: Void Surge
content: * Strengthen Ram’s weakness

* * The extra burst damage has more impact than it seems on paper. Also, compared to Prolonged Barrier, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/void-barrier-omnic-form.png)Void Barrier (Omnic Form) never breaks, and an extra second will rarely make a game-changing difference.

* Better damage in Omnic Form allows Ram to be more of a threat while waiting for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form.

Guide.title: Relentless Form
content: * Most of Ram's value is generated while in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form. Being able to extend the duration is really good. You won't always be able to get an elimination, but when you do, this is a very impactful buff.

Guide.title: Nanite Repair
content: * Bit of extra sustain
* * When inside Vortex for the full duration, Ram will heal for 150 health.

* Helpful when brawling because you can throw Vortex at your feet, and stay inside while Pummeling the enemy ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank.

Guide.title: Vengeful Vortex
content: * Better for poke
* * Being able to detonate Vortex in the air makes it easy to catch distant enemies without needing to hit a perfect placement. The 50 detonation damage also helps increase your poke lethality.
* Better rush downs
* * When chasing down an enemy, shoot Vortex in front of them and detonate to force them to walk through. This makes rushing down targets notably easier.

Guide.title: Maps
content: Maps that favor close-range engagements, have smaller objective areas, and little to no high ground are best for Ram. He wants enemies to be close enough to rush them with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form at any moment. Also, because he has good horizontal move speed but no vertical mobility, flat ground areas enable Ram’s play style best. Maps with wide open space and long sight lines are situationally difficult for Ram, depending on the matchup.

If the enemy is running more short-range heroes and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank, then he has the advantage, but if the enemy runs long-range or high-mobility heroes, he’s at a disadvantage. He doesn’t want to waste time trying to approach, and high ground gives the enemy an easy escape from Nemesis and his ult.

Guide.title: Watchpoint
content: Gibraltar

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: Team comps built around ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra can follow and assist him when he goes all in during and . Because Ram gains a move speed buff and immediately becomes the focus of the enemy team, he’ll be taking a huge amount of the enemy team's damage and cooldowns.

His armor and Block help him to survive the attacks, but if he wants to get max value, he needs his team’s assistance with healing himself so he can ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pummel-nemesis-form.png)Pummel (Nemesis Form) and damage the enemy, so he can get the kills. His Barrier can give short windows of protection to snipers and ranged allies, but is can’t be depended on due to its long cooldown.
Anyone who can give him additional speed boosts greatly helps him in bypassing the frontline and quickly killing the squishies.
**Example of a team comp built around Ramattra:**

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/hazard.png)Hazard, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/soldier-76.png)Soldier: 76, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko

Guide.title: Individual synergies with other heroes
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer's objective when teamed up with Ram is to take care of his strongest counter, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer ruins ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana's day because her only hope of dealing with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer is landing a difficult ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart. If she does, then that’s Ram’s go signal for Nemesis and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/annihilation.png)Annihilation because he knows he can hold W without fear of being slept. Most of the time, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer will be able to harass ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana enough that she won’t be a problem for Ram. When they are in sync, Ram’s Vortex makes landing one-clips and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/pulse-bomb.png)Pulse Bombs way easier for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring is the main reason Ram wants ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno on his team. Ram doesn’t constant speed boost, he just needs the extra speed at the exact moment he’s trying to rush in. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/juno.png)Juno can just save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/hyper-ring.png)Hyper Ring for everytime Ram runs in, and he’ll run over everyone. Compared to Lucio, she also has a much easier time healing and keeping Ram alive.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko

* Ram is susceptible to debuff effects, knockback, and stuns. Suzu can counter all of these and enable Ram to play into his counters with great success. Nemesis inside of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/kitsune-rush.png)Kitsune Rush also feels like having a 2nd ult for Ram. Faster walking and attacking speed means the enemy is forced to try and escape, so it's a deadly combination when both teams need to contest the objective area.

Guide.title: **General Mentality Against **
content: * Track Nemesis timing and punish him during his less threatening Omnic Form.
* Save mobility for dodging Vortex. If you are already in Vortex, don't use your mobility abilities until you've escaped.

* Break LoS during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/annihilation.png)Annihilation. If you can't escape, barriers also count as breaking LoS so hold the barrier until the duration expires.
