content: dva
winston
echo
anran

Guide.title: Overview
content: Widely considered to be the easiest hero in OW, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira's skill expression lies in resource management and decision making, as opposed to mechanical prowess. Biotic Grasp’s target tracking beam makes for an excellent choice for players who struggle with accurate aim tracking. Compared to all other non-tank heroes, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira has the highest amount of self-sustain, which enables players to be self-reliant when teamwork is lacking.

The ability to have the highest damage, highest healing and most eliminations in every game often draws players to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira . Instead of being built around utility abilities, her kit is focused on maxing out stats and raw healing/damage output. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira doesn’t have any easily exploitable weaknesses, which makes her difficult to counterpick if a team has a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira player dominating the match.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Prioritize healing resource management by consistantly finding opportunites to deal damage before critical teamfight moments.

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade reactively to escape crowd control abilities and enemy attacks. Reposition to a safer position where the enemy can't easily chase you.
* Throw Biotic Orbs with intention. Damage orbs are good for pressuring squishy targets during fights, but only use them when you have plenty of healing resources available.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Track her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade cooldown and pressure her aggressively once it has been used, as she is highly vulnerable without mobility.
* Avoid giving her free resource generation by minimizing unnecessary poke damage and positioning outside of her Biotic Grasp range.

* Focus her during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coalescence.png)Coalescence with burst damage or crowd control, she'll either be forced to Fade away, or be vulnerable to elimination during the ult.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Self-reliant
* Flexible
* High damage, healing and elims
* Low utility
* Predictable
* Low DPS

Guide.title: Self-Reliant
content: Technically there are three ways for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira to heal herself: Biotic Grasp damage self-heal, Biotic healing orb, and the Support heal passive.

Specifically for Moira, the heal passive becomes incredibly useful given that she can escape almost any encounter with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade, and let the passive heal her up.

Never need to rely on her other Support for healing. When being attacked, Moira can easily disengage with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade instead of needing to call for help.

Guide.title: Flexibility and Mobility
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade's short cooldown gives ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira the opportunity to quickly approach a target either alone or with an ally, then just 6 seconds later, escape to safety.

Close-range AoE healing of Biotic Grasp makes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira great at playing behind her team and healing everyone together. Biotic Orb's infinite range allows her to provide support from any distance to teammates far away.

Also really strong in 1v1 duels. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira basically never misses damage with Biotic Grasp’s auto tracking, simultaneously deals 65 Dmg and 30 HP of self-healing every second, and can output a burst of either damage or healing from Biotic Orb based on the situation.

Guide.title: Insanely high damage, healing, and elim stats
content: Very often you will see a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira player have every top stat in a game. Biotic Orb is best used immediately off cooldown which has Moira sending out AoE damage or healing every 8 seconds!
A damage orb is also a great tool for confirming elims on low health targets,
AoE heal and lingering heal over time of primary fire make Moira unmatched in healing numbers on a team that plays closely grouped up.

Guide.title: Lacks any Utility Abilities
content: Other Supports have highly impactful utility abilities such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu, Anti-Nade, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/immortality-field.png)Immortality Field. Compared to these abilities, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira can only provide a moderate but consistent amount of help to her team at any given time whereas other Supports have single buttons that can save an entire team fight and game.

Guide.title: Predictability
content: Moira’s ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade use can become predictable to enemies, and when they catch her without ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade, she’s an easy pick.

Guide.title: Low DPS
content: While her total damage output is great, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira can't critical hit and has no way to instantly apply huge damage to an enemy. If Moira’s target is being healed by an enemy Support, they often heal through any damage she can do.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Biotic Grasp
content: **Tips for Primary Fire** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grasp.png)Biotic Grasp

* Spray ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grasp.png)Biotic Grasp healing onto allies and allow the lingering 3 seconds of healing over time to top them off instead of wasting Biotic Energy healing them to full HP.

* Advanced tip: Healing spray is technically a slow-traveling projectile that has an on-hit healing and a healing over time. If you are walking toward your ally while healing them, you will effectively heal faster than the standard limit. Conversely, if you are walking away from your ally while healing, you will heal for less than normal due to the projectile travel time.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Biotic Grasp (RMB)
content: **Tips for Secondary Fire** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grasp.png)Biotic Grasp

* Position aggressively enough that you can constantly alternate between dealing damage and healing with ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grasp.png)Biotic Grasp. Maintaining this rhythm gives you near-endless resource uptime.
* A simple cycle to follow:
* * Spray heal → hold damage beam → spray heal → hold damage beam → repeat.

Guide.title: Biotic Orb
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-orb.png)Biotic Orb

* Because ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-orb.png)Biotic Orb provides up to 300 HP of healing but only 200 total damage, Heal Orb generally generates more ultimate charge than Damage Orb.
* Use Damage Orb only when no allies require healing or when confirming eliminations on low-health targets.
* Use Heal Orb when you are low on Biotic Energy or when your team is grouped and actively taking damage.

Guide.title: Fade
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade

* Take full advantage of Fade’s 6-second cooldown. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira has excellent mobility, so you should constantly reposition to optimal angles and cover.
* Jumping at the end of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade carries your momentum and increases travel distance.
* “Fade jumping” off a slanted surface allows Moira to gain significant vertical height, granting access to most high-ground areas.
* * To execute a Fade jump:

* Activate ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade while moving into a slanted object, then press jump just as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade ends. When performed correctly, Moira launches upward while still invisible.
* In general, avoid engaging alone by using Fade offensively. Instead, position without using Fade whenever possible so it remains available as an immediate escape tool.

Guide.title: Coalescence
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coalescence.png)Coalescence

* Contrary to what would seem to be popular belief, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coalescence.png)Coalescence only increases Moira’s damage from 65 to 85 damage per second. On its own, it is not an efficient killing tool. It would take nearly half of the ult’s duration to eliminate a standard 250 HP hero, assuming they receive no healing for over 3 seconds.

* Save ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fade.png)Fade during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coalescence.png)Coalescence whenever possible, as enemies will often focus crowd control abilities on you while you are channeling.
* To maximize value, position your beam so it passes through as many allies and enemies as possible, simultaneously amplifying healing output and damage pressure.

Guide.title: Destruction's Divide
content: * Good for optimizing her Ult’s purpose. Especially if you like to dive in and use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/coalescence.png)Coalescenceoffensively.

Guide.title: Ethical Nourishment
content: * Amazing for giving ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira burst healing. Much more consistent value than Destruction’s Divide.

Guide.title: Reversal
content: * Gives you control over orbs. Use this to keep enemies attached and damage, or give your allies healing for longer.

Guide.title: Phantom Step
content: * Good mobility. Best against dive comps to give you better escapes.
* Also enables more aggressive dive playtsyle for yourself since you have better access to high ground areas.

Guide.title: Lijiang Tower
content: * Control mode in general tends to have good maps for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira since her AoE healing benefits from most of the team being on the objective. The Control point on Night Market in particular is the perfect Biotic Orb bouncing cage. The entire point is surrounded by the square walls where Moira’s damage and healing orbs can stay trapped in, maximizing their output.

Guide.title: Eichenwalde
content: * The majority of fighting on Eichenwalde usually occurs at one of the 4 main choke points. Every one of these choke points are great for Moira as she can choose to send a healing orb sideways into her team to bounce back to them off a wall or have a straight shot through the enemy team for a damage orb.

Guide.title: New Junk City
content: * Flashpoint maps favor horizontal mobility and mid-range combat. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira is the queen of both of these. Every objective point has cover to play around that puts Moira in range for Biotic Grasp’s damage beam. The map layout also pairs well with offensive Biotic Orbs. Enemy backlines usually position around a wall behind the objective point where you can Fade in aggressively for the elimination.

Guide.title: Watchpoint Gibraltar
content: * The high ground in Watchpoint Gibraltar is too high for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira. There are a few fade jump spots for those with the skill and knowledge, but defenders on high ground are difficult for Moira to damage. On defense herself, the high ground also puts her out of range to attack most of the enemy team. Coalescence is also not particularly good on any of the three objective points.

Guide.title: Paraiso
content: * Attacking or defending the first point with Moira can be very difficult. You’ll often find that on Paraiso, it feels like you have to healbot your team and hope they get picks before getting eliminated. Breaking through each point on this map is much easier when playing one of the more utility-based supports.

Guide.title: Havana
content: * Havana’s line of sights are way too long for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira. She struggles to manage healing resources because her team will be taking way more poke damage if they have long-range support instead of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira, and she won’t be able to find enough targets for Biotic Grasp. Fade’s movement is also too short to get across the wide open areas between cover. There are

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: The best team comps to play ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira in like to be grouped together as often as possible. This allows Moira to maximize healing output and farm her ult extremely quickly. The team also benefits from constantly receiving healing. On the other hand, Moira’s flexible kit also enables her to do well with dive comps since she can follow up on their aggression or survive on her own when the rest of the team spreads out.
**Example of a team comp built around Moira:**

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junkrat.png)Junkrat, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio

Guide.title: Individual synergies with other heroes
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/zarya.png)Zarya

* Zarya and Moira both play off of each other really well. Zarya team comps also tend to be grouped into rush or deathball styles. Both heroes also have similar range with their damage beams. Zarya Projected Barrier enables ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira to make aggressive plays and makes an offensive Coalescence very difficult to shut down.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/cassidy.png)Cassidy

* Cassidy’s larger HP pool means he can play up front with his tank. This puts him in the ideal position to receive healing from ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira. When Cassidy gets an enemy low who retreats behind cover, a damage orb is an excellent way to finish off the elimination.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lucio.png)Lúcio

* Due to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira teams wanting to stay grouped together, Lucio’s speed boost is the secret ingredient to ensure you can move the entire team where they need to be. Moira’s high healing output allows Lucio to stay on speed boost more often and not have to worry about needing to use Amp it Up for healing.

Guide.title: How to Counter
content: When playing against a ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira, you want to take advantage of her lack of utility. This means making riskier, more aggressive plays. Moira is the strongest when team fights are slow and long because she provides massive amounts of sustain over a long period of time but she's unable to save her team from sudden bursts of damage. Tracking fade is the best way to shut down a Moira who keeps going for aggressive plays herself. If you’re using comms with your team, quickly calling out “No fade,” and pinging where the Moira went is a good way to signal when Moira can be killed.

When both teams have Moira, whichever one can out-stat the other typically wins. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira diff, really just comes down to who can stay alive, deal more damage, and provide more healing. If two Moiras end up in a 1v1 situation, healing orb beats damage orb because of the 100 HP value difference and Moira’s slow damage per second.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va

* The mech flying Pro Gamer is the hardest counter to Moira. Defense Matrix easily eats every damage orb sent to her team, and D.Va can also fly in, eat heal orbs, and fly out. Booster’s cooldown is even shorter than Fade, making D.Va one of the best Moira killers around.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer

* Tracer's horizontal mobility far outclasses Moira’s. Three blinks can easily chase down Moira, no matter where she Fades to, and recall, let's Tracer get out after confirming the kill. At close range, Tracer melts Moira way faster than her Biotic Orb can heal her. Although Biotic Grasp makes damaging Tracer easy, Moira has no way to shut down Tracer or deal with Tracer harassing her allies.
![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana

* Anti-Nade is basically a death sentence against any ally that Moira is trying to keep alive. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/moira.png)Moira has zero counterplay to Anti-Nade. Furthermore, you may be surprised at how often Ana players hit sleeps on an ulting Moira. Sleep Dart also makes it extremely dangerous for Moira to go in deep.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters names
content: dva
tracer
ana

Guide.title: Overview
content: Using the power of life-giving light and plant matter, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver heals the wounds of his allies. The lock-on mechanic of his primary healing makes ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver a very accessible hero for new and experienced players alike.

With a very defensive kit, Lifeweaver never wants to be the first on his team to advance, he prefers staying in the back where he can keep an eye on his allies and assist wherever needed. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform and Life Grip are on longer cooldowns than most Support abilities, but their game-saving potential makes up for their low deploy frequency.

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver is an excellent choice whenever you want to focus on healing and saving your teammates. His kit enables unique positional strategies since he can move his team to places no other Support can.

Guide.title: Play As
content: * Play corners. The charging and lock-on qualities of Healing Blossom enable ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver to position near cover better than most Supports. Stay covered when charging, and peek only when firing the projectile.
* Life Grip allies that your regular healing won’t be able to save.

* Use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform to give yourself and allies without vertical mobility access to high ground.

Guide.title: Play Against
content: * Focus your dives and flanks on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver . He won’t be personally killing you, so your only hindrance is his allies' protection.
* Save your best cooldowns until after Life Grip has been used. After you’ve seen someone get pulled, you have a long window of time to attack where your target can’t be saved by Grip.

* Pick a hero with vertical mobility. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver can easily avoid you if you can’t chase him vertically when he uses ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform.

Guide.title: Strengths And Weaknesses Summarized
content: * Lock-on healing
* Team verticality
* Instant save
* Struggles vs dive
* Single-target abilities
* Struggles to be proactive

Guide.title: Lock-on healing
content: When playing with high mobility allies, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver's lock-on primary fire makes a big difference in how consistently your allies will be receiving healing. Also, you don’t have to focus much on aiming and can give more attention to hero positioning and strategy.

Guide.title: Team verticality
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform has the unique ability to give vertical access to heroes who would have no other way of reaching high ground. It can be used multiple times in a row, so anyone who needs it can activate the Petal once placed. Even raising up the enemy can be the disruption your team needs to win a fight.

Guide.title: Instant save
content: Life Grip is the easiest way to instantly save an ally. No other Support ability has the ease and consistency of Life Grip when it comes to pulling a teammate from the grips of death.

Guide.title: Weak against dive
content: When a team running a dive comp sees the enemy is playing ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver, they just see a free kill every fight. Diving Lifeweaver poses no direct threat to the enemy as he primarily relies on evasion and team peel to survive.

Guide.title: Single-target abilities
content: Other than Tree of Life, all his cooldowns are single-target focused abilities. He can only heal one person at a time, and Life Grip’s long cooldown generally means only one teammate is getting saved per fight.

Guide.title: Struggles to be proactive
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver's kit is very reaction-oriented. To get the most value out of his abilities, he has to wait for the other team to make a play and try to counter. While you can get creative, he lacks the playmaking potential that the other Supports possess. If your team isn’t making it happen, Lifeweaver struggles to force the win.

Guide.title: Primary Fire: Healing Blossom
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-blossom.png)Healing Blossom
* Go for full charge

* * Overall, you’ll do far more healing by letting each ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-blossom.png)Healing Blossom shot go to full charge than shooting more projectiles at lower charges.
* Get to at least 80% charge before releasing.
* Jiggle peek
* * Between every charge, you should be jiggle peeking a corner or another type of cover. Don’t just stand in the open where you’re exposed to danger when you could be safely healing your team.
* Prioritize small and fast allies

* * When playing with another Support who has to aim their healing, help them out by focusing on the heroes that are harder to hit, like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji.
* Settings
* * Under hero settings, you have the option to toggle or hold ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/healing-blossom.png)Healing Blossom.
* Hold is on by default, but some players prefer not having to constantly hold down their button. Experiment and see which you prefer.

Guide.title: Secondary Fire: Thorn Volley
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/thorn-volley.png)Thorn Volley
* Focus on healing

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver is one Support that you want to play as a healbot. Your healing brings more value on average than your damage.
* Self Defense
* * Expect to be dove often. In these moments, keeping yourself alive and fighting the enemy is more important than ignoring the enemy and healing your allies.
* Poke pressure

* * T![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/thorn-volley.png)Thorn Volley doesn’t have good bullet spread or projectile speed, but it has no damage falloff. In poke phases of fights, your team shouldn’t need your constant healing, and you’ll be free to spend more time switching to damage dealing.

Guide.title: [SHIFT]: Petal Platform
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform
* Move the immobile

* * Heroes like Reinhardt, Ana, and Cassidy have no vertical mobility of their own. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform gives them pathing options that are normally impossible.
* Defensively, these same types of heroes can use Pedal to run away or walk over walls to get away from the enemy.
* Disrupt the enemy
* * The classic Pedal move of raising up an Ulting Orisa remains a great strategy to this day.
* Other examples of using Pedal to disrupt enemy attacks could include raising an ally out of Graviton Surge, or off the floor after being stunned or frozen.
* Give yourself a way out
* * Keeping yourself alive remains your number one priority, so if you feel you need to save Pedal for an enemy Tracer flanking you, then save Pedal for yourself.
* Throw out early

* * The cooldown of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform begins immediately when you throw it out. On defense or when a fight is just beginning, you can place one down where your team might need it, use it, and then already have another ready to go.

Guide.title: [E]: Life Grip
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/life-grip.png)Life Grip
* CC counter

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/life-grip.png)Life Grip can pull allies out of all hard stuns and crowd control abilities. Even ultimates like Cage Fight, Grav, and Flux that lock heroes in place are countered by ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/life-grip.png)Life Grip.

* Anytime an ally gets stunned and is vulnerable to death, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/life-grip.png)Life Grip is worth using to save them.
* Enable hyper-aggression

* * Whenever you have![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/life-grip.png)Life Grip, one ally can go for crazy aggro plays, knowing that you can pull them out if needed.

* Example: A ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt can pin into the enemy backline, get a kill, and be pulled out before he dies.
* Be thoughtful

* * 18 seconds is a very long cooldown. You can’t afford to waste ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/life-grip.png)Life Grip just to reposition one ally you think is overextended.

* Pay attention to your team's resources. A ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston might seem like they’re about to die, but is planning on using Primal. They’ll be one angry monkey if they get pulled out of the fight.
* Help me, I’m falling!
* * Life Grip is the only ability in Overwatch that can rescue an ally from being knocked off the map. When you see someone get booped off, pull them back to solid ground.

Guide.title: [SPACE]: Rejuvenating Dash
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rejuvenating-dash.png)Rejuvenating Dash
* Short Cooldown

* * Most of the time you can feel free to use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/rejuvenating-dash.png)Rejuvenating Dash for some quick healing, or to reposition yourself.
* Save for dodging
* * When the enemy team is flanking or diving you through a match, try to only use Dash for the specific purpose of dodging the dive attacker.

* Combine dashes with using ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform as an elevator up and down to maximize your evasiveness.

Guide.title: Ultimate: Tree of Life
content: **Tips for** ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tree-of-life.png)Tree of Life
* Needs LoS

* * Make sure your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tree-of-life.png)Tree of Life placement maintains LoS to yourself and your team throughout its duration. The AoE is decent sized, but not massive, so also make sure and place it near where your team wants to stand (e.g., the objective or where the fight is going to happen)

* Example: When your team wants to fight on the objective but is being pushed back, place your ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/tree-of-life.png)Tree of Life in front of your team so they can walk into the enemy team and stay within its AoE.
* Ignores Barriers
* * Unlike other AoE healing abilities that require LoS, Tree of Life ignores barriers so don’t worry about enemy shields.
* Use as a wall
* * The massive tree can be used as a wall to block choke points and doorways so the enemy team can’t walk through it. Great when capping the objective and the enemy team is returning from spawn.

Guide.title: Petal Protection
content: * A bit of extra Sustain, and ult charge.

* ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver can use the healing himself, which is especially good when petal dancing to avoid an attacker.

Guide.title: Dashing Escape
content: * Survive dive

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver needs all the survivability he can get against dive attacks, and the extra distance from this perk can make the difference between life and death against close-range dive enemies like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/vendetta.png)Vendetta.
* Keep up with mobile teams

* * Also good to selecte when your team consists of highly mobile heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/winston.png)Winston.

Guide.title: Superbloom
content: * The math

* * In 2.5 seconds, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver will fire 55 thorns, and you need to land 16 of those to trigger the detonation.
* You miss ~1/3 of your shots and still trigger Superbloom.
* Self defense

* * ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver's attack pressure is pretty low, and the extra incremental burst damage is useful when forced into duels.
* Anti-tank
* * Especially against non-barrier Tanks who can’t block your attacks, you can pump Thorn Volleys into their large bodies and trigger Superbloom detonations over and over.
* Pair with another high healing output Support
* * When you want to focus more on damage, play with another high-healing Support. If your other Support is Zen, for example, your team can’t afford for you to be spending time triggering Superbloom.

Guide.title: Sow the Seed
content: * Best for rush and brawl allies, as they get a lot of milage from movement buff and a burst of overhealth.
* Throw the seed in front of where your teammate is going, so they can pick it up as they chase the enemy.

Guide.title: Maps
content: The main feature ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver wants in a map is natural cover. He’s squishy, has short range in his mobility, and has weak offense. Therefore, he relies on natural cover to play around so he can evade enemy attacks while staying alive and healing his team.

High ground is always good for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver since only he can create a Pedal elevator for non-mobile allies. Open maps with spaced out natural cover are difficult for him to position on, as transitioning between exposes him, and his abilities start to feel limited by their range.

Guide.title: Team Comp Synergies
content: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver brings consistent ranged healing to teams, and especially to teams with highly mobile heroes. Equally as important are his utilities in ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform which can be used to grant access to high ground to immobile allies, and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform which allows him to save an ally from the brink of death.

Tanks like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga are the perfect pairings for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver because their primary weaknesses are lacking vertical mobility, range, and poor escape tools: all of which, Lifeweaver can offer them. Let either of them charge into the enemy team, dumb their cooldowns for kill, then pull them out before they die.

When it comes to DPS, take advantage of his lock-on healing with heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/tracer.png)Tracer who zip around and are difficult for many other Supports to sustain.

Also those who can use ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform for a combo like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/deadeye.png)Deadeye or ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/configuration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault are another type of good choice for similar reasons as the brawl Tanks.

The best Support for ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver is ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/brigitte.png)Brigitte because she can protect him from enemy dive and flanks while he sends out constant healing to the rest of their team.
Because he primarily brings healing, other Supports who offer more ultility like a speed boost, anti-healing, or CC are also ideal pairings.

Guide.title: Specific Hero Counters
content: All dive heroes like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/wrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/echo.png)Echo ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/genji.png)Genji, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/jetpack-cat.png)Jetpack Cat![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/sombra.png)Sombra, etc. excel at diving ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver, chasing his dash, going up to ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform.

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ana.png)Ana: Nade and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/sleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart are up twice as often as Life Grip. Force Cleansing Grasp Minor over Life Cycle. All LW does is heal, anti-nade shuts him down.

Focus your dives and flanks on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver . He won’t be personally killing you, so your only hindrance is his allies' protection.
Save your best cooldowns until after Life Grip has been used. After you’ve seen someone get pulled, you have a long window of time to attack where your target can’t be saved by Grip.

Pick a hero with vertical mobility. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/lifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver can easily avoid you if you can’t chase him vertically when he uses ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/petal-platform.png)Petal Platform.

text: ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/d-va.png)D.Va is a highly flexible dive tank with strong peel and burst damage. Defense Matrix counters projectile-heavy comps and completely negates high-value cooldowns like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/dynamite.png)Dynamite.

She can struggle against beam heroes like Domina or Symmetra if the map doesn't have the space for her to play around them and avoid their range. Even when this is a problem, the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/initiator.svg)Initiator subrole passive is incredibly powerful with D.Va, as she flies so frequently.

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina, the newest Tank, has been dominating across all ranks. While this may partly be due to players not knowing how to play against her properly, we can't deny her power. Her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-array.png)Barrier Array is almost never down because of the section's mechanic, plus her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/photon-magnum.png)Photon Magnum has good range and burst damage.

Domina is the best ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/roles/tank.svg)Tank for area control right now. Her self-sustain and damage mitigation enable herself and her team to lock down an area, then rotate to maintain distance. Where she can struggle is against highly mobile dive comps that bypass her control zones and attack her backline directly. Also, if the brawl Tanks like ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt get on top of her, she's going to fall over.

A mobility-focused tank who disrupts backlines, forces cooldown, and looks for quick assassinations. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/doomfist.png)Doomfist is strong when played against immobile Supports or very uncoordinated teams. He's having a hard time with all the hard CC and burst damage in the game right now. Unless you are a Doomfist specialist, you likely won't find much success playing him.

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/junker-queen.png)Junker Queen relies on her burst damage, self-sustain, and debuffs to steamroll team fights. She thrives in close-range fights and rush comps where her whole team goes aggro upon hearing her ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/commanding-shout.png)Commanding Shout. Limited range makes her weak against poke and high mobility comps. Then there's ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/kiriko.png)Kiriko existing in basically every game, so unless you ban the ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/protection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu, it's gonna be a struggle to win.

With two machine guns and a smile on his face, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/mauga.png)Mauga slams in, unloads, and charges out. In isolated Tank 1v1s, he's virtually unbeatable. Unfortunately for him, such a vacuum doesn't often exist, and Mauga gets all his damage blocked during ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/cardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive, then he either runs away or dies. Anti-heal abilities, such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/biotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade, are basically a death sentence.

When you want to hold your ground, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/orisa.png)Orisa is the stable frontline tank who can accomplish this goal. With strong anti-dive tools and survivability, she excels in poke and anti-brawl scenarios. However, she's completely dependent on ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/fortify.png)Fortify and cooldown cycling to stay alive. One wrong use, and she's a goner.

![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/ramattra.png)Ramattra is the Hybrid tank with poke and brawl forms. ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form allows strong frontline pressure and pierces barriers such as ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt and ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/domina.png)Domina's. Most players have learned how to kite ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/nemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form, then take him out while in Omnic Form. He has good survivability with shields and block, but struggles to take the fight into his own hands or be aggressive.

When you think of tanking in Overwatch, you think ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/heroes/reinhardt.png)Reinhardt. He's the classic brawl tank who dominates when he gets into swinging range. Unfortunately, this is very hard to do in the current state of Overwatch, as most of the meta and popular heroes have the mobility to completely avoid Rein if they are watching out for him. There are too many heroes that Reinhardt cannot interact with for him to be placed any higher.

That said, his giant shield, ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/barrier-field.png)Barrier Field signals his team to stand behind him, and he generally performs well because the vast majority of players understand how to play with a Reinhardt on their team.

A pick-focused tank who either feasts on the enemy team or feeds their ultimate charge. The threat of ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook forces the enemy to play and position around it, but any missed ![](https://cdn.mobalytics.gg/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,width=96/assets/overwatch/images/abilities/chain-hook.png)Chain Hook is the go-signal for the enemy team.
